original:
"Some among their ranks, yes," a hint of smile forms on Baird's face, "But others can see that this is the best way forward. The League can't pull the best and brightest from the entire Sector. The Galatia Academy can. They don't have the theoretical research and experimentation infrastructure we do. It's all practical matters with their Fleet Armamentarium; weapons, warships, heavy industry, and doling out contracts to gens-allies."

"Furthermore, subfactions within the League could not call an open vote on a matter so delicate as this. We merely resolved their political questions by other means," the provost tips her head toward you, acknowledging your role.
translation:
"是的，他们中的一些人会。" Baird 的脸上流露出一丝笑意，"但其他人知道这其实能让星域更快地向前发展 —— 英仙座联盟 无法从整个星域中找出最优秀最聪明的人，但 Galatia 学院可以，再者他们也没有我们的理论研究基础和专业实验设备 —— 这可是与他们的舰队武器库有关的实际问题，武器、战舰、重工业，以及与盟国签订的各种合同。"

"此外，联盟内部的各派不能就这样一个微妙的问题要求公开投票，我们只是用其他方式解决了他们的政治问题。" 院长歪过头来看了你一眼，承认了你在事情发展中扮演的角色。

Baird looks at you for a long moment. You think you see something new. Something almost like emotional pain.

"Scylla never appreciated the gifts I... the academy offered her. It's how she was raised, perhaps. Her insubordination was indulged. Became habitual. But with time, when she sees what we accomplish, maybe her higher sense of rationality will win out. I know she is capable of it."

Baird turns, staring forward, and sets her jaw.
translation:
Baird 注视了你很长时间。你感觉你在她脸上看到了前所未有的表情，似乎是某种感情上的痛苦。

"Scylla 从来没有对我... 对学院向她提供的机会表达过感激。也许，她就是这样长大的。她的不服从被纵容着。久而久之成为了习惯。但随着时间的推移，当她看到我们所取得的成就时，也许她思维中的理性会占上风。我知道她会回心转意的。"

Baird 转过身，凝视着前方，下巴绷得紧紧的。

"What she believes is that if she makes a show of how much she doesn't care about anything, anyone, it'll look like she's the most ruthless and focused executive in the Company. Just see how much she's willing to destroy to succeed! There must be something to it, right?"

He sits back, fists clenched. "It's a waste of capital! Human resources, too. Do you know how expensive it is to train good techs, competent management? It is the glowing prize at the center of this temple, this shrine to the ego of Menes Yaribay bought with the lucre of the Kazeronian empire, fueled by faith and blood from over two hundred cycles since someone who took the name Ludd did something, probably, half-remembered then gilded in glorious myth on a planet named Gilead.
translation:
尽管知道它是什么 —— 或者更确切地说，知道它不是什么 —— 但伸手去触碰这件已经蒙羞，只是仍被认为价值连城的物件，却依然像是亵渎神明。它承载着的能量和意义、信仰与暴力就是如此强大，哪怕它早已被物化，沦为了骗局。

它是这座神殿中心熠熠生辉的奖杯，这圣地供奉着 Menes Yaribay 的自负，由 Kazeron 帝国的财富铸就，而浇灌了它两百多星历年的信仰和鲜血，则来自于一个名为卢德的人在名为 Gilead 的星球上的所行之事，其记载大概已残缺不全，却在后来被镀上了辉煌的神话色彩。

original:
Menes leads your party past gilded statues guarding the portal to the main complex; the forms are evocative of splashes of molten gold frozen by happenstance into sensual humanoid figures.

You watch as Horus, lean and intense as some small predator, endures the patter from Menes, a man of more generous form and character. Menes plays down the 'frontier quality' of renovations, the poor selection of artworks, the difficulty of accessing the best artists and engineering firms to contribute to his home in 'all but exile'.

Occasionally a robotic or human servitor appears to offer drinks or nibbles, and you've a growing feeling that Menes has picked up a glass from one only to place it back on the tray of another without ever taking a sip.

A fresh glass in hand, Menes tentatively leads Horus into what can only be his prize entertaining space.
translation:
Menes 领着你们一行人走过了几尊守在主建筑入口前的鎏金雕像。雕像的造型宛如飞溅的熔金在机缘巧合之间凝成了千姿百态的性感人形。

你看着精干而凌厉的 Horus 就像一只小型猛兽一般，忍受着心宽体胖的 Menes 一直喋喋不休。Menes 轻描淡写地嫌弃着自家 "边陲质感" 的装潢和品味匮乏的艺术品，以及在他这 "形同流放" 的家里，想请到顶尖艺术家和工程公司相助是多么困难。

偶尔会有机器人或人类侍者出现，呈上饮品或小吃。但你越看越觉得 Menes 纯粹只是从托盘上拿起一杯酒，而后又放到另一个托盘上，自始至终一口都没喝过。

手中又换了一杯新酒后，Menes 试着将 Horus 领进他最引以为傲的主招待厅。

He nearly trips over himself to speak. "The great Horus Yaribay! Your reputation precedes you, if half of what-"

Horus holds up a hand, silencing the man, and turns aside. "Menes, what is this?"

"Ha- ha, ah, this is Ulmus Pond," Menes replies quickly, his drinkless off-hand waving to shoo Pond away. "Ulmus, not now. Perhaps see that Captain $playerLastName's Luddic friend here has a fresh drink? Thank-you."

"Now, cousin Horus, I must offer a thousand apologies." Menes himself turns, also cutting Pond out of the conversation. "Had you signalled ahead we could have arranged for a proper reception..."
translation:
他急着要说话，都差点把自己绊倒了。"伟大的 Horus Yaribay！您的大名如雷贯耳，如果传闻有一半 ——"

Horus 抬手让那人安静下来，然后转向身侧。"Menes，这是怎么回事？"

"哈 —— 哈，啊，这是 Ulmus Pond。" Menes 赶紧回答，他挥了挥没拿酒杯的另一只手，想把 Pond 赶走。"Ulmus，现在不是时候。你可以先看看 $playerLastName 舰长的这位卢德朋友需不需要来杯喝的？谢谢你了。"

"好了，Horus 堂兄，我万分抱歉。" Menes 自己也转过身，同样把 Pond 排除在了对话之外。"如果你提前说一声，我们就能安排一场正式的招待会..."

original:
When the marines finally breach the vault proper, it is with overwhelming force of sound and light. No unprotected human can withstand this assault on the senses; you are blinded, shocked, and rendered immobile. All you can do is cling to the kernel of self at the center of a storm of pain.

* * *

The return is slow, an awakening from a terrible and drugged sleep to emergency medical personnel and Menes' somewhat tardy security teams in their gleaming armor.

You and Bornanew leave the compound among the other victims. Bandaged, bruised, head aching, ears ringing.
translation:
当陆战队员最终攻破保险库本体时，随之而来的是排山倒海般的强光与巨响。没有未穿戴防护的人类能承受这种感官冲击；你瞬间被致盲，意识被震慑，动弹不得。在这场席卷一切的痛苦风暴中，你唯一能做的，就是死守住那一点残存的意识。

* * *

意识的回归很缓慢，仿佛从一场可怕的药物昏睡中醒来。你看到了急救人员和 Menes 那些姗姗来迟、身穿闪亮盔甲的安保团队。

你和 Bornanew 混在其他受害者中离开了庄园。他们身上缠满绷带，遍体鳞伤，头痛欲裂，耳鸣不止。

Hours later, after a series of transfers to obscure your movements from the heightened official surveillance, you step back onto your own shuttle - and the attentions of your personal medical team.

A chime on your TriPad confirms that the operation was a success. A holo of the simple work-glove that human beings fought and died over rotates mockingly. 

"Evidence," Bornanew says, tired but alert. His eyes are alarmingly bloodshot. "The seed of schism and war. Now whence did this come?"

几个小时后，你通过一系列转乘摆脱官方加强的监视，回到了自己的穿梭机上 —— 也回到了你私人医疗团队的照料下。

original:
You enter the great nave of the Cathedral of Holy Exodus.

Among towering columns are affixed recovered landing pods of the early Luddic refugee ships, now integrated into the vaults, painted with gilt and green, bedecked with candles and hanging glass ornaments which break the beams of the sun - filtered through ranks of high windows - into thousands of rainbow shards, endlessly refracting.

It is an ecstasy of light, a galaxy unto itself.

Bornanew pauses beside you, looking upward. Could one old work-glove and a lie tip all of this down to shatter upon the ground?
translation:
你走进 Exodus 神圣大教堂的宏伟中殿。

高耸的立柱之间，固定着早年卢德派难民船中回收的登陆舱 —— 如今这些登陆舱已被整合进拱顶建筑结构中，周身涂有鎏金与绿色的彩绘，还装饰着蜡烛与悬挂的玻璃饰品。阳光穿过一排排高耸的窗户洒落，经这些饰品折射后，化作无数道彩虹碎片，光影交错，不断折射。

这是一场光影的狂欢，自成一片星河。

Bornanew 在你身旁驻足，抬头仰望。一只破旧的工作手套，一句谎言，真能让眼前这一切轰然倒塌，碎落满地吗？

He leads you to a small alcove, invisible at the foot of the luminous architectural forest of cut stone and carved wood. And there, after exchanging words with an attendant, a door is revealed in the ornately carved wall.

original:
There are halls and offices here, lit not by candles but humble glowplates belched legion from Asher's nanoforge. The walls of cut stone are trimmed with alternating panels and mouldings of wood.

Bornanew's words and the token, presumably provided by the Archcurate Jaspis, clear a path through frowning oblate-secretaries and young Knight-novices on guard duty.

Not all are so dour; one or two initiates, scurrying by with armloads of books, greet Bornanew by name.
translation:
这里遍布着厅堂与办公室，照明并非来自蜡烛，而是无数块 Asher 上纳米锻炉批量生产的不起眼发光板。切割石材砌成的墙壁边缘，装饰着交替排列的木板与木饰线。

Bornanew 的话语，再加上那枚想必是由大祭司 Jaspis 提供的信物，为你们扫清了前路，沿途那些面带不悦的修道院文书，以及值岗的年轻见习骑士，都未加阻拦。

并非所有人都这般阴沉：有一两位见习修士抱着成摞的书匆匆走过，路过时与 Bornanew 问好。

original:
You follow Bornanew into a long room, a gallery of columns intermingled with bookcases; cleverly designed lightwells - and, surely, a series of mirrors - provide shafts of sunlight, motes dancing with little concern in their small world within this analog archive. 

Heads turn to follow your progress past desks stacked with paper books, writing implements, and even the occasional low-fidelity interface terminal.

Your tactical sense notes the figures at side-doors who disappear purposefully, clearly headed off to spread this news and summon gawkers - or allies.

Your weapon-hand twitches.
translation:
你跟着 Bornanew 走进一间狭长的厅堂，这里立柱林立，书架错落摆放。采光井装有设计精巧的镜片，将阳光引入室内，形成一道道光柱；在这座仿古的档案馆里，光柱中的微尘在自己的小世界里肆意舞动，无忧无虑。

你们走过一张张办公桌时，周围人的目光纷纷投来，紧随你们的脚步。桌上堆着纸质书籍、书写工具，偶尔还能看到几台低分辨率的交互终端。

你的战术直觉留意到，侧门处有几个人影神色匆匆地离开，显然是要去散播消息，或是召集看热闹的人；也可能是召集帮手。

你握枪的那只手微微一动。

Bornanew approaches a proud figure all in holy vestments at the head of the room.

那人终于转过身来。"见习修士，" 她回应道，语气中带着鲜明的自上而下的权威感，"你为何回到我的文书室？是又被指派了额外的赎罪任务吗？"

"It was you," Bornanew says with perfect earnestness.

"You scanned the glove said to be of Ludd. You did this in the vault of this cathedral, and you knowingly passed that scan data to an agent of the heretics called the Luddic Path. Their aim, and yours, was to sow discord within the Church of Galactic Redemption. This I shall prove before the judgement of the Inquisitors."

"For these crimes," he raises his voice against the growing murmurs, "against the Holy Church, by the authority of the Reverend Archcurate Sophronia Jaspis, as a Knight of Ludd, I do now place you under arrest."
translation:
"是你干的，" Bornanew 神情郑重地说道。

"你扫描了那只据称属于卢德的手套。你在这座大教堂的地窖里做了这件事，而且你明知故犯，把扫描数据传给了异端组织 '卢德左径' 的一名成员。他们的目的 —— 也是你的 —— 就是在 银河救赎教会 内部制造分裂。我将在审判官的面前证明这一切。"

"鉴于这些罪行，" 他提高声音，盖过越来越响的议论声，"这些针对神圣教会的罪行，以 Sophronia Jaspis 宗师之名，我将履行卢德骑士的职责，在此将你正式逮捕。"

original:
Bornanew's credentials - in truth, those of Archcurate Jaspis - fell the meddling traffic control bureaucrats who stand in your way, one after another.

A Knight-novice, of equal rank but rather lesser age than $global.jethroName, puts on a grimace as he is forced to reassign the shuttle-slot of some curate from the landing pad nearest to the Cathedral of Holy Exodus.    

Nearest is a relative term. On Tartessus, the Church of Galactic Redemption takes the view that spaceborn traffic is a shameful act to be hidden away from the eyes of land-dwellers. As your shuttle lands, Bornanew observes that the cathedral is somewhat over the horizon.
translation:
Bornanew 出示的证件实际上就是大祭司 Jaspis 的，这让那些从中作梗、挡路的交通管制官员们一个个乖乖放行。

一名与 $global.jethroName 级别相同但是年轻些的见习骑士，带着不情愿的苦相，被迫将某位神职人员的穿梭机停机位，从原本靠近 Exodus 神圣大教堂的停机坪重新调配到别处。

靠近 本就是个相对概念。在 Tartessus 星球上，银河救赎教会 秉持着这样一种观点：太空飞行器的往来是种不光彩的行为，应当避开地面居民的视线。当你们的穿梭机降落时，Bornanew 注意到，大教堂其实还在视线尽头的地平线之外。

original:
Expressions among the apprentices range from appalled second-hand embarrassment to impish delight.

Red-faced, the Knight-Captain, regains his feet with Subcurate Keepfaith restrained in his arms. There is little dignity remaining for either.

Bornanew, meanwhile, remains standing in a stray beam of sunlight - a product of the clever arrangement of lightwells. The effect places him as the glowing centerpiece to an instructive tableau.

This can't have been happenstance; Bornanew's insistence on pushing forward, toward the light...
translation:
学徒们脸上的表情各异：有人因这场尴尬的闹剧而面露震惊，仿佛自己也置身窘境；有人则带着顽童般的窃喜，看得津津有味。

骑士长涨红了脸，重新站起身来，怀里还紧紧制住助理祭司 Keepfaith。此刻两人早已没了半分体面。

与此同时，Bornanew 仍站在一束散落的阳光中 —— 这束光是采光井精妙设计的杰作。光影效果之下，他宛如一幅宗教画作中熠熠生辉的核心角色。

Bornanew 执意步步向前，朝着光亮处行进的举动绝非偶然...

The cadre of Luddic Knights guarding the Cathedral of Holy Exodus defer to Bornanew's authority.

"Excubitor Orbis," he whispers, then carefully turns his head toward a display of starry space and the orb of Tartessus. "Penance." 

He closes his eyes. Mouth open, still breathing.

You feel a movement in the air. Your chief medical officer hovers meaningfully, waiting for you to choose to leave, now.
translation:
Bornanew 面色苍白，呼吸微弱。"去 Hesperus，" 他说道，"去找卢德骑士团。"

"行星教卫，" 他轻声呢喃，随后缓缓转头望向显示着璀璨星空与 Tartessus 星球的屏幕。"赎罪。"

他闭上了眼睛。嘴巴微张，呼吸仍在继续。

你察觉到空气中的动静。你的医疗主管在一旁徘徊着，沉默地催促你离开。

original:
Menes is describing another of his expensive acquisitions when the lights cut out.

A moment passes in absolute darkness, the crushing weight of silence falling as the ventilation whirs to a stop. This is the terrible abyss of spacers' death; a reminder that you exist by the whim of machines caught in deadly vacuum, in a precarious balance of temperature and artificial atmosphere.

The subdued red emergency lighting strips flicker to life. Menes produces a nervous smile, "I'm sure it's just, um, a glitch." He mumbles something into his cuff, then gives it a confused shake.

Comms down. By the plan.
translation:
当 Menes 正在介绍他的另一件昂贵藏品时，灯突然灭了。

四周陷入了绝对的黑暗，通风系统的嗡鸣戛然而止，令人窒息的沉寂随之降临。这便是太空船员葬身的恐怖深渊；它提醒着你，你的存续全仰仗着机器的恩赐 —— 在致命的真空中，是它们维系着温度与人造大气之间的脆弱平衡。

昏暗的红色应急灯带闪烁起来。Menes 挤出紧张的微笑："这肯定只是，呃，只是个小故障。" 他对着袖口咕哝了些什么，然后困惑地摇了摇手腕。

通讯系统挂掉了，一切都在计划中。

They halt it several meters from you, then scurry over to retrieve the glove - still in its open sample case - and place the whole lot carefully into the blackened interior. original:
Your shuttle approaches an almost floral arrangement of pads set in the midst of a former mine pit.

Heavy doors open from the rockface inviting your landing party into the dimly lit hangar beyond.

A score of armored Knights march forth - like small, segmented dolls compared with the scale of the door, but as you approach you note their height. They must be the tallest farm-fed children of Gilead and Tartessus, all aclad in polished white armor, half-capes slack in the near-vacuum.

They turn precisely aside, weapons held vertical.
translation:
你的穿梭机正接近一片坐落在四散的废弃矿井中央的停机坪。

岩壁上厚重的大门开启，邀请你的登陆小队进入后方那间光线昏暗的机库。

二十名身着铠甲的骑士列队迎上前来 —— 与大门的尺寸相比，他们乍一看像一个个分段拼接的小玩偶，但当你靠近时，才会注意到他们的身高。他们一定是来自 Gilead 和 Tartessus 的良家子，全都身披锃亮的白色铠甲，短斗篷在近乎真空的环境中松垂着。

他们精准地向一旁转身，武器竖直持握。

You enter, the guards reverse their process, and the hangar is pressurized. 

A far door cracks open, casting a long wedge of light. Spots snap on, converted shuttles and fightercraft loom in all corners.

The Excubitor Orbis enters. 

Gideon Oak is a brick of a man, squat but powerful. Perhaps the product of a forgotten high-G world. He is accompanied by a weedy clerk.
translation:
你进入机库后，守卫们启动了反向操作流程，机库内开始充压。

远处的一扇门裂开一道缝隙，一道细长的光线投射进来。照明射灯骤然亮起，改造过的穿梭机与战斗机在各个角落赫然矗立，轮廓庞大。

行星教卫走了进来。

Gideon Oak 身形如砖石般敦实，个子不高却孔武有力 —— 他或许来自某个早已被遗忘的高重力星球。陪在他身边的，是一位身形瘦弱的文书。

original:
You can see the inner conflict on Bornanew's face.

He knows he is asking far, far too much. But he wants to. If he had the credits, he would give them to the cause of the Church without a second thought. But he is a Knight of Ludd, sworn to poverty but for the allowance granted to him by his order - or by the indulgence of the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis.

He sees that you see all of this. And, knowing that words can only do harm, he makes the barest movement toward a shrug. A way of saying, you know who I am; what I am; what I need ask. Your choice is yours.
translation:
你可以从 Bornanew 的脸上看出他内心的挣扎。

他知道他要求得实在太多了，但他需要这些。如果他有星币，他会毫不犹豫地把它们贡献给教会的事业。但他是一名卢德骑士，发誓安贫乐道，除了因被指派任务而领到的资金，以及因大祭司 Jaspis 的宽容而得到的津贴外，他一无所有。

他清楚你对这些事情十分了解。而且，他知道言语只会造成伤害，于是只轻微地耸了耸肩。意思是，你知道我是谁；我是什么；我需要什么。选择权在你的手上。

original:
It is estimated that roughly 100 marines will be required to pull off the operation.

Your marines will be equipped with an eclectic mix of equipment to allow them to pose as high-level pirates. They will be secretly infiltrated into Olinadu as, variously, spacer crew on shore-leave, contract technicians, and ne'er-do-wells looking to spend ill-gotten gains somewhere away from heavy law enforcement.

It goes without saying that you shall need to approach Olinadu with your $shipOrFleet's transponder off. Menes' overly charitable outlook on your character and generalized inattention to his official duties should allow you to join his 'party' with little oversight about how you actually got there.
translation:
据估计，大约需要{100 名陆战队员}才能完成这次任务。

你的陆战队员将配备乱七八糟的装备来冒充高级海盗。他们将以各种身份秘密渗透到 Olinadu 上，比如上岸休假的太空船员、合同制技术员，以及想在远离严密执法的地方挥霍不义之财的无赖。

不用说，你需要在$shipOrFleet{应答器关闭}的情况下接近 Olinadu。Menes 对你身份的过分慷慨和他对公务的普遍疏忽，应该能让你几乎不受监督地加入他的 '派对'，并且不会让人在意你是怎么去到那里的。

original:
To avert suspicion and ensure optimal timing, you and Bornanew will personally attend Menes' party when the raid is executed.

The raid will commence when two of a series of randomly generated time-slots are passed without receiving a stand-down signal. This signal will be, by all appearances, a routine status query to your $shipOrFleet, and appear to be perfectly routine behaviour for a justifiably neurotic independent $shipOrFleet operator.

Bornanew is watchful throughout the planning process, only occasionally advocating for lower-force protocols when a particularly bloodthirsty marine squad leader expresses more enthusiasm than strictly required for certain tactical details.
translation:
为了避免怀疑并掌握最佳时机，你和 Bornanew 将在劫掠进行时亲自参加 Menes 的派对。

在一系列随机生成的时段中，如果中止信号连续两个时段未被发出，那么劫掠行动就将会启动。无论从何种角度看，这个中止信号都只是你对自己$shipOrFleet的例行状态查询，对于一个有理由时刻保持警惕的独立$shipOrFleet指挥官来说，这种行为再正常不过了。

Bornanew 在整个制定计划的过程中都保持慎言，只是偶尔在某个特别嗜血的陆战队长对一些战术细节展现出超出必要限度的热情时，他才主张采用较低强度的方案。

"A nanoforge engineer could tell us where this came from," he says. "Who made it. When, and where. By that truth, we can judge the answers we receive from those we... interview." His last word is muted by the shuttle's maneuverings.

"The Church operates a nanoforge on the planet Asher, in the Canaan system. The engineers there will cooperate with the authority I bear, and despite mostly being nonbelievers, their discretion is already paid for by the Church. Our inquiry will be safe."

He pauses, and looks away. "So far as anything is, in the Church."
translation:
"纳米锻炉工程师能告诉我们这东西是哪来的，" 他说，"具体来说是谁造的。什么时候造的，在哪造的。通过这些事实，我们就能判断出我们从那些... 被采访的人那里得到的答案信不信得过了。" 他说 "采访" 时，声音被穿梭机的颠簸声盖了过去。

"教会的纳米锻炉在 Canaan 星系的 Asher 上。那里的技术人员会配合我所代表的授权。虽然说他们大多是无信者，但教会已经付过钱让他们保密了。我们的调查会很安全。"

他顿了一下，移开了视线，"至少，在教会所能做到的范围内很安全。"

original:
"A nanoforge engineer could tell us where this came from," he says. "Who made it. When, and where. By that truth, we can judge the answers we receive from those we... interview." His last word is muted by the shuttle's maneuverings.

"The Church operates a nanoforge on the planet Asher, in the Canaan system. The engineers there will cooperate with the authority I bear, and despite mostly being nonbelievers, their discretion is already paid for by the Church. Our inquiry will be safe."

He pauses, and looks away. "So far as anything is, in the Church."
translation:
"纳米锻炉工程师能告诉我们这东西是哪来的，" 他说，"具体来说是谁造的。什么时候造的，在哪造的。通过这些事实，我们就能判断出我们从那些... 被采访的人那里得到的答案信不信得过了。" 他说 "采访" 时，声音被穿梭机的颠簸声盖了过去。

"教会的纳米锻炉在 Canaan 星系的 Asher 上。那里的技术人员会配合我所代表的授权。虽然说他们大多是无信者，但教会已经付过钱让他们保密了。我们的调查会很安全。"

他顿了一下，移开了视线，"至少，在教会所能做到的范围内很安全。"

original:
The primary defenses are destroyed, the command and control section holed and venting fiery atmo. The superstructure's own spin is pulling the station apart like slow butchery.

You destroyed the nanoforge, but did not secure the evidence Bornanew needed to find the mole in the Cathedral of Holy Exodus on Tartessus.

"It is the best that could be done," Bornanew says, eyes downcast. His notebook is closed, before him. "I must submit myself to the Excubitor Orbis for judgment. On Hesperus."
translation:
主要防御体系已被摧毁，指挥控制区也被击穿，炽热的大气正喷涌而出。空间站的结构正因自身的旋转而缓缓撕裂，如同缓慢的肢解。

你摧毁了纳米锻炉，却未能获取 Bornanew 所需的证据 —— 那些能在 Tartessus 的 Exodus 神圣大教堂揪出内应的证据。

"这已是所能做到的最好结果了，" Bornanew 垂目低语道。他的笔记本正合着，摆在他的面前。"我必须向行星教卫大人请罪，就在 Hesperus。"

original:
The prize, turned over to your Tech officer's analysis team by a crew of sweating salvors, is a largely uncorrupted backup archive. Standard Domain tech, it hardly looks like the Pathers even knew it was quietly doing its job behind a thin access panel.

The technicians descend upon it with a suite of interfacers, passing every scrap of data to the analysts working in an isolated computing environment to reconstruct the system, starting with comms buffers and metadata.
translation:
这份战利品被一群大汗淋漓的打捞员移交至你的技术军官的分析团队手中 —— 那是一个基本完好的备份档案库。标准的 人之领 科技，而且似乎左径分子甚至未曾察觉到，它就藏在一块薄薄的检修板后默默运作着。

技术团队带着全套接口设备蜂拥而上，将每一点数据碎片传递至隔离计算环境中的分析员手中，从通讯缓冲区和元数据开始，着手重建整个系统。

original:
You watch from the command center as marine squads launch the opening salvo from seemingly innocuous cargo containers. Powered armor units burst forth like locusts; combat techs inject malware into the station network, demolitions breach emergency blast doors, and assault teams cut a swath to key targets.

Nodes on the adaptive objective graph, woven through the station tactical display, are achieved one after another. Points blink from blood-red to amber or green, depending on found conditions. Indeed, some comms relays and data clusters auto-destruct upon unauthorized access, but others quietly fail, allowing techs to seize the contents.

The last red-indicated volume is the industrial section housing what is indeed the station's nanoforge; the Pathers had regrouped for a last stand. And so it is.
translation:
你在指挥中心注视着陆战小队从看似普通的货运集装箱中发起首轮突袭。动力甲单位如蝗群般涌出；作战技官将恶意软件注入空间站网络，爆破组炸开紧急防爆舱门，突击队则向关键目标席卷而去。

在自适应目标图谱上，贯穿空间站战术界面的节点被一个接一个攻克。根据探测到的状况，节点指示灯从血红色闪烁着变为琥珀色或绿色。诚然，部分通讯中继站与数据集群在遭遇未授权访问时会自毁，但另一些则会默然失效，让技术人员得以截获内容。

最后标注为红色的区域是容纳着空间站纳米锻炉的工业区；左径分子已在此重组，准备负隅顽抗，正如预料。

original:
They were caught off-guard. Despite the large numbers of armed zealots of the Path, your strike teams concentrated force where their defenses, fighting to the death, could not hold.

Teams return to waiting evac drones and shuttles, trailed by tethered spoils: memory blocks torn from their cradles, a few bagged prisoners.

A blue-white flash illuminates the returning victors. Behind them, the industrial section spins itself apart, structural plates shattered into glowing shards, struts tortuously bent, and that atmo which hasn't burned off in a glowing plume forms a rapidly expanding, dissipating cloud, illuminated from within by dying light.
translation:
他们被打了个措手不及。尽管左径的武装狂热者人数众多，但你的突击队将火力集中于他们拼死抵抗却无法固守的防区。

各小队返回待命的撤离无人机与穿梭机，身后牵引着战利品：从基座上扯下的记忆模块，以及几名被拘束袋所捆缚的俘虏。

一道蓝白色闪光映亮了凯旋的队伍。在他们身后，工业区正在自我崩解 —— 结构板碎裂成炽热的残片，支撑梁扭曲变形，未被燃烧殆尽的大气在炽热烟柱中形成急速膨胀消散的云团，内部透出垂死的微光。

original:
You convene your officers, and Bornanew, to evaluate the situation.

Pather resistance is expected to be fierce; the core of their militants have a zealous faith, little fear of death, and are often experienced fighters. However they eschew top of the line technology and combat enhancement, whether cybernetic or biochemical.

Bornanew clears his throat and speaks. "Certain classes of combat drugs are accepted among Luddic Path militants. They favor, ah, 'natural' sources." He takes in the confused looks. "Plants," he adds.

Capturing high-value datastores before they're wiped creates exceptional difficulties. The assault must be lightning-quick, and disabling rather than destructive as much as possible.
translation:
你召集麾下的军官与 Bornanew 共同评估局势。

左径分子的抵抗预计将极为激烈；其核心武装分子信仰狂热，悍不畏死，且多为经验丰富的战士。然而他们排斥顶尖科技与战斗强化手段，无论是赛博改造还是生化增强。

Bornanew 清了清嗓子，随后开口说道："某些类别的战斗药剂在卢德左径武装分子中被允许使用。他们偏好，呃，'天然' 的来源。" 他察觉到众人困惑的目光，便继续道，"也就是植物提取物。"

在数据存储单元被清除前夺取高价值目标将带来极大的困难。突击行动必须迅如闪电，并尽可能采用瘫痪手段而非毁灭性打击。

这并非什么危险状况。那些风暴虽然声势浩大，但因这颗星球的大气稀薄至极，其物质密度其实很低。

Senior Engineer Tanaica places the glove and its containment vessel onto a shelf which retracts into the towering white casing of the analysis suite. Transparent panes, probably diamond-matrix, reveal arcane inner workings.

She hits a command to evacuate the atmo from the sample slot, and sets a manipulator to extract the glove and place it on the scanning bed. All of this she performs with a casual ease born of practice. She speaks as she taps away at the control interface.

"If it came from a high-quality nanoforge like what the Heggies or League's got, this might not tell us much." 

Some kind of protective barrier shunts down, hiding the glove from view. A holo of the glove emerges from a display unit, gaining resolution until a doppelganger rotates in the air before you.
translation:
高级工程师 Tanaica 将手套及其密封容器放置在一个置物架上，置物架随即缩进了分析设备高耸的白色外壳中。几块透明面板，大概是金刚石方窗，展示出其精密的内部结构。

她按下指令，抽干了样本槽内的空气，又操控机械臂取出手套，将其放置到扫描台上。这一系列操作，她做得行云流水，显然是经验使然。她一边在控制界面上快速操作，一边开口说道：

"要是这手套出自像 霸主 或 英仙座联盟 那样的高质量纳米锻炉，这台设备可能也查不出什么名堂。"

一道防护屏障应声降下，将手套完全遮蔽。与此同时，一块显示屏投射出手套的全息影像，影像的清晰度不断提升，最终，一个与手套一模一样的立体投影在你眼前缓缓旋转。

"Hm. Good output, this. But I'm thinking not good-perfect. Ludd...ics," her eyes dart at Bornanew, "No offense, but they don't go in for training much native talent. S'why you lot pay me."

"Anyway, when you get into really delicate products, your forge quality starts to matter. A work-rated vac-glove though?" She rolls her eyes. "This better be good."

The analysis suite is making some kind of humming sound, and there's a clunk. The engineer doesn't react, so neither do you. Her display erupts with numbers and icons, then something she does pulls a cutaway from the holo-glove, which scales as the rest of it disappears. 

Another segmentation of scale iterates, then another.
translation:
"嗯。分析结果不错，不过还不算完美无缺。卢德...教会，" 她飞快地瞥了 Bornanew 一眼，又补充道，"无意冒犯，但他们向来不怎么注重培养本土人才。这也是你们这些人花钱雇我的原因。"

"话说回来，要是分析那些真正高精尖的产品，锻炉的工艺水准就很关键了。可这玩意儿不过是一只工业级的真空手套？" 她翻了个白眼，"希望这东西值得我费这番功夫。"

分析设备发出一阵嗡嗡声，随即传来 "咔嗒" 一声。工程师对此毫无反应，你便也不动声色。她面前的显示屏瞬间被密密麻麻的数字和图标铺满，紧接着，她操作了一番，手套的全息投影上便浮现出剖面视图；随着投影的其他部分逐渐隐去，这个剖面的比例也随之放大。

"These defects are unique to the faults in an individual nanoforge. More or less." 

"Like a fingerprint," Bornanew says.

"No." The engineer shrugs. "But sure, if you like."
translation:
"我们能在这儿观测到我们所说的 '偏移痕迹'。" 她说道。手套内部深处，一片排列规整的微结构外围，一圈彩色指示环正不停闪烁；这些微结构大概就是单个原子的映射，如同砂岩的颗粒一般，隐约可见。

"这些缺陷应当是专属某台缺陷纳米锻炉的特征。"

"就像指纹一样。" Bornanew 说道。

original:
Bornanew lives, by a thread.

In the moments since the exchange, a time hollowed out by violence and filled with the fleeting intensity of adrenaline, your security team appears.

Finding you unhurt, they attach stabilization packs and trauma strips to the fallen Knight. He's left an incredible pool of blood in the cheap apartment. It drips down the narrow stairs.

The other two bodies lie dead.

It is unclear how fully Ulmus Pond was exploited by or truly believed in the Pather cause, but his loyalty - if he ever had any - died with him.
translation:
Bornanew 还活着，但已命悬一线。

在暴力掏空的短暂时刻里，肾上腺素带来的强烈感知尚未消退，你的安保小队已赶到现场。

确认你没有受伤后，他们为倒地的骑士固定了稳定气囊与创伤贴条。他在廉价公寓里留下了触目惊心的血泊，鲜血正沿着狭窄的楼梯滴落。

另外两具尸体已无生命迹象。

尚不清楚 Ulmus Pond 究竟是被左径事业所利用，还是真心信仰，但他的忠诚 —— 若曾经存在的话 —— 已随其性命一同消逝。

You hear your name called like a curse, and a makeshift missile smashes against a samovar behind you. It tips, slowly, and falls to the ground with a crash. A small wave of hot water washes over your boots, and a cloud of steam envelopes you.

Your bodyguards form a human wall to cover your path toward the exit. Stumbling outside, you can hear the ringing of alarm bells which signal the rapid approach of the local MuniSec squad led by a Knight of Ludd. There'll be no quiet business done in this bar for the rest of the shift, that much is clear.
translation:
混乱蔓延开来，船员和本地人都瞪着你，还有几个最醉的 —— 也是最愤怒的人，站了起来，这里明显不是只卖茶水和低度数啤酒的那种卢德酒吧。

你听到有人像骂脏话一样吼出你的名字，同时，一发临时制成的投掷物砸碎了你背后的茶炊。茶炊慢慢倾倒，最后砰然落地。一些茶水溅在你的靴子上，水蒸汽瞬间将你包裹起来。

你的保镖们组成人墙，护卫你走出酒吧。你刚跌跌撞撞地跑出门，就听到了警铃声，看来本地卢德骑士正带着地方安全部的人手快速赶来。很明显，今天酒吧里没什么能安静谈事的地方了。

original:
The chaos spreads outward, crew and locals alike staring, and those drunkest and angriest standing. One pulls a knife, which prompts a pirate three tables down to draw a gun, at which point your instinct to find cover kicks in.

You hear your name shouted like a curse, and an already broken vidscreen on the support column behind you explodes into burning plastic fragments, the soft-round from a boarding pistol putting it well out of its misery.

Your bodyguards respond with controlled bursts from energy weapons set to low-power, giving cover to your withdrawal. Smoke, screams, and flashes of discharge fill the bar. Stumbling outside, you see passers-by clearing out as fast as they can. A noodle stand cook gives you a frightened look as they duck behind armored shutters. There'll be no quiet business done in this bar for the shift, that much is clear.
translation:
混乱蔓延开来，船员和本地人都瞪着你，还有几个最醉的 —— 也是最愤怒的人，站了起来。有人掏出了刀子，隔着三张桌子的另一名海盗见状掏出了枪，于是你开始本能的找掩体。

你听到有人像骂脏话一样吼出你的名字，同时，你身后支撑柱上原本就坏掉了的显示屏绽成了无数燃烧着的塑料碎片，看来是谁接舷战配枪中打出的软质子弹结束了这东西的一生。

你的保镖们抬起能量武器，将发射模式调整成低功率模式，节制地开火掩护你撤离。刹那间，酒吧里充满了烟雾、尖叫、还有武器发射的闪光。你刚跌跌撞撞地跑出门，就看到街边路人都在快速逃跑，某个面条摊的厨子蹲在装甲卷帘门后面，惶恐地看了你一眼。很明显，今天酒吧里没什么能安静谈事的地方了。

"这种 '中枢' 可以追溯到 AI 圣战时代。霸主 认为清理它们 '成本太高' 了。" $HeOrShe抬起头，似乎想要引述什么，"恶将取胜，只当善因缺乏勇气，因饥肠辘辘，因四肢乏力而踌躇不前。" $personName $Rank 重新将$hisOrHer的目光投向了你，那之中充满了热情。"但教会不能坐视不管。"

"我们没有 霸主 那样的舰队，而这...在对抗那些人造恶魔的战斗中，向我们摇摆不定的盟友展示我们站在道德的制高点上是不明智的。因此，教会在充分考虑风险和你的谨慎的情况下，向你提供 $bcb_reward 星币，并希望你能在 $bcb_days 内完成这个任务。"

"One of our undercover walkers has found records long hidden by the Hegemony. They have hidden the existence of a fully functional Remnant station, or 'nexus' as the Tri-Tachyon apostates call it, some $bcb_dist light-years away, in the $bcb_systemName."

"It is truly an obscenity in the eyes of Providence that such a citadel of corruption would be left standing all these cycles since the great AI Crusades. original: "Are you sure? $TheFaction needs people it can rely on, and turning your back like this won't be easily forgotten."
translation: "你确定吗？$theFaction 信赖可靠的人，你的这种背弃不会轻易被原谅。"

original: "Do you affirm to that, citizen, and agree that your recorded affirmation stand as record of your commitment? The Hegemony needs people it can rely on, and if you were to let us down it would not soon be forgotten."
translation: "你确认吗，公民？确认就意味着你同意将辞职经历作为你档案的一部分被记录下来。霸主 需要可靠的人，如果你失信于我们，那不会轻易被原谅。"
context:

original:
"Are you sure, child of Earth? The Church of Galactic Redemption is the worldly expression of Ludd's holy teachings, the only path to salvation not only of your own soul, but the means by which all humanity may raise itself from the scourge of collective sin.

I cannot sit in judgment of your soul; the spiritual consequence of your choice is between you and the Divine. But the faithful are but women and men of these fallen worlds, and they may see in you one who has turned their back on the path of the Blessed Ludd. You would be scorned by the Faithful."
translation:
"你确定吗，地球的子民？银河救赎教会 在俗世中践行卢德的神圣教义，这是你使灵魂通往救赎的唯一道路，也是将人类摆脱万罪之罚的唯一途径。

我无权评判你的灵魂；这一抉择对你灵魂归宿的影响是神与你之间的问题。但我们的信徒只不过是委身于各个没落星球上的凡夫俗子，他们只会在你身上看到一个背弃神圣卢德之道的人。你必将接受信徒们的蔑视。"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2
文件：rules.csv
行：03618

original: "Are you certain? The League needs people like you it can rely on to uphold our principles. Although within your rights, if you leave now, less magnanimous constituents of the League may be suspicious or even vindictive at such a perceived betrayal of loyalty."
translation: "你确定吗？联盟需要你这样可靠的人来维护我们的准则。尽管你现在可以行使你的权力并选择离开。但对于这种可以被视为背叛忠诚的行为，联盟中那些不这么宽宏大量的成员可能会有所猜疑，甚至进行报复。"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2
文件：rules.csv
行：03657

original: "I hope this is not some kind of joke. Loyalty is the highest ideal of the Sindrian Diktat, as well you know. The Lion does not tolerate those who lack an iron conviction to our great movement."
translation: "我希望你知道这不是什么能开玩笑的事情。你应该很清楚，忠诚是 辛达强权 的最高思想。辛达瑞亚之狮不会容忍那些对我们的伟大运动缺乏坚定信念的人。"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2
文件：rules.csv
行：03670

original: "Are you sure? You'll be missing fantastic opportunities to advance your career; Tri-Tachyon rewards those who reward themselves, after all. And need I remind you there are those in the Company that might see this as a sign of... weakness."
translation: "您确定吗？您将会错过推动您事业发展的绝佳机会，而且公司也更看重那些懂得自我激励的人。还有我提醒您，公司里有些人可能会因此觉得您...很好欺负。"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2
文件：rules.csv
行：03644

original: "A good decision. We can use people like you."
translation: "明智的决定。你这种人值得为我们继续效力。"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2
文件：rules.csv
行：03607

original: "A good decision. Despite what dissident agitprop may claim, the Hegemony does not ask blind obedience. It takes courage to first question then choose to reaffirm a commitment. We can use people like you in this troubled age."
translation: "很好。和不同政见者所宣传的不同，霸主 并不需要盲从。提出质疑，然后再次坚定自己可以肩负身上的义务，这很需要勇气。在这个混乱的时代里，我们需要像你这样的人效力。"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2
文件：rules.csv
行：03633

original: "A wise choice. Our spirits are tested in this work we do, and sometimes our faith falters. But remember always that the light of Ludd illuminates the righteous path, however dim it may seem in times of great difficulty."
translation: "明智的抉择。在履行圣务时，我们的灵魂时常会受到考验，我们的信念不时会发生动摇。但请谨记，正义之道永远被卢德的光辉所照耀，无论它在艰难困苦之中显得多么暗淡。"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2
文件：rules.csv
行：03620

original: "I'm glad to hear you've changed your mind. The League can use people like you."
translation: "很高兴你改变主意了，联盟需要像你这样的人继续效力。"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2
文件：rules.csv
行：03659

original:
"I will be lenient and ... not ... report this serious error of judgment. I'm taking this risk because I still believe you can be a part of this great work we have been called upon to perform.

Step carefully."
translation:
"我会从宽处理，不会把这...对形势的严重误判上报上去。我冒这个险，是因为我依然相信你可以成为我们伟大事业的一部分。

务必谨慎前行。"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2
文件：rules.csv
行：03672

original: "A wise choice. Tri-Tachyon respects Valued Team Members who are willing to negotiate to maintain and, dare I say it, advance their position."
translation: "明智的选择。速子科技 尊重每一位重要的公司成员想通过谈判来巩固其职位或 —— 恕我冒昧 —— 谋求升职的意愿。"

版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2

行：03646

original: "I can see there's no changing your mind. Well, at least you had the courtesy to tender your resignation in person."

版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2

行：03606

original: "I see. At least you were brave enough to tender your resignation in person."
translation: "我明白了，至少你还有足够的勇气来亲自递交辞呈。"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2

行：03632

original: "I can see there's no changing your mind. Be wary of the path you tread, but remember that Ludd loved even those who were betrayers in that final day."
translation: "我看得出，你去意已决。在你今后所践行的道路上还请小心谨慎。但还请不要忘记，在最终之日来临时，即便是背信弃义者也能享有卢德神圣的关爱。"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2

original:
"I can see there's no changing your mind. On behalf of the League, I thank you for the service you have performed to this date and your courtesy in tendering your resignation in person.

Now if you don't mind, there are a handful of forms I need to fill out to finalize this process."
translation:
"看来你已经下定决心了。我谨代表联盟感谢你至今所做出的贡献，以及你亲自提交辞呈时的礼貌。

现在，如果你不介意的话，我需要填写一些表格来落实这个程序。"

版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2

original:
"I see all too clearly now that you have not the spine for our great work.

Begone from my comms, traitor. I shall report this to party intelligence immediately."
translation:
"我算是看清你了，你没有能担当我们伟大事业的骨气。

滚出我的通讯频道！叛徒！我会立刻向党内情报部汇报的。"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2

行：03671

original:
"I can see there's no changing your mind. Someone gave you a better offer, didn't they. No, don't say anything. I understand completely.

If they're paying that well, don't forget me if an opening comes up. In the meantime, I'd recommend you steer clear of Tri-Tachyon space for a while."
translation:
"看来我是没法挽留您了。有人给了您开出了更好的价码，对吧？不，不用说了，我都懂。

如果他们给的薪水真的那么高，到时候要是还有空缺，就别忘了我。还有，我建议您暂时先避开 速子科技 的疆域一段时间。"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2

original:
"Yes, not everyone has it in them to uphold the values of $theFaction to such a high standard. No shame in it.

Anything else I can do for you?"
translation:
"好吧，不是每个人都有能力把 $theFaction 的价值观贯彻到如此高的标准。这并不丢人。

那么，我还能为你做些什么？"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2

original:
"Yes, not everyone has the strength of character to uphold the values of the Hegemony to the standards that are required. The Sector has need of merchants and shuttle pilots, after all. Those are also honorable careers in their own small way.

Anything else I can do for you?"
translation:
"的确，不是每个人都能有坚强的人格，把挺身维护 霸主 利益的行为提升到如此高的标准。毕竟，这个星域也需要商人和穿梭机驾驶员。在他们自己的小圈子里，那也是很光荣的职业。

还有什么我可以为你做的吗？"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2
文件：rules.csv
行：03630

original:
"Indeed, not everyone is called to walk this path, beset as it is by violence, temptation, and hardship. Be not shamed to find a humbler path toward the spiritual love the Blessed Ludd has brought to our unworthy souls.   

Let me set aside the glorious and terrible to ask if there is anything else I can do for you?"
translation:
"诚然，这并不是每个人必经的修业之道，毕竟它被暴力、诱惑和困苦所充斥。圣卢德会为我们每一个卑微的灵魂都赋予他神圣的爱，或许你追寻它的道路较为谦卑，但请勿为此而感到羞耻。

让我们暂时抛开荣光与悔恨，看看现在我还能在其他方面帮上你什么吗？"
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2
文件：rules.csv
行：03617

original:
"Yes, I understand. It is dangerous work, and it requires exceptional character to uphold the ideals of the League. There is no shame in turning down this commitment; after all it is for your freedom to make this decision that we fight.

"Don't worry about it. You have a rogue scientist to track down, and on behalf of the Persean League Fleet Intelligence Service, I've said nothing to you on the subject."

He taps his nose. "Our meeting was purely a matter of routine internal affairs. Nothing out of the ordinary with the FIS coordinating on perfectly standard information-sharing with the executive representative of a member polity, don't you agree?"

Siyavong 探员双手一拍，"我想我们就此结束吧，你们常怎么说来着 —— '航行无阻'，舰长兼统领大人？"

original:
This hull is damaged, but through the scars of impacts and stripped armor your sensors officer recognizes the crest of the Galatia Academy. This expedition was lightly and inconspicuously armed, enough to discourage casual piracy while not offending the official neutrality of the Academy.

Perhaps this was not enough.

Salvage repeaters - a common feature of high-risk Academy probes and expeditions which promise a reward for return of data - are all dead. Manually disabled, overloaded and fused or even smashed with hand-tools, from the looks of it. Clearly someone did not want them transmitting their message, or any message, in this place.
translation:
这艘舰船已经受损，但从撞击的伤痕与剥落的装甲间，你的传感器技官辨认出了 Galatia 学院的徽标。此次科考队只配备了轻量且不起眼的武装，能在足以威慑普通海盗的同时不触犯学院的官方中立原则。

但或许这些武装还是有所不足。

所有打捞信号中继器 —— 高风险学院探测任务与科考队的常见配置，学院承诺对归还此物的数据者提供报酬 —— 均已失效。从痕迹判断，它们是被人为破坏的：手动关闭、过载熔毁，甚至被手用工具砸碎。显然有人不愿让它们在此地发送信息 —— 哪怕任何信息。
context:
版本：0.98-RC8 词条格式：v2
文件：rules.csv
行：00187

original:
The expedition's equipment is not the best money can buy, but the sensor suites and detector arrays were obviously lovingly modified and maintained - what's left of them, anyway. They're torn apart, twisted and burnt into jagged black filaments.

Shielded datacores are recovered by salvor teams and returned for analysis in a signal-quarantined vault kept for this purpose. It does not take long for your tech officer to report results.
translation:
科考队的设备虽然并非是顶级配置，但传感器组与探测阵列显然经过精心改装与维护 —— 至少残存部分如此。它们被撕扯得支离破碎，扭曲烧熔成参差的黑色线体。

打捞小组回收了屏蔽型数据核心，送入专为此类任务设置的信号隔离库进行分析。你的技术军官很快回报了结果。

"Judging from logs and fabrication tags, the expedition dates to circa cycle 176," your tech officer says. "This was the flagship of a small flotilla. The rest were... lost."

"Someone... tried to erase all records. Forge-reset."

"根据日志与制造标签判断，此次科考队活动时间约为星历 176 年，" 你的技术军官汇报道，"这是小型编队的旗舰。其余舰船均已... 失踪。"

There's simple deletion and there's systemic erasure done to ensure that data recovery is effectively impossible. Whoever did this was not proficient enough to do the latter.

简单的删除与系统性的擦除有本质区别 —— 后者的目的是杜绝数据恢复的可能性，而始作俑者并未精通到能执行后者的程度。

original:
Datastreams are painstakingly recovered, the high-interest combat logs prioritized by your techs. The data is lossy, and the gaps must be filled by algorithms which, used improperly, have a reputation for confidently asserting false results.

Nonetheless.

You see the black of the abyss, and the cluster of lights and icons signifying the Galatia Expedition's flotilla. The view is highly abstract, a reconstruction of a visualization necessary in not only hyperspace but the uncertain depths of the Abyss.

You speed the stream forward to the point where everything goes wrong.
translation:
数据流被艰难地复原，你的技术军官优先恢复了高价值的战斗日志。数据存在损毁，空缺部分必须由算法填补，但若使用不当，这类算法常会言之凿凿地输出错误结论。

尽管如此。

你看到深渊的黑暗，以及标示 Galatia 科考队编队的光点与图标群。视图高度抽象，这是在超空间乃至深渊不确定深处都必需的视觉重构。

你将时间流快进至一切开始崩坏的节点。

The feed is degraded, patchy. The flotilla is gone; only the flagship remains, panicked voices on ship comms, in retreat from its previous course. The timeline show a halting record of desperate damage repairs and the crews' slow realization that they cannot make it back to civilized space.

It is a death-spiral known and feared by all spacer crews.

Systems break down, fuel and supplies dwindle. Morale breaks down. Then discipline. It unravels faster than usual with so many civilians.

You shut it off.
translation:
画面时断时续且模糊不清。舰队已然溃散；仅剩旗舰，通讯频道里充斥着恐慌的语音，舰船也偏离了原定航线。时间线显示着绝望地进行紧急损伤维修的断续记录，以及船员们逐渐意识到无法返回文明星域的缓慢过程。

这是所有太空船员都熟知且恐惧的死亡螺旋。

系统逐一崩溃，燃料与补给日渐枯竭。士气瓦解，随后纪律也荡然无存。在搭载如此多平民的情况下，崩坏的速度比通常更快。

original:
This is a ship of mercenary-adventurers crewed by a colorful mix of distinct personalities from worlds representative of a broad swath of the Persean Sector.

The captain was a former officer who found himself on the losing side of minor rebellion out of the Persean League. The pilot, a racer-turned-smuggler recovered from stim addiction. Former Diktat gone renegade, present at the massacre of... scion of an Eventide officer family, overbearing mother, disowned after... the engineer, the armorer, the navigator... all irrelevant details. You skim the report faster.

You can't imagine how they managed to work together. It doesn't matter; they're all dead now.
translation:
这是一艘雇佣探险船，船员们个性迥异且出身遍布英仙座星域各个角落，而这也体现出了星域的辽阔。

舰长曾是一名军官，直到他在一场叛离英仙座联盟的小规模动乱中发现自己站在了注定会失败的一边。而驾驶员则是一名改行跑走私的竞速赛手，刚戒掉了兴奋剂药瘾。前强权叛党者，亲历过... 大屠杀的现场。来自 Eventide 军官家族的名门之后，有着强势的母亲，因为... 的原因断绝了关系。还有工程师、军械员、领航员... 全都充满了无关紧要的细节。你快速地略过了这些报告。

你无法想象他们在一起工作时的光景。但没关系；因为他们现在都死了。

original:
The outside hull is oddly pristine, as if sent on a long journey fresh from the forge without personalized outfitting and customization.

Your salvors breach the exterior and find a different story: crudely anchored power conduits and coolant tubes have been rigged haphazardly through the shafts and corridors of the ship. Safety doors are stuck open and hatches cut through to provide access to serpentine bundles of cable. It's not high-quality work; the occasional powered-down maintenance drone, stupid automatic things meant to assist human technicians, suggests the obvious culprits.

Your salvors must make numerous cuts to clear access to core ship systems. It is not dangerous, merely inconvenient. It is near the true centerpoint of the hull volume that they find a trio of AI cores, two gammas and a beta from the looks of the casings. They are unpowered, the coolant congealed in its pipes.
translation:
外部船体看上去崭新的出奇，好似该舰从工厂出炉即开始了一次远行，完全没有任何个人化配装和改造的痕迹。

你的打捞员们破开了外壳后所见的场景则大有不同：粗糙地固定住的导管和冷凝液管道危险地穿插在舰船的通道之中。安全门被卡开，舱门被切割以让如长蛇般的缆线穿过。这不是什么精工细活；偶尔能发现一些现已关机的维护机器人，这些为了辅助人类技师而制作的愚笨自动机械暗示了这一切的始作俑者。

你的打捞员必须做出一系列切割方能接触到舰船的核心系统。这并不危险，但很不方便。最终在舰船船体的真正中心点，他们发现了三个 AI 核心。从外壳来看，是两个 Gamma 核心和一个 Beta 核心。它们都没有链接能源，且它们的导管充满了凝结的冷凝液。

The only body found aboard is the former captain, sitting at his command console, desiccated eyes fixed ahead at the suffocating nothingness of deep space.

Behind the CIC, in the armored computer center, there is a Tri-Tachyon manufactured AI core interface. Just sitting there unassuming out in the open, a perfectly casual commercial hardware installation. This dates the ship back further, to before the AI Wars.

No core lies in the cradle, however. Perhaps it was taken when the ship was abandoned.
translation:
船舱内唯一找到的尸体是坐在控制台上的前舰长，他干涸的眼睛凝视着前方令人窒息的，一片虚无的深空。

在作战信息中心后面，武装计算机中心中，有一个速子科技制造的 AI 核心接口。它就那么静静地裸露着，像一个随处可见的商用硬件装置。这表明这艘船的历史可以追溯很早以前，乃至 AI 战争之前。

original:
As your salvor teams breach the hull, they discover tell-tale signs of a pirate crew: prominently-displayed hand weapons, decor as bold and brutal as it is unsophisticated - skulls and blood-red predominate, and signs of lackadaisical maintenance performed on the less interesting ship systems.

It is not a tomb-ship, however. 

By numbers, most of the crew appears to have escaped before leaving the hull derelict. A few unfortunate victims of personal violence - or parts of them - appear to have been left behind from some kind of internal conflict. The cycles since were not kind to what remained as the life support systems slowly failed.
translation:
当你的打捞小队破开船体时，他们发现了大量明显属于海盗船员的痕迹：显眼的手持武器，以骷髅头和血红色色调为主，粗犷而野蛮的装饰风格，还有舰船次要系统维护不善的痕迹。

然而，这艘舰船并非是一艘 "坟墓船"。

从数字上看，大多数船员似乎在船只被遗弃之前就已逃离。过程中一些不幸的受害者似乎因内部冲突而被抛弃，而随着生命支持系统逐渐失效，他们彻底陷入了水深火热之中。

original:
A cursory trawl of what logs the senior officers bothered to keep suggests that this ship was part of a small pirate flotilla tracking a well-supplied independent expedition working its way through the outer fringe. That expedition spotted the pirates, then burned rapidly toward the Abyss. The pirates followed and soon lost their prey in the stultifying darkness.

With supplies and fuel dwindling and no certainty of a 'hostile resupply', the pirate leadership began to argue, and then to scrap hulls while consolidating crew onto the remaining ships - at the barrel of a gun, as necessary.

There wasn't quite enough room for everyone, it appears.
translation:
粗略浏览了上级军官们记录的日志之后，可以发现这艘舰船属于一个小型海盗舰队，当时他们正在追踪一支在边缘星区航行的，补给充足的独立探险队。当探险队发现了海盗后，他们迅速驶向深渊超空间。海盗尾随而至，但很快就在无穷无尽的黑暗中失去了目标。

随着补给和燃料的减少，猎物却迟迟不见踪影，海盗头子们之间开始了内讧。直到不得不开始拆船，将船员集中到剩余的船上 —— 必要时使用暴力的方式。

不过似乎，他们没有足够的空间容纳所有人。

original:
A search reveals that this is, or rather was, a Tri-Tachyon flagged vessel. 

The crew is dead. What's left of the young executive with lead authority over the operation is still in his luxuriously outfitted personal cabin; such incidents involving the untimely discharge of an engineering-grade plasma cutter are not unknown in poorly managed repair docks, but when they occur in a ship's executive suite, pointed questions are raised.

The last survivor, suited against the apparent life support failure, is found near the jury-rigged power generator that was spliced into the ship's shield-grid. The suit's safeties were overridden and its atmo mix of oxygen reduced to zero.

It would have been a painless slide into unconsciousness and, soon enough, death.
translation:
经一番搜寻后得知，这艘船是，或者说曾经是，一艘隶属于 速子科技 的船只。

所有船员都已死去。业务主管级的年轻执行官的残躯仍然留在他装修奢华的私人舱室里。这类涉及工程级等离子切割器意外发射的事故在管理不善的修理码头上并不少见，但这些事故发生在一艘舰船的执行官套房里，那就是个大问题了。

活到最后的那个人被发现于那台接入了舰船护盾电网的应急发电机附近，显然是为了抵抗失效的维生系统而穿着太空服。太空服的安全装置遭到了强行控制，呼吸空气中的氧气含量被降低到了零。

那应该会在不知不觉中就毫无痛苦地失去意识，继而很快走向死亡。

original:
"Hmm, history is not all the study of 'great leaders', but one can't help but admire a narrative of glorious victory, hubris, and ignominious end. Philip Andrada, for instance."

$HisOrHer gaze drifts into the past as $heOrShe speaks, "I remember like it was yesterday. He embodied all that was proud and good in the Hegemony. Practically deified on every holo following his defeat of the Warlord Loke. Oh, how we celebrated at that news! It was the vanquishing of chaos itself, the dawn of a new golden age. So it felt, once."

"His turn wounded us," $heOrShe says softly. "It wounded the Hegemony itself, very deeply." $HeOrShe nods to $himOrHerself, drifting back into some old memory.
translation:
"嗯，历史并非仅仅是对 '伟大领袖' 的研究，但那些关于辉煌胜利、傲慢骄纵，最终身败名裂的故事，总是令人不禁心驰神往。比如 Philip Andrada。"

$heOrShe一边说着，目光一边飘向了遥远的过去，"我至今记忆犹新，清晰地仿佛就发生在昨天。他曾是 霸主 的骄傲与一切良善品质的化身。在击败军阀 Loke 之后，几乎所有的全息影像都将他奉若神明。哦，当初我们听到这个消息时，是何等地欢欣鼓舞！那仿佛代表我们已经彻底战胜混乱，迎来了一个崭新黄金时代的曙光。至少当时我们是这样的感觉。"

"他的背叛刺痛了我们，" $heOrShe轻声说道，"也深深地刺痛了 霸主。" $HeOrShe若有所思地点了点头，又陷入了某些旧日的回忆之中。

"The contemporary form of the Church of Galactic Redemption has proven remarkably stable in spite of, or perhaps because of, the chaotic political arrangement of the Persean Sector immediately post-Collapse."

The historian cradles $hisOrHer hands, unconsciously repeating the old motions of lecturing.

"The Holy Ecumene Council of Archcurates rule on matters of canon, authorize and delegate executive functions, and perform certain exclusive sacraments. However they may be censured and even laicized by a supermajority of the Curates-popular! The members holding those more common positions are ratified by local congregations but must be ordained by an Archcurate in good standing."

$HeOrShe sips some tea, then frowns and looks at $hisOrHer cup as if the tea had gone unexpectedly cold. "Of course, it's rather more complicated than just that in practice..."
translation:
"银河救赎教会 的组织形式展现出非凡的稳定性，尽管英仙座星域在大崩塌后初期经历了混乱的政治格局 —— 但或许，正是这种混乱反而成就了它的稳定。"

历史学家将$hisOrHer的双手交叠，无意识地重复着过去讲课时的习惯性动作。

"圣枢机议廷负责对教规教义问题做出裁决，授权并委派行政管理职能，以及举行某些专属的圣礼。然而，他们也可能受到绝大多数 '大众神职人员' 的谴责，甚至被解除圣职！担任那些较低层级职位的人员虽由地方教会批准，但圣职必须由一位资格完备的枢机主教授予。"

$HeOrShe啜了一口茶，随即皱起眉头，看向$hisOrHer的茶杯，仿佛意外地发现茶水已经变凉了。"当然，在实践中，情况远比这要复杂得多..."

original:
"There are those among the Church of Galactic Redemption - the Luddics, in popular parlance - who hold that the Knights of Ludd are an aberration at odds with the original Luddic vision of the Church. Doubtless true," the historian raises $hisOrHer eyebrows at this small heresy. "An examination of what are agreed by scholars to be among the more authentic passages of the Book of Ludd suggest that themes of militancy and 'a knighthood of the faith' are likely intended as abstract references to a sort of semi-sacral militant volunteerism which would range in practice from a civic protest movement all the way to, arguably, insurrectionism."

"The practical benefit of a standing militant order during the Post-Collapse chaos and following wars must be admitted, however," $heOrShe leans back in $hisOrHer seat, contemplative. "And the most vocal objectors within the Church proper argue that the Knights err by degree rather than in whole. The less vocal objectors? Well, we may not know their thoughts for many, many cycles indeed. The Knights see to that."
translation:
"银河救赎教会的各教众 —— 简单点说，就是那群卢德教徒们 —— 竟然拥有卢德骑士团，简直背离了教会最初的教旨。这一看法无疑属实，" 历史学家在提到这一小小的异端思想时挑了挑眉，"学者们公认卢德之书中较为可信的段落表明，武装斗争性和 '信仰骑士团' 的主题可能是对一种半神圣武装志愿主义的抽象指涉，其现实形态本应涵盖从公民抗议运动到 —— 甚至于可以是 —— 叛乱活动。"

"但必须承认，在大崩塌后的混乱以及随后的战争中，一个常备的军事组织具有现实意义的实用价值，" $heOrShe靠回自己的座位上，陷入了沉思，"就连教会内部最直言不讳的反对者也只敢指责骑士团的存在只是路线的些许偏差，而非本质性错误。至于那些沉默的异议者？嗯，我们可能在许多、许多个星历年内都没办法知道他们的想法。骑士团自会把事情料理周全。"

"It is speculated that Admiral Andrada, the self-anointed Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat - or 'Sindrian Mutiny' per the Hegemony viewpoint - is facing a dictator's all-too-common problem of succession. Until now, behind the unified facade of the Diktat, it appears that he has played his major supporters off one another to maintain political stability. Declaring a clear successor would have disrupted this internal balance." 

"And now," the historian speaks slowly, rubbing $hisOrHer chin, "with the cycles' inevitable turn and Andrada in rumored poor health, will he make a surprise announcement to designate an heir? There would be a wave of arrests and, dare I say, executions as those loyal and disloyal to the Executor-apparent are... sorted."

"Or perhaps Andrada has a secret family, or a mind-simulation, or a clone, or some wilder scheme?" $HeOrShe barks a laugh. "Speculation on this point seems to say as much about the speculator as about anything Andrada is thinking. I should ask you for some insight!" $HeOrShe laughs again.
translation:
"据推测，海军上将 Andrada ，即 辛达强权 —— 从 霸主 视角应该称之为 '辛达乱军' 的自封 最高元首，正面临着独裁者普遍面临的继承问题。迄今为止，他始终在辛达统一的外表之下挑动主要支持者相互制衡来维持政局稳定。明确指定继承人必将打破这种微妙平衡。" 

"而现在，" 历史学家摩挲着$hisOrHer的下巴，缓缓说道，"随着岁月的无情流逝，加上 Andrada 据传身体状况不佳，他会突然指定一个继承人吗？届时应该会爆发一波抓捕事件，我敢肯定，那些人将根据对元首的忠诚与否而...归类，以此决定是否处决。"

"又或者 Andrada 还藏着秘密家族、思维模拟体、克隆人，再或者其他什么更疯狂的方案？" $HeOrShe大笑一声，"对此事的猜测往往更多反映出揣测者自身的立场，而非 Andrada 的真实想法。真该问问你有什么看法！" $HeOrShe又笑了起来。

original:
"If Philip Andrada, the self-anointed Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat, were the strategic mastermind he was claimed to be - first by Hegemony propaganda and then his own - then why then did he not simply sweep the Persean Sector in a conquest to rival his greatest vanquished foe, the Warlord Loke?"

"Well!" The historian raises a finger like an orator, then, thinking better of it, lets $hisOrHer hand drop to the table. "Matters abound! Andrada took a portion - but only a portion - of the Hegemony navy in the course of his mutiny. He took possession of the Askonia system and was immediately faced with the catastrophic consequences of the Opis incident, ongoing rebellion, complete lack of logistics, and the pressing need to maintain a credible military force against a vengeful Hegemony. And, indeed, all of this while fulfilling the expectations of key supporters!" 

"The true testament to Andrada's genius may well lie in his scheme not immediately collapsing in upon itself!"
translation:
"如果 Philip Andrada，这位自封的 辛达强权 最高元首，真的如 霸主 宣传和他自己所声称的那般算无遗策，那么他为何没有直接横扫英仙座星域，成就堪比其最强手下败将军阀 Loke 那般的征服伟业？"

"问的好！" 历史学家像演说家一样举起一根手指，但转念一想，又把$hisOrHer的手放回了桌子上。"原因当然很多！Andrada 在叛乱过程中仅裹挟了 霸主 海军的部分力量。他虽然占据了 Askonia，却必须立刻面对 Opis 事件的灾难性余波、此起彼伏的叛乱、彻底崩坏的补给体系，同时还迫切需要继续维持一支可靠的军事力量，用以对抗复仇心切的 霸主 —— 当然，在做好这一切的同时，他还要满足关键支持者们的期望！" 

"如此说来，反倒是 辛达强权 这套国家架构没有迅速崩溃，才真的说明 Andrada 是个天才！"

original:
"The culture of transient interstellar starship crew and infrastructure workers - "spacers", if you like - has become particularized in the era post-Collapse. Rather than existing in vast diffusion across the Human Domain as a mere statistical category, impossibly detached and undistinguished, they've been localized to the Persean Sector and now form a critical mass of intra-cultural contact out of which distinct commonalities arise."

$HeOrShe takes a moment to catch $hisOrHer breath before proceeding. "Indeed, the majority of interstellar logistics have shifted from Gate to hyperspace journeys. Spacers bear everyday witness now to the ruins of the Collapse and AI Wars. These journeys are haunted," $heOrShe takes on a jovially grim tone. "Haunted, one might say, by history. Indeed, one might suggest that Spacer culture has become quite superstitious in the last two hundred cycles."

$HeOrShe trails off, letting a breath go, looking upward toward unseen stars. "The great dark filled with death and mystery as never before," $heOrShe says, quoting something.
translation:
"在大崩塌后的时代，星舰船员和相关基础设施从业者 —— 如果你愿意的话，可以称之为 '宇宙民' —— 的文化已经变得独具特色。他们不再仅仅作为 人之领 中一个庞大而分散、难以捉摸且毫无特色的统计学概念而存在，而是扎根于英仙座星域，现在已经形成了一个关键的文化内部交流群体，从中涌现出了独特的共性。"

$HeOrShe稍微停顿了一下，调整了下自己的呼吸，然后继续说道："事实上，星际物流的主要存在形式已经从星门改为了超空间航道。这些太空佬现在每天都在目睹大崩塌和 AI 战争的废墟。这些航程，" $heOrShe用一种既愉快又阴郁的语气说道，"可以说，是被历史的幽灵纠缠着。事实上，有人可能会认为，在过去的两百年里，宇宙民文化已经变得相当迷信。"

$HeOrShe渐渐停了下来，呼出一口气，抬头望向看不见的星辰。"前所未有的黑暗，充斥着死亡与神秘。" $heOrShe引用着某句名言。

"Old Mairaath, the center of the old Mayasuran stellar polity, was primed to blossom as a shining beacon of culture and civilization in the Persean Sector, a light to outshine Opis perhaps, once the terraforming came into true fruition."

"Both those lights are extinguished, now," the historian says gloomily. "I suppose they lacked the hard-hearted military-industrial alignment of the Hegemony's Eventide-Chicomoztoc axis, to say nothing of Kazeron and its League. And so on, for the rest of them."

"The worst of us thrive in these violent times, it seems." $HeOrShe seems to realize in the moment who $heOrShe is speaking to and adds, without conviction, "Uh, present company excluded, of course."
translation:
"古老的 Mairaath，古老 Mayasura 政权的中心，本应以文明灯塔的形式在英仙座星域绽放出文化与文明的光辉，假如它的地貌改造工作顺利完成，其光芒将比 Opis 还要耀眼。"

"但现在，这两盏 '明灯' 都已经熄灭了，" 历史学家阴郁地说道，"我想，它们缺乏霸主 Eventide-Chicomoztoc 轴心那种冷酷无情的军事工业联盟，更不用说 Kazeron 及 英仙座联盟 了。其他的政权也大都如此。"

"看来，在这种暴力时代，我们之中最糟糕的那部分反而更能茁壮成长。" $HeOrShe似乎突然意识到自己在和谁说话，于是毫无说服力地补充道，"呃，当然，不包括在场的各位。"

"What precisely the Hegemony does with the 'forbidden' AI confiscated by its technological inspectors, particularly during the post-AI Wars crackdowns, is not - yet - a matter of historical record. And unlikely to ever be, if COMSEC has their way," $heOrShe says bitterly. 

"Obviously," $heOrShe continues, "the Hegemony is more conservative in exploitation of AI relative to the Domain at its height. The grumblings of the Luddic population ring loud in any Hegemon's ears, and Baikal Daud knows better than to spark unrest under the present peace-of-compromise."

"Now that said," the historian leans closer, lowering $hisOrHer voice, "The paranoid provide entertaining speculations. One theory tells of secret overminds hidden in far-off planetoids simulating worlds which hold in thrall the minds of billions of bio-suspended human slaves; cruel scenarios playing out in the sick imagination of uncaring AI-gods. Nonsense, of course," $heOrShe smiles reassuringly. "What purpose would such mistreatment serve?"
translation:
"霸主 的技术检查员没收的 '违禁' AI，特别是 AI 战争后各类镇压行动中没收的 AI，到底被用来做了什么，目前没有 —— 还没有 —— 准确的记录。如果 COMSEC 能如愿以偿的话，可能永远也不会有历史记录。" $heOrShe苦涩地说道。

"显而易见，" $heOrShe继续说道，"与鼎盛时期的 人之领 相比，霸主 在利用 AI 方面更为保守。卢德派民众的抱怨声在每一任至高霸主的耳边都响个不停，而 Baikal Daud 深知在当前的妥协和平之下，最好不要激起任何动荡。"

"话虽如此，" 历史学家身体前倾，压低了$hisOrHer的声音，"妄想者们还是提供了有趣的猜测。有一种理论认为，在遥远的行星小天体上隐藏着秘密的超级计算机，它们模拟着世界，并将数十亿进行冷冻休眠的人类思想置于奴役之下；这疯狂的猜测还认为冷漠的 AI 之神会让各类残酷场景在其中上演。当然，这是无稽之谈，" $heOrShe的微笑显得十分宽慰，"这种虐待有什么意义呢？"

original:
"Those who awake from cryosleep who were laid to rest in the time of the Domain are perhaps the most lost of all. Many, though not all, imagined they would populate the far end of a rich frontier; they accepted that they would leave behind all they once knew. Now they all find themselves cut loose from all reference, unmoored in history."

"And who is to care for them? Certainly the Luddics suggest the comfort of their religion. Others take up drink or drugs, or nihilistic detachment which too-often spills outward into destruction. Not a few of the most brutal pirates are former sleepers, you know."

"Where records persist, sleepers who are uniquely skilled are sometimes... recruited, drafted - 'kidnapped' is perhaps the word - by parties seeking insight into some old tech or lost secrets." A troubled look crosses $hisOrHer face. "I admit that if I could, I would arrange for the systematic interview of the sleepers. They would prove an excellent resource to our pre-Collapse histories, provided we keep a realistic understanding of the limitations of first-hand sources."
translation:
"那些在 人之领 时代进入低温休眠，并在如今醒来的人，可能是最迷茫的一群人。他们中的许多人，尽管不是全部，都幻想过自己会成为富饶边疆的开拓者；他们接受了告别过往熟知世界的命运。但现在，他们发现自己甚至被斩断了所有参照系，在历史的长河中漂泊无依。"

"又有谁能来关怀他们呢？卢德教会 当然会建议他们寻求宗教的慰藉。另一些人沉溺于酒精或毒品，亦或者陷入虚无主义的疏离，这种心态往往会外溢为破坏行径。你知道吗，不少最残暴的海盗都曾是低温休眠者。"

"在有档案尚存的区域，拥有独特技能的休眠者有时会被...招募、强征 —— 或许 '绑架' 这个词更准确 —— 被某些渴望破解古代科技或失落机密的势力掳走。" $hisOrHer的脸上掠过一丝忧虑。"我承认，如果我能做到的话，我会系统性地安排对休眠者的采访。只要我们对一手史料的局限性保持清醒认知，他们将成为研究大崩塌前历史的珍贵资源。"

"I find myself with a growing affinity for the developing itinerant spacer culture," $heOrShe gestures to the patrons around you. "They have developed a colorful milieu, worldview, and even a shared mythology."

Has hyperspace become more chaotic, mysterious; inhabited, almost, by alien phenomena? Or was it simply unobserved, or unreported before? Or were the reports suppressed? Or was there simply not enough intra-spacer contact to reinforce their observations - or shall we put it, for the skeptical -  these shared narrative projections?"

"I am a mere historian and, now," $heOrShe smiles sadly, "I am bereft of the corrective presence of my colleagues in the Academy. I both fear and admit that my documentation efforts might appear to drift toward dilettantism."

"我发现自己越来越喜欢新兴的流浪太空佬文化了，" $heOrShe向你周围的顾客比划了一下，"他们发展出了丰富多彩的​社会环境​​、世界观，甚至共通的神话体系。"

"不过，" $heOrShe身体前倾，"就我个人而言，我不禁怀疑自从大崩塌以来，是否宇宙本身发生了某种本质变化。超空间是否变得更加混乱、神秘，仿佛被陌生的现象所占据？还是说这些现象本就存在，只是从前未被观测或未被记录？亦或是相关报告以前遭到限制？又或者，当时的流动太空佬之间的接触不够频繁，缺乏足够交流来印证彼此的观察 —— 或者，对于怀疑论者来说 —— 仅仅是虚假故事的集体叙事投射？"

original:
"Ah, the tragedy of Opis. The sheer scale of loss is incomprehensible to the mind. To this day there are those who fight and kill over the finer points of whose fault it was. I have my position, but that argument over-dominates the story of the Opisean polity itself. Why should those countless dead be defined by their murderer? I find that the beginning of a story is necessary to illuminate the end, don't you agree?"

$HeOrShe doesn't wait for an answer, but begins to lecture. "Opis was a center of population, of art and commerce. Not heavy industry as-such, however - that they exported to Sindria; and agriculture, to Volturn. Out of sight, out of mind. The rulers of the Chartery of Opis grew to see little need in appeasing any but their local patronage networks. Wealth flowed to the center, where influence coagulated; the edges were forgotten."

translation:

original:
Your sensors officer and analysis team perform a thorough scan of the coordinates given to you by Nile Virens.

The location is a lightly populated, poorly developed rural zone on the far fringe of one of the more unremarkable Luddic-majority settlements. The land is nearly barren and bereft of valuable mineral deposits.

Orbital imaging shows a small, struggling farmstead close to the coordinates given. An individual human appears to be present, though it would require observation over a greater time period to fully establish an accurate count of inhabitants. There are also what appear to be a collection of burial sites near the farmstead.

"At least," your sensors officer reports, "that's what it appears to be. Weapons, people; many things can be hidden. Especially with the interference caused by this magnetic field..."
translation:
你的传感器技官与分析小组对 Nile Virens 提供的坐标进行了彻底地扫描。

目标地点位于一个不起眼的卢德聚集地边缘，是一个人口稀少而未被开化的农业区。这是片不毛之地，几乎没有有价值的矿物资源。

Bornanew takes Jaspis' small, frail hand in his own.

"Yes, of course. Please, Mother Sophronia, you must not get too excited. It is just me, and I have caused you much distress."

"Yes and truly, " she says, shaking Bornanew off. "And for it you've already decided to undergo some senseless display of penance, I doubt not. An unseemly habit learnt from the Knights."

"Captain," she turns toward you. "You must grow tired of this, so I shall be succinct: you have my deepest gratitude. My secretary shall see that you receive your payment."

"舰长。" 她转向了你，"你一定听烦了，所以我就简洁些：我向你致以最深切的谢意。我的秘书会确保你拿到报酬的。"

original:
Finding a body to substitute for Bornanew is not difficult. One that appears to have died a violent death, but at least a quick death?

Shot in the back by a Pather seems likely, but too dramatic. An accident, then; even easier. A thruster malfunction at the docks. Over in a split second, and no one really to blame except slipshod safety/control measures. One of those unhappy little events that Providence provides to bring an unexpected end to the path of life... and which burns away obvious identifying features.

The Reverend Archcurate will accept a closed-casket burial, you think.
translation:
找具尸体来代替 Bornanew 倒也不难。比如一具看起来痛快地死于非命的尸体？

一具被左径分子从背后射杀的尸体倒是挺可信，但太张扬了。伪装成意外会更加简单，比如船坞或者是喷气机故障。这样的事故只需要一瞬间，完全可以把这口黑锅扣在马虎的安保措施头上。这正是上天意想终结一条生命时会用到的小事故...也刚好能烧尽所有能够清晰辨明受害人身份的特征。

你觉得宗师大人也不会太在意棺材里躺的究竟是谁。

"It is said that Brother Cotton hears the song of the angels, the whisper of pneuma itself. It is not for human ears, they say." $HeOrShe looks away wistfully, "He is like a prophet of old; touched by the divine."

Putting $hisOrHer hands together, the Pather goes on for some time about how wonderful Brother Cotton is, and how we should all follow his example and be so blessed.

original:
The lead guard does a quick one-two knock on the doors and they swing open. 

The air is cool, the walls hung with cloth woven in bright patterns; wooden furniture prevails. A clean, earthy scent hangs in the air. You are overcome by a sense of ancient wealth - entirely underwhelming compared to the palaces of Eventide or a Tri-Tachyon executive's chateau, but here, you can tell that every object, every surface, has been transformed by the hand and muscle of human beings alone.

You are led up stairs - wooden, creaking unsettlingly - to a room overlooking an interior courtyard garden. The silhouette of a man stirs at your presence.
translation:
领头的守卫快速敲了两下门，门开了。

空气凉爽，墙壁上挂着织有鲜艳图案的布；满眼都是木制家具。空气中弥漫着清新的泥土香味。一种古老的财富感震慑了你 —— 虽然与 Eventide 的宫殿或速子科技高管的庄园相比起来平淡无奇，但你可以看出，这里的每个物体和每个平面，都仅由人类用的双手和肌肉所造就。

你被引上楼梯 —— 木制，噶吱作响 —— 来到一间能俯瞰内部庭院的房间。一个男人的轮廓因你的出现动了起来。

original:
"I felt you would not wish to hear of 'the Path'. But if you wish, I will tell you briefly of the Path."

He looks down, frowning. "The Path is not all alike. In some places, the Path provides something that nothing else will. Not Kazeron, not the Hegemony, certainly not the Mazalot Unification Authority."

He looks up, changed; there is a sad fervor in his eyes that you did not see before. "We were lost. And then the Word found us. Ludd's message shines bright in the dark of space, in the shadow of the powerful. Not even the Church can contain it."

"THAT is the Path." He nearly shouts, standing. Then takes a deep breath, and a moment to smooth his fine clothing.
translation:
"我不觉得你真的想了解 '卢德之道'。但是如果你想的话，我可以简单地向你介绍介绍。"

他皱起眉头，垂下脑袋。"每个人的卢德之道都并非一致，卢德之道展现了常人所不能及之物。这些东西 Kazeron 给不了你，霸主 给不了你，Mazalot 统一政权自然也给不了你。"

他抬起头，表情快速变化，那是一种你从未见过的，既狂热又哀伤的眼神。"我们曾经迷失。然后，'卢德之道' 找到了我们。在漆黑的太空中，在强权的阴影下，卢德的教诲振聋发聩，就连教会也不足以容纳其万一。"

"那，就是卢德之道。" 他几乎是站着喊出来的，随即深深地吸了一口气，顺了顺身上精致的衣服。

original:
He takes the datapad and manipulates the digital map with skill born of familiarity.

After but a moment, he pushes the datapad back across the table to you. A marker has been set on a blur outside of a minor settlement in the southern hemisphere; some homestead. The Luddic settlers did not see fit to submit their names to the Mazalot Unification Authority's survey, so it is named only by a code assigned by a software interpreter.

"That is where he went after we spoke. My watchers in the transport hub have not seen him leave the municipality," he shrugs at this; there are other modes of transport, of course.

"You should speak with Bornanew."
translation:
他接过了数据平板，随后熟练地操作起了数字地图。

片刻之后，他把数据平板推给了桌对面的你。标记落在了南半球一个小聚落旁的模糊地区上；是一座家宅。当地的卢德住民没把名字写进 Mazalot 统一政权的调查里，所以这一块只用了一串软件助手生成的代码表示。

"我们谈过后，他就去了这里。我安排在交通枢纽的监视员从没见到他离开过这个市区。" 对此他嗤之以鼻；显然还有很多其他的移动方式。

"你去和 Bornanew 聊聊吧。"

"If I didn't bring you in now, it seems you'd ask everyone in the system about Jethro Bornanew, about the Luddic Path, and ultimately, about me." 

"You are blessedly persistent," he smiles indulgently. "Dangerously persistent, if left to your devices, I suspect. Others would ask why you're asking. The MUA would ask why you're asking. Too much of this asking, asking, asking. It upsets delicate things."

As he speaks, he reaches out and almost, but not quite, touches the fine teapot. He seems to realize what he is doing and pulls back.

"The false prophet who, who seduced us - his proclamations became bizarre. Unreasonable. Impious. He grew wroth at any questioning, claiming the angels commanded him, and then. Um."

"There was an accident." $PersonRank $PersonName looks aside, avoiding the gaze of the comms, "He is... I pray that his restless spirit might find a peace now which it did not know in life."

"发生了一起事故。" $PersonRank $PersonName 看向一边，避开通讯设备的摄像头，"他被...我祈祷他不安的灵魂现在能找到生前从未有过的安宁。"

original:
Your officers were conservative in planning, crafting an imaginative tactical scenario which assumed the pirates possess all sorts of armaments and preparation which, in the end, they did not: anti-armor capability, a drone recon network, sentry turrets, field fortifications, and finally an EW-proof ghost gun ambush.

In the end, the operation is a simple matter of cutting the lights then punching through flimsy shelter walls to stun-round those few pirates with live firearms detected and flagged by the marines' personal combat radar.

They missed the hand-made bomb, however.
translation:
你的军官们做了慎密的筹划，精心考虑了一整套天马行空的战术情景，假设海盗持有各类武装且防备周密。然而到头来，他们什么都没有，没有反装甲能力，无人机侦察网络，哨戒炮台，阵地工事，更没有什么免疫电子战的土制枪械伏击。

到头来，这次行动只是简单地掐断灯火之后从藏身处薄弱的外墙开洞进去，接着给陆战队员个人战斗雷达探出来的少数几个持有火器的海盗喂点震撼弹。

但是他们还真没料到那个土炸弹。

original:
"Ah, Ormon Fenius. Fenius the Outcast, he's called. The slimiest piece of trash that ever oozed from the mud of..."

$HeOrShe pauses, thoughtfully. "Come to think of it, I dunno where he's from. Somewhere awful where everyone lies, cheats, and steals from one another, probably."

At this, $heOrShe looks around, "'Course there's properly done lying, cheating, and stealing. Quite acceptable, using one's own wits to win a prize through clever work," $heOrShe thumps $hisOrHer chest, "That's my trade, it is! Cleverness and craft. Not like Fenius."
translation:
"啊，那货叫 Ormon Fenius，也有的叫他浪子 Fenius 什么的。他这种最最下贱的垃圾崽种肯定是从..."

$HeOrShe说着说着突然停下了，好像在想着什么："这么一想，我还真不知道这崽种从哪片烂泥塘子爬出来的，多半也不是啥好地方，得是那种所有人都互相撒谎、行骗、盗窃的地方。"

说完这一句，$heOrShe又向四周张望了一下："自然，撒谎行骗盗窃啥的也不是坏事，这种事也有正当的，毕竟也是用聪明才智获得收入的一种手段嘛。" $heOrShe顺势拍了下$hisOrHer自己的胸口，"对咯！我也是干这行的，不过我用的是自己的聪明才智，和 Fenius 那个崽种可不一样。"

original:
"Fenius, why he'll lie, cheat, and steal for anything, from anyone. The man has no honor! And, and," the pirate is getting worked up, standing to shout, "He's no fun!"

No fun. The worst of crimes.

The pirate sits, calming down. "He let us land so we could get Marlowe's stash, then blasted our ships from orbit and took off. One reactor went critical, the other... well, just failed. But the previous, ah, owner of my ship thought to have survival equipment. So here we are."
translation:
"Fenius 这货，为啥不管见了谁都是撒谎、行骗、盗窃？就因为他没有荣耀可言！他还，他还..." 海盗说着说着渐渐兴奋起来，大喊着直接站了起来，"他还没意思！"

没意思，那可还真是个大罪。

海盗终于坐了下来，冷静了一些："那崽种让我们在这降落，说这里就能找到 Marlowe 的财宝，然后他自己从轨道上对我们的船一通猛射，之后脚底一抹油，溜了。我们一个反应堆临界了，另一个...就，直接报废了。但我这艘船的，啊，上一任主人考虑周全，给我们留了生存装备，这才让我们挨到了现在。"

original:
"Ah, Old Marlowe!" The pirate gets almost misty eyed, "Now there was a pirate. He could drink! Oh, how he drank. And fight! Bloodthirsty, he was, would shoot you in the front, back, side - any direction he could get. Whatever it took to win."

"Well, he weren't exactly a nice man. And when he gambled, he cheated. Oh, how he cheated! A sight to see, I tell you. Anyway, eventually he cheated the wrong mark and," $heOrShe makes a gun-shape with $hisOrHer hand and motions firing it, making a wet noise. $HeOrShe uses the other hand to indicate a generous volume of splatter from the exit wound, if you're interpreting the body language correctly.
translation:
"啊，老 Marlowe 诶！" 对面的海盗眼里瞬间泛起泪光，"那才叫真正的海盗。他那酒量简直绝了！哦，你是不知道他多能喝。他还很能打！那个嗜血狂魔，管你过来是正面、背面还是侧面，只要抓住机会他就往死里开枪。为了能赢，他什么招都使得出来。"

"其实吧，他确实不算什么好人。只要一下注，他就耍赖出千。绝了，真不知道他哪来那么多出千招数！我就跟你讲，他出千，绝了。可怎么说呢，他最后到底是坑错了人，然后嘛..." $heOrShe一只手比成枪做了个开火的动作，嘴里配合着发出吧唧一声，用另一只手比划出那人被射了个对穿，血肉飞溅的场面，如果你没理解错这一通肢体语言的话。

original:
The leader of the pilgrims you have transported from $lpt_sourceName insists on having the 'excellent captain' see $lpt_hisOrHer group off.

"You should visit the shrine, captain," $lpt_heOrShe insists. "I was once an unbeliever; the experience is quite transformational."

"Of course, I understand that this is a journey you must choose to undertake for yourself." $lpt_HeOrShe flashes a perfect smile and makes a pious gesture, then offloads to a private shuttle $lpt_heOrShe has hired to transport $lpt_himOrHer and $lpt_hisOrHer party to the shrine.
translation:
你从 $lpt_sourceName 带来的朝圣者的领头人非要 "杰出的舰长" 来为他们送行。

"你应该去看看圣地，舰长。" $lpt_hisOrHer坚持道。"我也曾是个无信者；那是段脱胎换骨的体验。"

"当然，我也知道这是个必须由你自己选择去行的旅道。" $lpt_HeOrShe做着虔诚的手势，一边露出了一个完美的微笑，然后搭上了$lpt_HeOrShe为他们一行雇来送他们去圣地的私人穿梭机。

"Submit and repent! Your use of sinful technologies may be forgiven, for a tithe of $entity.LP_titheDGS credits.

Resist, and only God's holy vacuum will show you mercy."

"Servant of Moloch! Redemption is not out of reach even for you. A tithe of $entity.LP_titheDGS credits may set you upon the first step of the Path of Ludd."

original:
You prove yourself worthy of association by partaking in a round of 'Atmo Drops', a drink centered around consuming eye-watering liquor as quickly as possible.

The mercs are drunk, for sure, but composed enough to speak around the details of why they're being investigated by local authorities.

After a couple of the mercs head up to order a round of 'Orbital Bombardments' their leader pulls you aside and sketches out a proposal. "We've got $motr_numberOfMarines suits, experienced operators. We can fight in vac or atmo, one to five gee." He smirks at the look you give, "Okay, three. Four if it's quick and there's a bonus." A scarred hand dismisses this, "Details!"

"What matters is I'll offer our contract for $motr_priceText credits. Practically charity, isn't it? Put us to work, or sell it off elsewhere, doesn't matter to me if you can get us outta this fix. What'dya say?"
translation:
你陪着喝了一轮 "大气圈直降"，一种主要比谁能最快灌完辣眼睛烈酒的喝法，证明了自己是个值得打交道的角色。

佣兵们肯定都喝高了，但还算保持着能谈吐的清醒，聊起了为什么他们被地方政府所追查的细节。

趁着几个雇佣兵起身去点一轮 "轨道轰炸" 的工夫，他们的领队把你拉到一边，给了一个提议："我们有 $motr_numberOfMarines 套装甲的人整装待发，个个都是经验丰富的好手。甭管是真空还是地面，一个G还是五个G，都能出动。"他对你的怀疑的样子笑了下，"好吧，最多三个G，如果有奖金而且只是简短行动的话，四个G也行。" 一只有疤痕的手挥过，"细枝末节就甭谈了！"

"重要的是我们的合同只要 $motr_priceText 星币。简直是在做慈善，对吧？给我们找点活干，或者在别的地方把合同再转让掉，只要能让我们摆脱这个困境就行，其他的我都不在乎。你怎么说？"

original:
It is not unusual that the Remnant Nexus exchanges signals with the local comm relay. Wherever Tri-Tachyon's AI fleets linger, one finds clouds of tiny spy-sats, relays, and repeaters chirping squirts of data back and forth. Very quietly, almost enough to be lost in the background noise. But not quite.

It is not a simple thing to tap into this self-evolved network to request a very specific piece of information. You assemble your senior officers and consider your options for hacking into the Nexus
translation:
余辉中枢和星系内的通讯中继站进行信号交互并不罕见。毕竟无论这些 速子科技 麾下的 AI 舰队在哪儿徘徊，都会留下如云雾般密布的间谍卫星和中继转发系统，不停地来回吞吐数据流。虽然这些都安静到几乎能被背景噪音所掩盖，但也不是完全悄然无息。

接入这样一个自我进化出来的网络里获取某个特定的信息绝非易事。你将你的上级军官召集到了一起，考虑能采取什么行动来黑入中枢。

original:
As a commissioned privateer of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation, you have been given a standard set of access codes. These are old protocols, and while they've migrated away from company standards over time (due, probably, to the meddling of idle AIs), your technical officers have the skill to adapt to the unusual changes.

After hours of painstakingly crafting a request - it must be asked in precisely the correct way and have the properly mutated access codes attached - the question is asked and the answer received nearly instantly. Unnervingly so. Nonetheless, you now have navigation coordinates which should lead to the planetkiller.
translation:
身为一名 三一速子科技公司 麾下的签约私掠者，你被给予了一套标准访问编码。这些协议很老旧，而且和公司标准规范渐行渐远 (也许是那些到处闲逛的 AI 们搞的鬼)，不过你的技术官们完全有能力适应此类异常变动。

由于必须附上准确转换后的访问编码，并使用非常精确无误方式进行询问，检索请求在煞费苦心地认真编写了几个小时之后才发出去，之后却几乎立即就收到了回答，让人不禁有些胆怯。但无论如何，你现在拿到了应该都能通往行星杀手所在位置的导航坐标了。

original:
Your comms officer inputs the commands, a look of confusion remaining on their face.

"Their system isn't built for comms. Um, at all. But, theoretically the adaptive protocols should... could interface, if there's a proper link..." 

Another tap at the controls, "The line should be open. If someone, something... is listening."

Your display shows nothing but holo-snow. Your officers fall silent, and the signal processing amplifies the buzz of cosmic background radiation to a near-audible level. There's nought but a yawning void awaiting your words.
translation:
你的通讯军官输入了指令，一脸的困惑依然没有散去。

"它们的系统构造没考虑过接受通讯，呃，完全没有。但，理论上自适应协议应该...也许能进行交互，如果有合适的链接的话..." 

通讯军官又在控制台上按了一下，"链接应该开启了，如果有人，有什么东西...在听着的话。"

你的显示台上除了全息雪花噪之外什么都没显示。你的军官都安静了下来，与此同时，信号处理器自顾自地把宇宙背景辐射的嗡响放大到了几乎能听见的音量水平。在这无有之处中，仿佛有片虚空正打着哈欠等着你发话。

Data recovery from a Tri-Tachyon war-AI nexus is laborious due to the unusual hardware and the AI-designed data architecture which seems to delight in confounding idiosyncrasies.

original:
Data recovery from the AI war-nexus is laborious due to the unusual hardware and confoundingly idiosyncratic data architecture. 

Your tech officer stumbles on their words from excitement and exhaustion. "A detachment from this nexus encountered a Hegemony fleet. Broke them in minutes, a terrible defeat. Tri-Tachyon had intel protocols; they'd assign AIs to trawl captured datastores then feed that back to more AIs and- ah. There's a planetkiller device."

Your tech officer is wide-eyed. "The weapon. A planetkiller," they repeat with the excited morbidity of a child who, maybe, glimpsed a dead body. "The Hegemony fleet cached it in an asteroid. We got the name of the system it's in!"
translation:
由于 AI 战斗中枢那不同寻常的硬件设备以及充斥着令人困惑特征的数据架构，导致从中恢复数据相当费劲。

你的技术军官兴奋又疲惫，有一句没一句地说道："有一支无人舰队从这个中枢启航，后来它遇到了一支 霸主 舰队。前者没几分钟就把后者碾碎了，真是个可怕的下场。而 速子科技 有一套通讯协议，他们会让 AI 爬取截获的数据，然后将其反馈给其它更多的 AI —— 啊。这提到了一台行星杀手。"

你的技术军官突然瞪大了双眼。"那种武器。一台行星杀手，" 重复的语气像是瞥见了一具尸体的孩子一样狂热又病态，"霸主 舰队把它藏在了某颗小行星上。而我们现在知道它在哪个星系里了！"

$HeOrShe holds up a hand in anticipation of your questions. "We have confirmed that this Tri-Tachyon source is reliable; their details match Hegemony records concerning a strategic data breach, and a subsequent fleet lost during the first AI War."

"Don't look so surprised, captain," $heOrShe says, chidingly. "Faith in Ludd's Word does not contradict worldly expertise."

左径分子在数据平板上点了几下，打开了一个共享数据库。"有一个令人憎恶的巢穴，你可以称其为余辉中枢，其中有关于一支 霸主 舰队的数据 —— 那支舰队曾携带过一颗行星杀手。它在 $pk_nexusSystemName 星系里。" 

$HeOrShe举起手，抢先制止了你的提问。"我们已经确认这条来自 速子科技 的消息是可靠的。它们的细节符合 霸主 记录中的一次战略数据泄露事件，以及接下来，那一支在第一次 AI 战争中失踪的舰队。"

"别看起来这么吃惊，舰长，" $heOrShe对你的失态略加责备，说道，"信奉卢德福音和使用专业术语之间并不矛盾。"

original:
The Pather taps something on an old datapad, then pauses. And carefully looks at you.

"Something in my spirit hesitates. Why should that be?" $HeOrShe slowly puts the datapad down. "How did you, a slave to Moloch, come to speak with me so readily? Is this a ruse to use the information so-revealed to ourselves for your own ends? Or for Tri-Tachyon? The Hegemony?"

You can see $hisOrHer expression turning from distrust to disgust. "I won't be your dupe, your fool, your means of finding the tool of the defiler!" $HeOrShe stands, shouting, "Begone from here!"
translation:
那个左径分子在一个老旧的数据平板上敲了几下，然后停了下来，并仔细打量着你。

"我的意志有些犹豫不决。为什么？" $HeOrShe缓缓地放下了数据平板。"你，恶魔摩洛克的奴隶，怎能如此平和地与我交谈？这一定是一个诡计，你是为了你某些不可告人的目的而透露给我们这些信息？还是为了 速子科技？霸主？"

Used by salvors on the Fringe, these are kept up-to-date for a reasonable subscription fee and statistically proven to ensure an efficient transition into contemporary society for temporal refugees including cryo-sleepers, decivs, and castaways.

original:
You are escorted to the rim of the rocky plateau where your shuttle awaits. Skiron reminds you again to return to Hegemony space and tell 'Command' about Sentinel.

About to step aboard, you notice a stark white fragment of bone in a gravelly rill. You pause in your step; it must be a fibula, or tibia. Maybe. You suspect that the Protocols would demand orderly containment of the honored dead.

So, this?

Whatever it was, it was done many cycles ago.
translation:
你被护送到了一个岩石台地上，你的穿梭机在此等候。Skiron 再度提醒你要回到 霸主 疆域，并将 Sentinel 的情况报给 '指挥部'。

就当你即将踏上船时，你在砾石中发现了一块异常明显的骨头碎片。你停下脚步；这应该是一块腓骨，或者一块胫骨。你心怀疑惑：纪律应该会要求荣誉身故的死者被规范地收容。

那，这个是？

不管是什么，这都是很多个星历年之前的事情了。

"It is not unimaginable that Tri-Tachyon, or some AI, has broken our security. But. I believe you to be who you say you are, Captain $PlayerName, Auxiliary to the Hegemony Navy."

original:
"It is our duty," the Skiron exchanges a glance with her lieutenants. "Until we receive orders otherwise. Although..."

She deliberates for a moment with her advisors, then turns back to you. "Assuming medical technology is available in the Core Worlds, we would send some of our number with, um, advanced conditions for treatment. Command will make arrangements for their well-being, I am certain."

"And," after an awkward pause, "appropriate payment will be made to you as well, I am sure."
translation:
"在接收到新命令之前，我们的职责就是坚守岗位。" Skiron 和她的中尉们交换了一个眼神，"不过..."

她与顾问们商讨片刻之后，转过头来对你说到，"有些医疗条件只有核心世界才能够提供，而我们正好需要，呃，转送几名病情严重的患者接受治疗。我确定指挥部肯定会负责照顾他们的健康状况的。"

"而且，" 在片刻尴尬的停顿过后，她继续说道，"我也很确定，你肯定会得到相应的报酬的。"

$HeOrShe goes still. "I see," $heOrShe says. "That is a troubling allegation. Though if what you say is true, it was done over a hundred cycles ago."

$HeOrShe直起了身子。"我知道了。" $heOrShe说道，"那确实是个令人担忧的指控。然而即便属实，那也是远在上百个星历年之前的事了。"

It's the perfect trap, really: a stream of under-prepared prey gets fed to the pirates, enhancing their reputation. The supply of mercs taking low-ball contracts is reduced, driving up the prices of the old guard cartel. And, best of all, it's deniable: if the pirates are destroyed, so are the cartel's partners in their conspiracy.
translation:
问题就是同业竞争压低了价位 —— 而这帮勾结在一起的佣兵组织则和海盗达成了交易来解决这一问题。

这真是个完美的陷阱：一连串准备不足的猎物被喂给海盗，让海盗名声远扬。接低价合同的佣兵团因此被灭得越来越少，让这些勾结在一起的老字号能坐地起价。而最好的一点就是这个计划根本无从查证：如果海盗被毁灭了，那这些佣兵在阴谋中的同伙自然也就没了。
