original:
With the automated defenses cleared, your salvors are free to crack open the enormous zero-G vaults of the cache. Power is provided to dead conduits, fused circuits replaced with temporary fittings, and the great doors persuaded to loosen their mechanical restraints.

At first, it appears to be empty. A colossal tomb, never filled. Then probe-mounted radar starts to build a picture in your bridge display while suit lights pile their beams into the space, catching drifts of dust and gas set afloat by the re-opening. Spars gleam in the dark, revealing trifold radial symmetry.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," your tech officer says, attention fixed not on the suit cams or bridge display but on technical specs scrolling through a display already overfull with diagrams and documents. "You have to see this."
translation:
解决掉自动化防御系统之后，你的打捞员们便可毫无阻拦地打开贮藏点巨大的无重力仓库。失去能量的管道被重新充能，融毁的线路被临时衔接替换，面前的大门终于被驯服，并缓缓松开了其机械门锁。

第一眼望去，仓库内似乎空无一物。仿佛一座巨大却又空旷的墓穴。随后，探测机上的雷达开始在你的舰桥屏幕上构造一副画面，而宇航服上的灯光也再度穿过被打开的大门所激起的尘埃，照向仓库深处。远处一些的闪烁的光点显示出了三重放射式对称的姿态。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，" 你的技术军官说到，他的注意力并不在舰桥投影或者宇航服摄像头画面之上，而是在翻阅一个屏幕上满满的数据图表和文件。"你得看看这个。"

original:
"I'm afraid that I know no one by that name, captain." $HeOrShe shrugs apologetically.

"If you are looking for a member of the Path, that will not be easy. It is, as I'm sure you know, a kinship of people, not numbers and indices. You must know someone who trusts you and knows the one for whom you look."

"So forgive me, but I do not have your answer. But... " $heOrShe smiles coyly, "I may know who to ask."
OR
"I know not that name, $playerSirOrMadam," $heOrShe says. "We do not believe in indexing people with the beast's number. To find someone, you must know someone, and you must build a bridge of trust. This is the Luddic way."

"So," $heOrShe nods, conceding something, "while I have no answer for you, I may know someone who does."

"所以还请原谅我，我并不知道问题的答案。但..." $heOrShe狡黠一笑，"我可能知道你该去问谁。"
OR
"我不知道这个名字，$playerSirOrMadam，" $heOrShe说道。"我们不相信把人当成野兽一样用数字编号的那一套。想要找一个人，你必须先认识一个其他人，然后建立起信任的桥梁。这才是卢德的做法。"

You explain that while you were indeed at the protest on Jangala Station on that fated day, it is not all as it appears. 

The holos that leaked out were manipulated by secret Hegemony AI cores which substituted your face for that of a Hegemony officer on the scene. The cowards are trying to deflect blame away from themselves! It is obvious that the long-term goal of the Hegemony is to stamp out all spiritual belief, the better to assert AI-led control over the population and turn all humans into mere machines, cogs in a new Domain; a mechanistic galaxy-straddling Moloch built in defiance of God's creation!
translation:
你想方设法辩解道，虽然你在 Jangala 空间站命定遇袭的那一日正好出现在空间站，事实却根本不是他们所想的那样。

original:
You explain that while marines under your command were indeed deployed on that fateful day on Epiphany, you were in fact trying to stop an Hegemony black-ops raid being run through the pirate Warlord Kanta. It was the subsequent black propaganda/cover-up that placed you at the center of the action.

Kanta is, of course, a hollowed-out shell controlled by an AI core; an abomination in the eyes of all followers of Ludd but indeed the very image of the Hegemony's ultimate goal for all humanity in the Persean Sector: machine-slaves to false AI-gods tasked with building a new Domain; a mechanistic galaxy-straddling Moloch to defy the very nature of God's creation!
translation:
你想方设法辩解道，虽然你指挥的陆战队员确实在 Epiphany 遇袭这一天被部署过，但你实际上是在试图阻止霸主通过海盗军阀 Kanta 进行的隐秘劫掠行动。反倒是他们随后用以掩盖自身行径的宣传，将你拖入了这次袭击的中心。

当然，所谓 Kanta 也不过是一个由 AI 核心控制的空壳；在任何卢德的追随者眼中，这具空壳都只能说是令人生厌，但此等孽物，也正是霸主终极目标下英仙座星域所有人类的形象：为建立一个所谓的新人之领，而被 AI 伪神操弄着的机械奴隶；而那所谓的新人之领，正如一个横跨整个银河的摩洛克机械，蔑视着神之造物的一切天性！

You can tell from the horror on $personPost's face, and subsequent affirmation - they're right, about everything - that the arc of your story is too enticing not to take root. Though absurd, it feels right, and plays to a deep-rooted sense of persecution.

你声情并茂，深入阐释着，那 AI 核心们是如何使出重重阴谋诡计，想方设法挑动人类内斗的；而你本人受到这 AI 核心们坑害的经历又如何驱使着你，让你有生以来第一次，开始重新考虑 卢德左径 那崇高的理想与远大的目标是否才是正道。

original:
His sneer fades. You wouldn't be so stupid, his look says, would you? You give a little nod; yes, you would. You've done far stupider and walked away intact.

Before long, you've got the dossier on one Nile Virens, local Pather strongman, transferred to your datapad. Contact info, addresses, and a patchy bio. Operates compounds in all the major Luddic population centers. Runs the Path, such as it is, on Mazalot.

"You deserve each other," the officer grumbles as he makes his exit.
translation:
他的冷笑消失了。你有那么蠢吗？不会吧？他仿佛在用表情这么问。你轻轻点头。没错，你就那么蠢。你还做过蠢得更离谱的事，而且能全身而退。

不久之后，你让一份关于本地左径铁腕人物 Nile Virens 的档案转到了你的数据平板上。包括相关人士信息、地址和一份零散不堪的简介。在所有主要的卢德聚居区都运营有定居点。那基本上就是在暗地里领导整个 Mazalot 的左径了。

original:
The agent freezes mid-speech, looks at you - yes, you mean it - then quickly taps at a datapad, looking between it and you.

"Captain." The datapad is tucked away, the agent standing up straight, the smile wiped off his face. "I'm afraid there's been a misunderstanding. The MUA, naturally, fully supports the League Fleet," his eyes meet yours, and he makes a comradely nod, "-and the commissioned privateers who bolster our forces."

"On behalf of Mazalot MuniSec, allow me to render any required assistance with, ah, Fleet operations..."
translation:
这个特工话说到一半戛然而止，看向了你 —— 是的，你没在开玩笑 —— 然后在数据平板上飞快地敲了几下，目光在你和平板之间来回对照。

"这位舰长，" 数据平板被收到了一边，这个特工站的笔直，脸上抹去了笑容，"之前恐怕有一些误解。MUA 组织，理所当然地，全力以赴地，支持着联盟舰队，" 他与你目光交接，亲切地点头，"—— 以及让我们的部队如虎添翼的签约私掠者们。"

"请允许我代表 Mazalot 地方安全部，为，呃，舰队行动，提供一切必要的协助..."

original:
As you slip out of the bar, leaving the sound of breaking glass and shouting behind, you reflect that the MuniSec goons were definitely running holo-rec, so it's not a clean getaway. 

But it's also probably not worth the real authorities making too much a fuss about, either. You wouldn't be the first spacer to run from a brawl, not on Mazalot, not anywhere, and allowances must be made for the commerce your type brings to these worlds.

Someone will remember, however.

original:
"I didn't want to come to this Luddie-infested backwater of a failed terraforming experiment to hunt Pathers, but Intel smelled rot. Do you know what that means? - Don't answer. We have heard reports - disturbing reports - about the accounts of the Mazalot Unification Authority Municipal Security branch."

The officer is on his back heel, sweating. Nearby tables are carefully pretending not to listen to your tirade.

"'Riddled with Pather credits' is what I've heard. And as you well know per the League's Interstellar Terrorism Statute - which you so helpfully quoted for me - that means that central oversight is empowered to intervene in local affairs."
translation:
"我本来也不想到这个地貌改造失败的穷乡僻壤，在到处滋生的卢德佬里面追猎左径分子，但情报中透露出一股不妙的气息。你知道那意味着什么吗？—— 不用回答。我收到一些令人不安的报告，与 Mazalot 统一政权安全部门 (MUA) 的账目有关。"

这个军官立正站直，汗水涔涔而下。附近几桌人小心翼翼地装作没听到你的长篇大论。

"关于左径分子资金来源的流言，已经充斥了我的耳朵。而正如你所熟知的那样，根据联盟的星际恐怖主义法 —— 就是你之前帮我引用的那个 —— 这意味着中央监督机构将有权干预地方事务。"

"Do you know what that means? Do not respond, officer, I am not finished."

You continue the dress-down, describing the various powers that the central League executive can hammer down upon members found to be involved in abetting terrorism - Mairaath's millions dead were fresh in the minds of the composers of the League's constitution, and the powers enumerated to stop a repeat of the event are far-reaching indeed.

It is, you reflect, a good thing you paid attention to League history.

"你知道这意味着什么吗？别急着回答，长官，我还没说完。"

你继续斥责着，描述了联盟中央行政部门可以对被发现参与教唆恐怖主义的成员施加的各种处罚 —— Mairaath 的数百万死者在联盟的规则制定者们心中记忆犹新，而为阻止事件重演而被赋予的权力确实意义深远。

Gens Yaribay is a respected operator which the MUA, naturally, welcomes within the local commercial volume. If MuniSec can be of any assistance in your, ah, business..."

original:
You oversee the raid from your bridge, your $shipOrFleet providing EW cover and sporadic fire support for the breaching drones and marine shuttles.

The raid hinges on mere minutes of chaos, comms throughout the hemisphere crackling with static and only tightbeam relays able to pierce the rain of EM scatter amid clouds of chaff and disruption. Casualty reports roll in, displays on your bridge bleeding to fill the space with a bloody glow.

In the confusion, more than one team reports success. This can be sorted out later. As quickly as they landed, your forces perform an orderly withdrawal, laying covering fire while hauling casualties and prisoners.

你在舰桥上监督本次劫掠行动，你的$shipOrFleet正在为入侵的无人机和陆战队穿梭机提供电子战掩护和零星的火力支援。

original:
You convene your senior officers to discuss an extraction scenario for Jethro Bornanew, presumably employed or taken hostage by Nile Virens. 

It is impossible to completely avoid the MUA's defense network, although even cursory scans show that it is deployed to counter internal uprisings rather than external raids. Persean League casualties can be minimized, but certain sensor stations and defensive batteries will have to be disabled to open the way for a clean assault on Virens' bases.

The Pathers are another problem entirely: separate infiltration squads must simultaneously breach secure compounds located in densely populated settlements. Casual use of heavy weaponry among civilians would attract unwanted interference both in the immediate operation and your future activities. You must strike everywhere swiftly, unerringly, and with a light touch.
translation:
你召集上级军官商议营救 Jethro Bornanew 的方案，目标此时应该是被 Nile Virens 雇佣或囚禁了。

想要完全避开 MUA 的防御系统是毫无可能的，尽管他们是为了应对内部暴动而非外部劫掠而建成。突袭过程中对英仙座联盟造成的损失可以降至最小，但是为了能直击 Virens 的据点，一些侦察站和防御炮台依旧需要处理掉。

左径分子则完全是另一个问题：潜入小队们必须同时进攻人口密集的聚落中戒备森严的几座建筑。在人群中随意使用重型武器不但会立刻引来阻碍，还会对你未来的活动造成影响。你必须迅捷，精准，还要谨慎地打击每一个地区。

$personName sighs, deeply, as if you've brought $hisOrHer rather more trouble than the signed up for. Because you have.

original:
Local MuniSec holds you, your guards, and a few witnesses until a mid-rank Knight of Ludd can make a ruling on the situation. The case for self-defense is clear-cut - witnesses swear holy oaths to this - and the licensing of your protective weapons is accepted.

"A child, led astray," the Knight says gruffly as the would-be assassin is wrapped in a simple shroud and taken away. Their eyes turn to you, "Your pride sows wrath, and it bears this bloody fruit."

After a pointed silence, they say, "You and yours; go now. What's here is done."

"...So I pray," the Knight mutters as you turn away.
translation:
地方安全部控制住了你和你的警卫，以及几位目击者，直到一位中阶卢德骑士终于对情况做出裁定。正当防卫的事实显而易见，目击者对其所见所闻宣以圣誓，并且你的自卫武器许可也都真实有效。

"一位被引入歧途的孩子。" 当这名刺杀未遂的刺客被朴实无华的裹尸布裹起带走之后，骑士哀叹道。人们的目光随之转向了你，"你的傲慢播下了愤怒，最终收获了这血腥的结果。"

在一段突兀的沉默后他们说："你和你的人；现在走吧。这里发生的事已经了结了。"

"...我祈祷如此，" 在你转身离开时，骑士低声说道。

original:
The attendant receives your request with only the subtlest disapproval. To your surprise, a subcurate approaches to escort you to the shrine's viewing chamber.

A vast, dim gallery opens upon a hundred-meter diamond plate window allowing a full view of the glory of Kumari Aru. Here, pilgrims quietly contemplate the miracle of Creation, taking in the sublime and terrible beauty of the gas giant looming below. Storm systems the size of a standard terrestrial world churn with slow majesty, inner-lit with green-violet sheet lightning, teeming with xenolife.

Does something incomprehensible look up from the lee of a dark cloudbank at the bright point in that alien sky?
translation:
圣务侍接受了你的请求，只是稍显不悦。出乎你意料的是，一名助理祭司走了过来，领你去了圣地的观礼室。

一个巨大而昏暗的回廊围绕着一扇百米宽的菱形窗口展开，让人得以一览 Kumari Aru 的壮丽美景。在这里，朝圣者们冥思创世者的神迹，体验下方赫然耸立的气态巨行星所展现出的庄严敬畏之美。规模相当于一个标准的类地星球风暴系统缓慢而威严地翻腾着，大片绿紫色的雷电不时闪烁其中，孕育着数不尽的异种生命。

不知在那阴暗的云层之下，是否有什么难以名状之物正抬头望着它们的天空中的亮点？

"Captain $PlayerName," the Knight says, "Let me speak welcome on behalf of the Church of Galactic Redemption. I extend to you an invitation from the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis to meet and share refreshment."

original:
The Knight's eyebrows shoot up in surprise. With a blink the Knight recovers composure, and says "Y... es. Of course. This is a request, not a demand. Although. The Reverend Archcurate." A moment's pause. "She suggested that I insist, if necessary." 

Beneath the solemnity, the Knight's look pleads for you to not put them in the awkward situation of denying the Archcurate. 

You mentally review your model of the Church hierarchy: the Archcurate Conclave is the crown of the Church, meeting or sending representatives to perform the rulings that determine the highest matters; interpreting the canon of Ludd, sanctification, holy law, excommunication. If the Church has rulers, this Archcurate is among them.
translation:
骑士惊讶的扬起眉毛，随即便恢复了镇静，说道，"是...是的，当然了。这是个请求而非命令。即便宗师大人她..." 他停顿了一下，"她建议我在必要时坚持一下。"

在这种庄重的氛围下，骑士恳求你不要让他们因你的抗命而陷入尴尬的境地。

你回想了一下教会的等级制度：教宗密会是教会的最高权力机关。他们有权举行会议或派出代表来裁决教会的事务，此外还能解读卢德的教义、提拔某人、制定圣典或是将某人逐出教会。如果说教会有统治者的话，那这位大祭司一定是其中之一。

You are bereft of affinity for the nicety of manners without suffering the years to earn that exalted state." She picks up a teacup and taps its side idly.

His dark eyes examine yours via the comm-link for a long moment before he speaks.

You return to your shuttle, taking a final breath of air rich with the exhalations of both the greenery and the mass of humanity.

As your pilot swaps take-off pings with traffic control, they pause at an unusual set of nav instructions which are forwarded to your (now retrieved) datapad: you are being directed to a landing which serves a huge monastic complex, some sort of Church administrative center.

The local datasphere is not forthcoming on details. It's difficult to say if this is a security measure or pious neglect.
translation:
吸入最后一口充满了绿色植物和人类气息的空气后，你返回了穿梭机上。

当你的飞行员与交通管制交换起飞信号时，一组不寻常的导航指令打断了他们，随后这些指令被转发到了你的数据平板上：你的穿梭机需要沿着非标准航线前往一处庞大寺院建筑群中的着陆场，那似乎是教会的行政中心。

你被带到了一条更小的路上；不是通往主圣地的大道，而是位于峭壁背风处林海中的、一座更小的次级圣地。

original:
The attendant dutifully explains that the shrine commemorates the holy site where Ludd first stepped onto Gilead and was brought prostrate, to the shock of non-believers, to kiss the earth itself, so overcome was Ludd by the rapturous touch of Divinity.

Ludd's influence spread by its own evident virtue, the attendant explains, and the industrial terraforming machines were brought down and flowers bloomed in the rubble. There is no mention of strikes, global storms, sabotage, apocalyptic flooding and heatwaves, or corporate terror squads in this narrative. Nor does the attendant mention that, technically, an entire planet owned by the Eridani Utopia Terraforming megacorporation was illegally occupied by a radical cult. Rather, the unbelievers wept as Ludd revealed their sins and told them forgiveness was within reach on this garden-world.

It is an appealing morality tale delivered earnestly.
translation:
圣务侍尽职地解释说，这个圣地是为了纪念卢德第一次踏上 Gilead 而建的，那时卢德被神伟大的才能所折服，在无信者们震惊的目光中，弯下腰亲吻了大地。

圣务侍继续解释说，卢德的精神通过其自身明显的优点传播开来，地貌改造工业机器被摧毁，鲜花在废墟中盛开。在叙述中，对方没有提到罢工、全球风暴、蓄意破坏、末日洪水和热浪，也没有提到企业的恐怖组织。圣务侍更没有提到，严格意义上来说，这件事就是 波江座-乌托邦地貌改造集团 拥有的整颗星球被激进的教团非法占领。取而代之地，对方说，当卢德揭示了他们的罪恶并告诉他们，在这花园世界里宽恕将触手可及的时候，无信者们感激涕零。

真是个引人入胜的道德故事。

Around you flows a river of pilgrims. They've invested such meaning into the journey they've made, supposedly in the path of their prophet Ludd. It is almost unbelievable how much has been built on the words of one obscure figure who managed to be blessed by circumstance with great charisma and a moment to bend the arc of history.

What would the - certainly - long-dead Ludd make of what's become of all of it?

你的周围流淌着朝圣者的人流。他们为自己跟随先知卢德的脚步的旅程找到了意义。令人难以置信的是，那个设法利用了环境、以巨大的感召力在一瞬间弯曲了历史走向的人，他留下的话语究竟都形成了什么。

All around you see despair and decadence in equal measure channelled into the elaborate rituals of the Luddic Church. Made safe, made convenient; an insulating layer that allows people to live without truly walking Ludd's Path.

original:
The attendant nods, explaining that you must leave your guards behind because this is a place of peace, and all are equal on the Pilgrim's Path. 

The request is an implied request for keeping up appearances: a couple of your guards, unarmed and trained for situations requiring this degree of subtlety, attend to your safety as per matter of course. You note other unusually small parties of "pilgrims", plainly but clearly wealthy by their cut and carriage, led by their own shrine-attendants and accompanied by unusually muscled 'distant cousins'.

Nonetheless, the crowds filing out of the transport complex, on a wide highway of beaten earth and cobble, are enormous. Those that cannot walk are carried; no powered transport is provided.
translation:
圣务侍点了点头，解释说你必须让保镖留下，因为这是个和平的地方，朝圣者之路上人人平等。

这不过是个对外在形象的含蓄要求：几个没有携带武器的保镖接受过应对这种微妙情况的训练，他们理所当然地成为了和你一同拜访此地的朝圣者以照顾你的安全。同时你还注意到了其他一些异常的小规模 "朝圣者"，他们的举手投足毫不掩饰地流露出了明显的富有，由专属的圣务侍带领，还有些肌肉发达的 "远房表亲" 陪同。

从运输中心鱼贯而出的人群数量庞大，他们来到了由碎土和鹅卵石铺成的宽阔公路上。由于此地不提供助力交通工具，那些无法行走的人只能由其他人抬着。

original:
The path of the pilgrims leads up a slope covered in trees more enormous than any you've seen before. Though small in scale compared to the celestial phenomena that is your daily bread, their living architecture forms a natural cathedral.

Dispassionate Knights of Ludd watch as attendants shuttle you through a cordoned path in an arc through a final grove of mighty sequoia-analogs atop the promontory at the terminus of the ridge - it is a temple, struts and spars intertwined with the trees. Golden sunlight filters through heavy branches, and as the breeze lifts a whispering chorus of foliage, you catch an earthy scent over the mass of humanity surrounding you.
translation:
朝圣者之路通向了一个山坡，山坡被你前所未见的巨大树木覆盖着 —— 尽管与你见惯了的天体和太空建筑相比还是太小了 —— 他们的活建筑形成了一个天然的大教堂。

original:
Deorbiting to the surface of Gilead is strictly overseen by the Knights of Ludd; your shuttle must queue behind a flotilla of lumbering transports and haulers filled with approved industrial goods.

This provides you with time to contemplate the face of Gilead; its continents, once fringed only by alien algae-equivalents, were seeded with Earth-life by a far-roving sporeship of the second wave of human expansion. The Eridani-Utopia Terraforming megacorp followed and its vast machines stabilized the climate and ecological processes. Ludd came then, pulled down the machines, and the believers who followed maintained the world as a garden-wilderness of astounding richness. Truly, it is a gem of the Persean Sector.

Your shuttle receives a ping from traffic control: permission to descend.
translation:
离开轨道下到 Gilead 地表的过程由卢德骑士严格监管，你的穿梭机得排在一堆装满经过批准的工业产品的笨重运输船和拖船后面。

original:
"People like us, just gotta keep our heads down. Pray in public, yeah, live your own life on the quiet, you know?" 

They take a drag from a black market drug stick. "Say what you will about the Excubitor Orbis, at least he takes mercy and forgiveness as seriously as he takes all those other 'knightly virtues'."

Between complaints about Luddic society you get the understanding that for 2,000 credits an unauthorized shuttle flight to the shrine of Hesperus could be tagged by a helpful nonbeliever as a regular pilgrim transport.

"像我们这样的人，就得低着脑袋过活。公开场合得虔诚一点，是啊，私下里自己的日子还是该咋过咋过，你懂吧？" 

他们抽了一口黑市毒烟卷，继续道："不管你对行星教卫有几个意见，至少他对待怜悯和宽恕的态度也和他对其他那些 '骑士美德' 一样严肃。"

original:
The hum of your ship grows in your ears, the sense of inhabiting your own body in a can hurtling around a gravity well, the incomprehensible webs of influence keeping you both in this place and in the constant dynamism of crisis.

Lower and higher dimensions twist and vibrate, a web conspiring to hold you up - or back - falling and clinging just so. Your technologies tap these invisible quirks of physics to keep you warm, to keep your feet on the ground, to keep the air flowing follow a rhythm, a meter. It is like music, in fact. If you listen carefully...

It would be impossible to speak, now.
translation:
飞船的轰鸣在你耳中不断回响放大，让你意识到自己正身处于一个围绕重力井飞驰的铁罐头中。引力犹如无数无边的大网，让你困入动力持续变动的危局之中，滞留于此。

高低维度互相交织震荡着，一同合谋将你网住，当你即将下坠时将你举起，在你意欲爬升时把你拖住。你身边的各种科技仿佛在有节奏地敲打着种种无形的物理异象，使你保持温暖，让你脚踏实地，令空气保持循环，一切都充满了韵律。其实这犹如乐曲，只要你仔细去聆听...

此刻，难以言述。

original:
The shrine is a grand tomb set in an enormous airshaft. The industrial viscera has been transformed into a baroque sculpture of thousands of edged weapons aligned like feathers of a wing, rays of gleaming serrated metal boldly thrust in killing arcs through the vast space.

In the middle, surrounded by a galaxy of flickering candles, lie the lead-lined caskets of a squad of martyred Knights. The manner of their deaths, the subcurate explains in reverent whispers, left their bodies unidentifiable and infused with radioactive material which would kill a direct observer even to this day.
translation:
这座圣地是一座华丽的墓穴，坐落在一个庞大的通风竖井内。曾经脉动的工业肺腑已经被一座巴洛克式的雕塑取而代之。成千上万锋利的兵刃犹如羽翼上的翎毛般齐整排列，钢铁的锋芒闪耀着寒光，错落有致地排出了弧形的杀阵，直指那无边的宇宙。

在那中央，无数烛火犹如银河般闪耀，将一队殉道骑士们的铅衬棺木环绕其中。助理祭司虔诚地低语道，他们的死因导致其遗体无法辨认，渗入的放射性物质时至今日仍会让直接观察的人命丧黄泉。

original:
The landing bay antechamber is a baroque gothic-militant display of post-industrial salvage. Dead suits of power armor stand at attention, weapons proudly displayed. Glowing between rivet-encrusted arches are scenes of battle and martyrdom done up in mosaic panes formed of fractured gems; structural diamond and colorful lenses recovered from mining lasers or reactor inspection ports.

The gallery is filled with parties of Luddic pilgrims dressed in traditional handweave meeting with shrine attendants.

展馆里挤满了身着传统手工服饰的卢德朝圣者，他们正在与圣地的圣务侍们会面。

original:
The shrine is a grand tomb set in an enormous airshaft. The industrial viscera has been transformed into a baroque sculpture of thousands of edged weapons aligned like feathers of a wing, rays of gleaming serrated metal boldly thrust in killing arcs through the vast space.

In the center, surrounded by a galaxy of flickering candles, lie the lead-lined caskets of a squad of martyred Knights. The manner of their deaths, the subcurate explains in reverent whispers, left their bodies unidentifiable and infused with radioactive material which would kill a direct observer even to this day.

You are left in a prayer-niche to contemplate the horror.
translation:
这座圣地是一座华丽的墓穴，坐落在一个庞大的通风竖井内。曾经脉动的工业肺腑已经被一座巴洛克式的雕塑取而代之。成千上万锋利的兵刃犹如羽翼上的翎毛般齐整排列，钢铁的锋芒闪耀着寒光，错落有致地排出了弧形的杀阵，直指那无边的宇宙。

在那中央，无数烛火犹如银河般闪耀，将一队殉道骑士们的铅衬棺木环绕其中。助理祭司虔诚地低语道，他们的死因导致其遗体无法辨认，渗入的放射性物质时至今日仍会让直接观察的人命丧黄泉。

你留在一座祈祷者壁龛之中，深思着这份恐怖。

original:
The novice seems to brighten up at this. "It's actually a misunderstanding that the teachings of Ludd are anti-technological, after all..." They see the look on your face at the threat of another scripture reading. 

"Ahem. In other words, we believe the problem with advanced technology is not necessarily intrinsic. Well, some technologies are abhorrent- planet-killers, mind-interfacing, crass immortality. Anyway, the six industrial sins are committed when the human spirit is corrupted by technology used without virtue."
translation:
见习修士听到你的话后似乎眼前一亮。"常人认为卢德教义反科技，这实际上是一种误解，毕竟..." 话说到一半，对方注意到了你面如死灰的表情，仿佛已经忍耐经文到了极限。

"嗯嗯。换句话说，我们认为先进技术的问题不一定是内在的。好吧，的确有些技术本身就令人憎恶 —— 行星杀手、心灵接口、愚蠢的永生。总之，工业的六宗罪是因为人们的精神被无道德底线的技术侵蚀所导致的。"

original:
You join the novice in prayer, repeating the words as best you can with hands clasped. At first it feels silly to partake in this naive ritual led by a cloistered child of the Church. It is like a lamb leading the lion. 

And yet.

Perhaps there is value in the unblushing faith held by such an innocent.

When the prayer finishes, the novice beams a bright smile at you. Behind, you notice that the shrine's Curate Sacraria - the priest of highest authority here - has been watching your exchange from a candle-lit alcove.
translation:
你加入了见习修士的祷告，双手合十，尽可能地重复着祷告词。起初，参加这个由一个与世隔绝的教会孩子主持的天真的仪式感觉很傻。就像狮子去接受小羊羔的指引一样。

然而那只是一开始的想法。

也许这样一个天真无邪的孩子毫不羞愧地秉持的信念，的确有其价值所在。

当祷告结束时，见习修士对你灿烂地微笑着。你注意到，在后面，圣地的神龛祭司 —— 这里的最高权威牧师 —— 一直在烛光照亮的壁龛边观察着你们的互动。

"Wonderful! Blessed already are those whose spirit of reason calls them to the Church."

This is everything they could have hoped for, everything they've been training for. You're given an earful and more about sin, forgiveness, redemption, and the spiritual salve of a simple life. Lots about walking a path and stories about how all sorts of people were impressed with things Ludd said and did.

The novice winds down, and, noticing your endurance flagging, says "May... may I pray with you for a safe journey through the holy vacuum?"
translation:
"太棒了！受精神呼唤前往教会的人已是受福之人。"

这是对方期盼的回答，也是对方为之训练的目标。你听了一大堆话，是关于罪、宽恕、救赎和朴素生活等的种种精神慰藉。还有很多故事，指引人如何与道同行，以及各种各样的人是如何折服于卢德的言行的。

注意到你的不耐烦，见习修士不再滔滔不绝，反而说到，"我...我可以和你一同祈祷吗？祝愿我们在神圣的虚空中一路平安。"

"Perhaps." The attendant cools a little, "As Ludd said, 'To hold faith in your heart, wholly and truly, invites small cruelties of the tongue's lash.'"

"And do you know what Ludd said next?," they ask, rhetorically, "'Let faith be your armor; let walls of devotion build you a citadel, and there we shall be always in spiritual union.'"

original:
The hum of your shuttle changes pitch as it hits the edge of true atmosphere, passing quickly into cloud cover. Beyond the viewpanes human-eye visibility is reduced to nearly zero. As the shuttle fires retros for landing, dipping well below the speed of sound by the demand of both nav regs and good manners, your viewport begins to collect marching droplets of moisture.  

The droplets have an odd ochre coloration, and the clouds above a sickly green tinge. You've heard of this effect; fine-grained spore-analogs in the atmosphere.
translation:
伴随着时高时低的噪音，你的穿梭机抵达了真实大气的边缘，一瞬间消失在云层之中。在观察窗之外，人眼的能见度几乎为零。当穿梭机开始着陆时，由于导航规则和礼貌的要求，其下降速度远低于音速，你的观察窗逐渐布满移动着的水滴。

水滴呈现出一种奇怪的赭色，而云层上方又是病态的绿色。你对此有所耳闻：这是大气中细小的类孢子的东西。

original:
A quick datapad search reveals that, statistically, human activity within the Jangalan biosphere is relatively safe so long as proper air filtration and decontamination procedures are followed. Detox meds for accidental exposures are readily available, though may have unpleasant side effects.

There are reports of individuals whose poor luck and lack of contingency planning combined with vehicle malfunction during truly abysmal weather has resulted in cases of long term exposure to Jangala's biosphere for days, weeks, and in one case more than a standard month. The resulting growths and infections appear to result in a singularly tortuous manner of death.
translation:
数据平板的快速检索显示，从统计数据来看，只要遵循适当的空气过滤和净化程序，Jangala 生物圈内的人类活动相对安全。针对意外暴露的排毒药物很容易获取，尽管它们可能产生令人不快的副作用。

有报道称，一些人的运气不佳，缺乏应急计划，再加上在真正恶劣的天气下的载具故障，导致他们长期暴露在 Jangala 生物圈达数天、数周，有一例甚至超过一个标准月。由此产生的生长和感染似乎导致了异常折磨的死亡。

original:
You reach up and loose your mask, drawing in breath from Jangala. Shallowly at first, then deeper. The smells of spice and rot and ammonia and fresh greens. Whatever may come, you know it won't instantly kill you, and anything that happens is reversible. Is that a tingle, a catch in your throat?

Have faith.

You follow the short trail you were told of. It seems nearly overgrown, feelers and tendrils brush against you.

There are others. Maskless pilgrims, tears streaming from their red eyes and mucus from their noses, skin blotchy, white robes rapidly discolored by alien emissions. They meet your eyes, smile and nod in camaraderie, making the signs of Ludd for you.
translation:
你抬手揭下面罩，吞吐着 Jangala 的气息。从刚开始的轻浅试探，逐渐变得深吸长气。香辛味，腐败味，氨味，新鲜绿植味，百味杂陈。不论迎面扑来的是什么气体，你知道这都不会让你当场毙命，而且造成的损伤都是可逆的。然而你喉头依然感到一丝异样，是刺痛吗？

秉持信仰。

你照着自己得知的那条捷径走了下去。这条路看起来几乎全都是杂草，触角和卷须不断刮蹭着你。

这里还有其他的人。那是些摘掉面罩的朝圣者，他们双眼通红，涕泗横流，皮肤斑驳，一袭白袍在异星的废气里迅速褪色。他们与你目光相交，怀揣着同道的情谊对你微笑颔首，行卢德之礼。

original:
There are overgrown human figures - a statue garden. The forms blister with growths, crawling with tendrils, sprouting the fruiting bodies of alien life.

One moves; not the wind, but another pilgrim, the growths taking hold. How long does this take, hours? Days?

It becomes distracting, hard to focus. You feel like you might die, but the feeling reaches a plateau, a sea of pain and irritation. You allow yourself to float in a buzzing atonal headache, itchiness, torment.

And something more.
translation:
这里到处植物漫身的人形 —— 简直是一座雕像花园。这些造像身上缀满了液疱，缠满了卷须，萌发出了外星生命的子实体。

周围传来了一阵动静，不是风吹草动，而是另一个朝圣者被植物的疯长给牢牢抓住了。这要花多长时间？几个小时，还是几天？

这些景象让人精神溃散，难以保持专注。你感到自己可能会就这样死去，但这种感觉上升到了极限之后就不再积累，形成了一片充满了痛苦和焦虑的汪洋。你任由自己漂浮这一片杂乱无章且挥之不去的头痛，瘙痒和折磨之中。

You wait. The crowd grows, and grows less patient - a minority jeers and shouts, a few spacers start throwing trash. The Luddics perform their chant-prayer, calling for an end to the orbital burns, arms locked. From fights breaking out, it is clear that there is much support for the Luddic cause outside of the overt protestors.

It feels near a boiling point when heads start to turn and you see a dark regiment of lightly armored troopers deploy from columns into a wedge. Security drones hum overhead, targeting lasers and ID-cams flickering.

你冷眼旁观。聚集的人越来越多，也越来越没有耐心 —— 一小部分人发出嘲笑和叫喊，有些宇宙民开始朝人群丢垃圾。卢德教徒们手拉着手，吟唱祷文，呼吁停止使用轨道射线焚烧地表植被。从打斗中可以看出，除了公开的抗议者，还有许多人支持这项运动。

The Luddics' fists, signs, and even hammers are useless against the power-armored gendarmerie.

"You may pass safely, citizen," a drone buzzes at you in a pleasant voice.

Stepping toward the main promenade, you turn to find that you've left a diminishing trail of blood-spots. A scuff or two of your heel on the deck plate takes care of the problem.
translation:
军队的稳步推进冲散了抗议者的队列，他们挥舞着手中的电击棒，让所有尖叫和呼喊都归于虚无，透过镇暴气体，你可以模糊的辨认出无人机正在释放抑制泡沫来压制挣扎的人。卢德信徒的拳头，标语牌，甚至是铁锤，在装备动力装甲的宪兵面前显得苍白无力。

The reception lounge is filled with parties of Luddic pilgrims in traditional handweave led by subcurates in ritual hand-washing. A glance upward reveals the true cleansing: a battery of air-purification units caught in a tangle of murmuring ducts.

Foliage presses itself almost sensually against the outer viewports, letting in only dim light. The plant life seems to twitch, liquids oozing over the panes from cracks in bladders and tubules, leaving rivulets cutting across flaking encrustations. Between the zeal of the foliage and hand-crafted charm of Luddic engineering, the place feels distinctly worrisome compared to the environmental containment you are accustomed to.

original:
You are led past heavy curtains which mute the murmur of pilgrims and shut out all artificial light. Pilgrims kneel in the shrine-chamber, silhouetted before the glowing panes to without lit by that sickly yellow-green cloud cover.

Beyond, you see the statue garden. The forms blister with growths, crawling with tendrils, sprouting fruiting bodies of xenolife. Among them are pilgrims, exposed in only light robes. Easily overtaken by the overgrowth. At their feet, covered by a quilt of mosses and mycelium or alien equivalents, are bones. Or are they fallen branches, overgrown rocks? The final wish for terminally-devoted fanatics, or your imagination?

The green churns not quite imperceptibly in the course of the minutes you watch, all-consuming, ferociously regenerative, a cycle of life that could be born of Earth or an alien world.
translation:
你被带领着穿过厚重的幕布，这些布料阻隔了朝圣者的低语，挡住了所有的人造光源。朝圣者们跪倒在神殿内，他们在明亮的窗格前被勾勒出轮廓，不必被那病态的黄绿色云层照亮。

在远处，你看到了那座雕像花园。这些造像身上缀满了液疱，缠满了卷须，萌发出了异种生命的子实体。只穿着浅色长袍的朝圣者夹杂其中，疯长的植物轻易淹没了他们。在他们脚下，那被苔藓和菌丝或类似外星生物组成的被子覆盖着的是人骨，还是倒下的树枝和杂乱的岩石？是绝境中狂热信徒的最后愿望，又或者仅仅是你的想象？

在你停留的几分钟里，绿色在不知不觉中汹涌澎湃，无厌地吞噬，凶蛮地再生，生命的轮回既可以生于地球，也可以生于一个异星世界。

original:
The air hits you, warm and wet, like high-G shock foam. You step out and follow the short trail; it seems nearly overgrown. You follow it, leaves and feelers brushing against you.

You find the statue gardens, the forms blistering with growth, crawling with tendrils, sprouting fruiting bodies of xenolife. Among them are pilgrims, exposed in their light robes. Easily overtaken by the overgrowth. How long does it take- hours, days?

At their feet, covered by a quilt of mosses and mycelium or alien equivalents, are bones. Or fallen branches, overgrown rocks. Or the final wish for terminally-devoted fanatics.

The green churns not quite imperceptibly in the course of your stay, all-consuming, ferociously regenerative, a cycle of life that could be born of Earth or an alien world.
translation:
空气刺痛着你，带来温暖又潮湿的感觉，就像高重力缓冲泡沫一样。你沿着小路走了出去，这条路几乎被植物淹没了。你顺着路继续前行，树叶和触须拂过你的身体。

你发现了一座雕像花园，这些造像身上缀满了液疱，缠满了卷须，萌发出了异种生命的子实体。穿着浅色长袍的朝圣者夹杂其中，疯长的植物轻易淹没了他们。形成这一切花费了多少时间？是几个小时，还是数天？

他们的脚下，那被苔藓和菌丝或类似外星生物组成的被子覆盖着的，是骨头，还是枯枝，乱石？是狂热信徒的遗愿，或者只是你自己的想象？

在你停留的几分钟里，绿色在不知不觉中汹涌澎湃，无厌地吞噬，凶蛮地再生，生命的轮回既可以生于地球，也可以生于一个异星世界。

original:
The ossuary is built from buried hulls, roughly welded in a chaotic but not artless architecture. No surface is quite level, and the original - faded, crumbling - icons and lettering belie forgotten functions. "Crew quarters", "attachment point", "purge before cycling".

In the gloom you begin to make out empty sockets, rib-cages, countless femurs and spines. They cluster in recesses, corners, in stowage spaces with hatches removed.

You realize that the dust in the air comes from the bodies, the bones, slowly crumbling around you.

藏骨堂由深埋地下的船体改造而来，与错落有致的建筑粗略地焊成一体。这里找不到任何平整的表面，而那些面目全非，破碎不堪的符号和字迹，已然遮盖了被人遗忘的舱室功能 —— "船员宿舍"，"连接点"，"循环前清洁站" 等等。

你悚然惊觉，空中飘散的尘埃，正是来自于身边这些日渐破碎的骸骨和遗体。

original:
Veils of dust slowly flex and twist in the electrostatic fields of the shrine, strong enough to overcome the low gravity of this world to hang in the near-vacuum.

Instructions are given by some unnamed Luddic priest who recites their words into crude repeaters awoken by your activity:

"Come only in peace. Let rest the dead. We pray now in the words revealed to Ludd... "
translation:
尘埃如面纱一般在圣地的静电场中飘摇，电场的强度足以克服这颗星球微弱的引力，使尘埃悬浮在近乎真空的环境中。

你激活了简陋的中继器，一位不知名的卢德神父所朗诵的导言开始广播：

"铸剑为犁，逝者安息。我等虔诚祷告，谨遵卢德神启..."

original:
In the gloom you begin to make out empty sockets, rib-cages, countless femurs and spines. They cluster in recesses, corners, in stowage spaces, their hatches removed.

Recorded verse haunt the comms channels.

"... cities fall from orbit like burning leaves / caught by the wind and wailing / life's breath pulled from mother and child..."

在一片幽暗中，你渐渐辨认出空洞的眼窝，肋骨架，以及数之不尽的股骨和脊椎，它们一团团簇拥在壁龛里，在墙角里，在拆掉舱门的储物间里。

阴魂不散的诗篇，回荡在通信频道之中。

"...城塞，于星轨坠入凡尘，似落叶燎作飞灰 / 狂风无尽之哭嚎，困我于囹圄之中 / 母子相依为命，生息俱为所夺..."

You are left among the dead. The webs of ash hanging in the air twitch and flow as movement elsewhere in the labyrinth trigger minor fluctuations in the standing electrostatic charge.

Your shuttle descends toward the surface of Killa, following the landing beacon to an ancient lava-sea peppered with craters.

Tactical systems log the brief ping of targeting radar but the signature suggests a handheld system too crude to pose a threat to your countermeasures.

The landing site is far from any obvious ruins or landmarks. There's just a smear of crumbling temporary habs and cold, broken transports.
translation:
你的穿梭机向 Killa 的地表降下，跟随着陆信标的指引，来到了一片遍布着无数火山岛屿的古老熔岩海之上。

战术系统记录了微弱的瞄准雷达脉冲信号，识别特征表明其来自于简陋的手持式系统，不足以对你的反制措施造成威胁。

original:

There are low-density voids beneath the surface; artificial density patterns. Caves or bunkers or tunnels. Ferric and non-ferric metals, some EM activity, some radioactivity. It reads about as standard as any report you've seen involving the smear and scatter of ruined human civilization across the Persean Sector.

translation:
扫描结果出来时，你的数据平板也随之响应。

original:
A shifty official meets your shuttle on the landing pad. Behind him, you spot temporary weapon emplacements and shield modules stamped with the crest of the Sindrian Diktat. Pale conscripts in battered armor eye you warily while they suck down narcotic smoke.

The official produces a trembling facsimile of a smile and looks you up and down. 

"A, a pilgrim are you?" he asks unconvincingly. "I'm afraid the shrine is closed today. And tomorrow. Security concerns. The situation has been... unstable."

一名狡诈的官员在停机坪上看见了你的穿梭机。在他身后，你看到贴着 辛达强权 徽标的临时武器阵地和护盾模块。面色苍白的征召兵穿着破烂不堪的护甲，一边吸着麻醉烟，一边警惕地盯着你。

original:
The shifty official meets your shuttle on the landing pad. Behind him, you spot temporary weapon emplacements and shield modules stamped with the crest of the Sindrian Diktat. Pale conscripts in battered armor eye you warily while they suck down narcotic smoke.

"立正！" 这名官员来接见你时，对着征召兵们大声喊道。接着他对你悄声耳语，距离近的有些过头："我刚刚还没说，如果您需要任何东西，任何！来铲除这些卢德恐怖分子..." 他没再继续说下去，只是期望从你眼中看到一丝认可。

original:
Not quite an hour later, you find yourself at the bottom of the sea, in the Luddic shrine of Volturn. It is a creaking and unnervingly humid inspection module at the end of a modified extraction stack; a metal proboscis thrust into the depths of Volturn.

It is also filled with guns, explosives, grenades, cellmags. Crates and racks are piled high, making the small space more cramped. A small shrine is set in an open space under a round diamond-matrix viewport which holds back a titanic mass of water. A few candles struggle to maintain even a decent flicker among the ranks of their dead comrades.

There are pilgrims here, of a sort. Their unwashed bodies smell of sweat and smoke, they speak and pray quietly. The curate sacraria re-lights a candle from one that is burning, and offers one for you to do the same.
translation:
不到一小时，你已深入海底，抵达 Volturn 的卢德 圣地。那是一个潮湿的探测舱室，位于改良型钻井的末端，嘎吱作响，令人不安，如同刺入 Volturn 深处的长喙。

这里还填满了枪支，炸药，榴弹，弹匣。板条箱和架子高高堆起，让本就狭小的空间愈发拥挤。那圆形的金刚石观察窗，将亿万吨水体阻隔在外，其下的空地上布置着一个小小的圣地。一些蜡烛在它们那一排排熄灭的同道之中挣扎着，闪烁出恰到好处的微光。

这里有一些勉强算是朝圣者的人，他们安静地交谈和祈祷着，未经清洗的身躯散发着汗水和烟熏的气息。神龛祭司用已燃的烛火点亮了另一支，也给你一支让你跟上。

The curate leads you to the back of an entry hall and pulls back a heavy curtain. The metal rings attaching it to a rail above clatter, dropping flakes of rust.

Perhaps this is a shrine of humility?

It is a small thing set in the back of a back room, rows of candles are arrayed around the wooden centerpiece carved with images of Ludd's travails. The candles are all dead, but the place is illuminated by dim shafts of light let in by grimy portholes.

original:
Curate Sacraria Standfast coolly acknowledges your presence. She is armed with a small pistol, politely holstered but with the clasp impolitely loosed.

She is equal parts perplexed and annoyed when you request to see the shrine, but she draws back the dusty curtains for you and stands aside.

The shrine looks as abandoned as ever in this back room. Rows of unlit candles are arrayed around the wooden centerpiece carved with images of Ludd's travails. The place is illuminated only by dim shafts of light let in by grimy portholes.

当你提出要参拜圣地的时候，困惑与些许厌烦两种情绪同等地浮现在了她的脸上，但她依旧为你拉下了尘封的幕帘，并站到了一旁。

在这间后屋中的圣地，看起来已被遗忘了许久。一排排蜡烛环绕着中心的木雕，其上镌刻着卢德的艰苦历程。烛火早已尽数熄灭，但透过那蒙尘的舷窗，一缕幽光依旧笼罩着这个地方。

original:
Specks float on blue-black like stars in space in the light cast out into the crushing depths. It is an almost unsettling wrongness from a familiar image. Motes of something or other flick to and fro.

"Life prevails even here, under unthinkable oppression," the curate says. "Let us be thankful, too, for the ingenuity granted to us by Providence," she taps the pressure hull, which resounds dully. "See? We do not hate all technology."
translation:
蓝黑色的海洋之上光影斑驳，如同穹顶之上的璀璨星辰，闪耀的光芒穿过重重阻碍，直至破碎的凶险深渊。此形此景几乎是令人如坐针毡般的离经叛道，违背了熟悉的循规蹈矩。点点微尘在其中忽隐忽现，往返穿梭。

"即使在这里，在难以想象的高压之下，生命仍然能蓬勃绽放。" 祭司说道，"让我们也心怀感激吧，感激上天赐予我们的智慧。" 她轻轻敲打着压力外壳，后者回应以低沉的回响，"看到了吗？我们也并不抵触所有科技。"

With the flash of official iconography, instructions are returned from the orbital navigation service which attempts to track the innumerable human-made artifacts of the Volturnian sea - floating habitats, sprawling farm envelopes, transient mining platforms, and even ancient-style seafaring vessels.

Your shuttle pierces the atmosphere in a long descent arc, politely slowing to under the speed of sound as it approaches a bank of thick fog illuminated by Askonia's primary. What at first looks like an ethereal castle is revealed by proximity to be a dismal, jostling accretion of barges parasited to a retired extraction rig.
translation:
随着官方图标的闪烁，轨道导航服务机构传回了指示。该机构同时也致力于搜寻 Volturn 海洋里那无数的人工遗物 —— 浮动栖所，杂乱延伸着的农业舱，临时采矿平台，甚至是古代样式的航海船只。

你的 穿梭机 拖着长长的降落尾迹，穿过了大气层。随着那 Askonia 主星所照亮的浓雾渐渐靠近，你礼貌地将速度降至亚音速。起初你好像见到一座飘渺空灵的城堡，近看才发现是一座阴郁的废弃钻井平台，周边挤满了一大堆寄生虫似的驳船。

original:
How old must it be, thousands of cycles?

If you had been asked a shift ago, your reasonable reply would have been to call it a myth. The Onslaught Mk.I could easily be a just-so founding narrative element of the Human Domain, a story about united struggle and hardship against an implacable Other with a shiny bit of military kit in center stage. An imagined avatar of the empire's holy trinity: military, industry, gate system.

Yet here that avatar appears, unbelievably far and wayward from the heart of the Human Domain - or even what was once the Domain's frontiers a thousand cycles ago.

Your ops chief, unperturbed, looks to you for confirmation. Words are unneeded, the question is clear: send in the salvors?
translation:
它究竟存在了多久？成千上万个星历年？

如果在一个星历日前被问及，照理，你会称其为一个传说。攻势 Mk.I 很容易被当作 人之领 恰到好处的创世叙事元素 —— 一个关于团结抗争无情异族的艰辛故事，核心点缀着一件闪亮的军事装备。那是帝国三位一体的想象化身：军事、工业、星门系统。

然而这个化身此刻正现身于此，并难以置信地远离 人之领 的中心 —— 甚至比一千个星历年前的 人之领 边疆更加遥远荒僻。

你的行动长官神色如常，等待着你的确认。他的问题不言自明：是否要派遣打捞员们？

original:
This gives your officers pause - Ops calls a hold order while the situation is assessed. Internal self-defense systems activating? War-drone deployment?

Only silence.

Then acoustics picks up a few taps as salvors secure themselves to bulkheads, powering down their tools and, no doubt, reaching for what small-arms they do carry.

Still, no movement.

Low, steady EM activity - just the repeater, a chorus of them in fact, mechanically intoning the same message to one another.
translation:
这让军官们犹豫起来 —— 行动长下达了暂停指令，等待态势评估。自卫系统启动？战斗无人机部署？

一片寂静。

随后，声学设备捕捉到几声轻敲，那是打捞员们正在舱壁上固定自己，关闭电子工具，以及毫无疑问的，掏出随身的小型武器。

仍然没有任何动静。

低而稳定的电磁活动 —— 只有中继器，一群中继器的合唱，机械地向彼此发出相同的信息。

original:
Fevered analysis proceeds. In the midst of what appears to be structured noise buried in the analog waveform - datasets which are insensible without context - analysis teams discover a set of coordinates; a position at some distance from the small gravity well you're orbiting in archaic but parseable Domain astrogation units. The message still repeats itself.

"The signal is weak," your sensors officer says. "Unlikely to be picked up by anything that isn't in close-order formation with the... the hull. Tactical telemetry to coordinate distributed systems?"
translation:
分析工作火热地进行着。在看似结构性噪音的模拟波形深处 —— 那些缺乏上下文便无法理解的数据集 —— 分析团队发现了一组坐标；一个用古老但可解析的 人之领 天文导航单位标注的位置，与你正在环绕的小型重力井保持着一定距离。信号仍在持续重复着。

"信号很微弱，" 你的传感器技官说道，"除非与...船体保持密集编队，否则任何设备都难以捕捉。是协调分布式系统的战术遥测信号吗？"

original:
Cautiously, team by team, your operations chief reactivates exploration and assessment of the hulk.

Bafflingly crude automation is wormed throughout the ship, whispering to itself. Interfaces are built on familiar fundamental principles, but aesthetically red-shifted, seeming from an alien culture.

What records remain are damaged where they aren't missing entirely. The logs tell of aeons of war in the darkness between the stars. Human crew in and out of cryo, continually diminished, replaced by the augmented wounded, then the cyborg rebuilds, and then, and then... this exhausted humming, clicking thing threaded throughout the ship.
translation:
慎之又慎，一队接一队，你的行动主管重启了对残骸的勘探与评估。

令人费解的原始自动化系统在整艘舰船中蔓延，低声自语。交互设施用熟悉的基本原理而构成，但其设计美学发生了红移，仿佛源自异界文明。

残存的记录大多损坏，或干脆完全缺失。那些日志诉说着恒星间黑暗深渊里绵延万古的战争。人类船员在低温休眠中进进出出，持续减员，先由强化过的伤员接替，然后是机械和生物的重构体，再然后，再然后...只剩下这遍布舰体、精疲力竭的嗡鸣声与咔嗒声。

original:
The logs are empty for long periods- dark, hibernating leaps. Then there is a noted uptick in activity less than 200 standard cycles ago. The enemy is only identified as "Threat". A datastore reference leads to blocks of information decayed by time. But the reconstruction algorithms leap into action and, despite troublingly low reliability ratings, sew together a set of files. 

Patch notes.

The hardware specs are arcane, the software obtuse and plagued by null library calls, but the common language of human mathematics sketches out the intent. There, your technology officer's team assembles a new spec of the sensor modifications required to detect this "Threat".

Adapting these requirements on your relatively modern systems is a far easier task than the labors described by the ancients.
translation:
日志存在多段很长时间的空白 —— 应该是停止活动的休眠期。在接下来在距今 200 个标准星历年之内，活动记录出现了显著激增。敌人仅被标识为 "威胁"。数据存储索引指向的几个信息块已经被时间侵蚀损坏。但随着重建算法的介入，一组文件还是被拼凑了出来，尽管可靠性评级低得令人不安。

补丁说明。

虽然硬件配置写得晦涩难懂，一团糟的软件里还充斥着无效库调用，但人类数学的通用语言还是勾勒出了设计意图。凭借那些，你的技术军官团队整合出一套探测此 "威胁" 所需的新传感器改装需求方案。

将这些需求方案适配到你相对现代的系统上，远比古人描述的艰巨工程要轻松得多。

original:
Your connection request is accepted promptly.

$personName looks you over appraisingly. You get the feeling that $heOrShe could probably guess your credit balance to the nearest hundred-count.

"If you're looking for an experienced freelance officer - on a strictly temporary basis - I'm looking to take on a client. My asking rate is high, but you'd be losing money trusting one of your ships to someone with less experience."
OR
Your comms request is promptly accepted.

$personName looks you over for a moment then nods as if you've passed some kind of test.

"If you are looking to hire an experienced combat officer on a limited-time contract, then you've come to the right place. I think you will find my terms reasonable.  Excellence does not come cheap."
translation:
你的连接请求被迅速接受了。

$personName 上下打量了你一番。你觉得$heOrShe说不定能猜透你的星币余额，偏差不过百位。

"如果你正在寻找一个经验丰富的自由职业军官的话，那正巧，我也在找一个客户，不过仅限临时雇佣。我的要价很高，但把你的船交给那些经验不足的家伙会更加赔钱。"
OR
你的通讯请求被迅速接受了。

$personName 看了你一会儿，然后点了点头，好比你通过了某种考验一样。

"如果你想短期雇佣一名有经验的战斗人员，那么你就找对地方了。我觉得你马上就会发现我的开价并不离谱。毕竟，卓越从不廉价。"

original:
Your connection request is accepted after an extended delay.

$personName looks you over with barely concealed suspicion.

"You have a bit of a reputation in the, ah, freelancing community. But I do need the credits. So: if you need the services of a better ship's captain than you probably deserve, here's your chance. I will, of course, have to charge a premium for the risk entailed by your engagement."
OR
The comms link opens after a significant delay.

$personName looks you over with a flicker of disapproval.

"I've heard of you, $playerName, and despite your... mixed reputation, I am willing to deal. After all," $heOrShe takes a philosophical tone, "I wouldn't be a mercenary if the offer of enough credits didn't turn my head against my better judgment."

"Now impress me."
translation:
你的连接请求在一段漫长的延迟后终于被接受了。

$personName 以不加掩饰的怀疑态度打量着你。

"你的名声在那个，啊，在那个自由佣兵圈子里不太好。不过我现在的确得赚些星币。所以如果你想雇一个活干得好，更配得上你的家伙，那么现在机会来了。当然，我将不得不为受你聘用所带来的风险加收一笔费用。"
OR
通讯链接在经过明显的拖延之后接通了。

$personName 看了看你，眼中带着一丝不满。

"我听说过你，$playerName，尽管你的名声有点... 褒贬不一，但我还是愿意和你谈谈。毕竟，" $heOrShe摆出了一副豁达的口吻，"有钱能使鬼推磨，如果我不是这种人，就不会干雇佣兵这一行。"

"怎样，让我开开眼吧。"

original:
You input the connection request. The standby signal persists for so long you are about to ask comms to check their equipment - and the channel opens. 

$personName looks you over with barely concealed hostility.

"Your reputation precedes you, $playerName. Frankly, I don't need your credits. And I don't want to see your face."

$HeOrShe pauses for a moment. 

"Safe travels."

$HeOrShe cuts the comm link.
OR
The commlink blinks on standby for a near eternity. Your comms officer indicates that it is indeed working correctly and shrugs. You are about to order the request canceled when the connection opens.

$personName looks to you in mock surprise. "I'm so sorry for the delay, it's just that I've heard all the stories about $playerName, and I couldn't believe it was really you. Contacting me! What luck."

You begin to sense an air of sarcasm as $heOrShe continues, "... Because now I get to tell everyone that I got the chance to tell you to suck vacuum!"

The link is hard-cut while $personName is performing a rude-gesture. Your comms officer keeps a stony face toward their console as they clear the screen.
translation:
你提交了连接请求。待机信号持续了很久，你正准备让通讯军官检查设备时，频道接通了。

$personName 带着几乎毫不掩饰的敌意看了你一眼。

"你已经臭名远扬了，$playerName。老实说，我不需要你的星币。我也不想看到你的脸。"

$HeOrShe停顿了一会儿。

"出门时小心点。"

$HeOrShe切断了通讯链接。
OR
通讯链接的待机画面一直在没完没了地闪烁着。你的通讯军官耸了耸肩，表示它确实在正常工作。你正准备下令取消这个请求时，通讯接通了。

$personName 看向你，装作一副惊讶的样子。"很抱歉耽误了您宝贵的时间，我才刚听说了所有关于 $playerName 的故事，有点不敢相信真的遇到了您。而您居然主动跟我联系？真走运！"

你开始感觉到一种讽刺的气氛，而这时$heOrShe继续说了下去，"... 因为现在我可以和大伙炫耀，我终于有机会对你讲 —— 吸他妈的真空去吧！"

$personName 做出一个粗鲁的手势并强行切断了通讯。你的通讯军官朝着控制台板着脸，把屏幕清空了。

$HisOrHer quickly glances down at a screen then back to you, "Which would be, ah, on the order of $entity.LP_titheDGS credits."
translation:
"好吧。" 这个左径分子有些犹豫地说到，"尽管我们说得天花乱坠，称我们携手同行的道途会是多么蒙福而丰盛....但上天只眷顾那些懂得接受摆在面前的恩赐的人 —— 以及那些愿以与其罪孽相称的什一税来谦卑己身的人。"

$HisOrHer飞快地瞥了一眼屏幕，然后又望向你，"而这份罪业，啊，恰好等价于 $entity.LP_titheDGS 星币。"

original:
"My thanks to Providence!" the $rank exclaims, then calls back to $hisOrHer bridge crew, "Persecution proves our devotion! The unbelievers now beg us to share our blessings." $HeOrShe turns back, troubled, "Um. However. My standing is... limited. It is not my place to welcome you to the fold under our hammer and sword, no matter the tithe you offer unto our holy war. You will have to speak with a shepherd of greater authority than I at one of our gathering-places in the fringe worlds." 

"Of course," $heOrShe is abashed now, "I cannot tell you where a station of the Luddic Path is located. I am pledged before Providence to secrecy and it would be a sin to swear false oath. That path must be yours to discover."

"I suggest you pray for revelation," $heOrShe says earnestly.
translation:
"赞美上天眷顾！" $rank 喊到，随后回过头去向$hisOrHer的舰桥船员说到，"迫害证明了我们的虔诚！不信者现在正恳求我们分享祝福。" $HeOrShe转了回来，似乎是有些困扰，"呃，但要怎么说呢，因为我的位置...有限，不管你要为我们的圣战事业贡献多少的什一税，我都无权以锤与剑的名义接纳你加入我们的教团。但你可以在我们位于边缘星区世界的某个集会所，找一位比我权威更高的牧师谈谈。"

"当然了，" $heOrShe现在显得有些惭愧，"我不能告诉你 卢德左径 的空间站具体在哪。我在上天面前立誓保密，而发假誓是罪过。那条路必须由你自己去发现。"

"我建议你为启示而祈祷。" $heOrShe真诚地说到。

original:
Your $shipOrFleet maneuvers closer to the asteroid.

Your sensors officer gives a shout of alarm - bogeys are spilling out of the asteroid, clouds of loosely-piled regolith and stealth-sheath panels spinning away as they are caught by thruster-bursts. The angular forms of Domain XIV Battlegroup hulls appear, veteran ships judging by the obvious field repairs. The IDs are automatically tagged and collated into the tactical display.

You have no time to ask why a ghost fleet from the First AI War has ambushed you.

Very faint and lossy. We're really only picking this up because of the MILAUX package installed in our comms system to help integrate with Hegemony fleet actions."

original:
A party of the inhabitants wearing masks and hoods meet you halfway.

Their guards, at the back, hold weapons slung; standard Domain-fab carbines. Their clothing is repurposed utility forgecloth, the type used to line cargo bays and maintenance conduits. They wear adornments denoting status made of worn but well-polished military insignia; winged phoenixes and stars. Hegemony crew survivors. And they've been here for a long time, from the looks of it.

A leader steps forward, pulling off her goggles. "Did we win?" she asks.
translation:
一群身着面罩与兜帽的当地住民在途中与你们会面了。

这群人的卫兵在队伍的后方，随身的标准预制型人之领卡宾枪被吊在背带上。他们的衣着是改制后再利用的勤务合成服，就是在负责管理货舱和钻维护通道的人员身上会看到的那种。但他们的身上依旧有着一些用来表明职务与地位的装饰品，由磨损严重但依旧擦得锃亮的军徽制成 —— 那是双翼绽开的不死鸟与群星。这群人是 霸主 的幸存船员，而且根据他们的样子来看，这群人已经在这里待了相当，相当长的一段时间了。

他们的领队走上前来，一边摘下了她的护目镜。"我们赢了吗？" 她问道。

original:
The leader exchanges glances with her companions, taking in the implication of your words.

You are invited to their settlement, to continue your conversation out of the cold. These castaways have not forgotten hospitality, in their manner. 

Or, perhaps, their leader - an elder by the name of Alo Skiron called "commander" by her lieutenants - knows the wisdom of controlling the spread of potentially explosive news from the outside Sector.
translation:
头领与她的同伴们交换着眼神，尝试着接受你话里的言外之意。

你受邀进入了他们的聚落，寻一个稍微暖和一点的场所继续谈话。至少这些落难者依旧没有忘记基本的待客之道 —— 至少是以他们的标准来说。

亦或者，是他们的头领 —— 一位被她的 "中尉" 们称呼为 "指挥官" 的，名叫 Alo Skiron 的长老 —— 明智地选择了一种能够将外部星域中传来的爆炸性新闻控制在最低传播限度的手段。

original:
You are led to a cluster of neat, low structures; earthworks and hull panels spotted with forgeglass and chimney. The streets are clean and the citizenry uniformed by job role. Despite fixing you with open stares, they do not falter in their assignments.

Commander Skiron welcomes you and your party into a central meeting hall. It is warm, and festooned with Hegemony paraphernalia: uniforms, weapons, etched insignia from supply-case lids. The hand-worked reverence brings to mind a Luddic shrine that has undergone conversion to worship a martial god.

You pretend to sip a wretched yeast-derived ersatz tea - coffee maybe? - given to you by Skiron's attendants.
translation:
你被带往了一群简单，低矮的建筑群中。这些建筑大多由土方与星舰的船体结构板构成，烟囱和预铸玻璃点缀其中。街道十分干净，居民们身着自己职业对应的制服。尽管他们的目光都赤裸裸地盯着你们，但没有一人停下自己手上的工作。

Skiron 指挥官将你们一行人迎进了一座中心议会厅。这里不仅相当温暖，还装饰着 霸主 相关的随身装备：制服，武器，补给箱盖上抠下的徽记等等。这些手工制作的纪念物几乎让你以为这是一座卢德圣地，只不过进行了一些翻修，好重新用来敬拜一位军武之神。

对于 Skiron 的侍从端上来的劣质酵母衍生物代茶 —— 说不定是代咖啡？—— 你则是假装抿了一口。

original:
"Will you bring word of us to the Persean Hegemony of the Fourteenth Battlegroup? They must have survived, yes? The Protocols promise that you will be rewarded, and we, saved."

(Behind her, in unison, you hear intoned the words "Reward and Salvation," in not quite the sing-song of group prayer.)

Now you can see the strange gleam in Skiron's eyes, as if she is looking up at the unwitting savior from her religion. And at the same time, something like fear, even panic, under the mania; you are an outsider.

They don't have outsiders here.
translation:
"你愿意将我们的消息传达给 第十四战斗群英仙座星域霸主统摄政权 吗？他们肯定幸存下来了，对吗？纪律保证了你会得到嘉奖，而我们则会得到 —— 救赎。"

(在她身后，你又听到了人们齐声，用好似又不似祈祷与合唱的声音反复念着 "嘉奖与救赎"。)

现在 Skiron 像是看见了她信仰中的救世主一般，眼底正散发着奇异的微光。而与此同时，那眼神中在狂热之下也还埋藏着些许恐惧，甚至是惊慌，因为你是个外来者。

他们这里从来就没有过外来者。

original:
Your standard comms request gives no return. If there is a comms network, or even an emergency survival unit on the surface, it's either damaged or can't make a connection.  

Your comms officer tries more unconventional workarounds, from a suite of ancient standards used to ping drifting Domain-era relics to the latest suite of underworld methods that would earn a stern look from any honest customs officer; lossy but easily mistaken for background noise by sensor grids. All attempts are fruitless.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. We might have to make contact the old fashioned way," your comms officer reports apologetically.
translation:
你发送的标准通讯请求并未得到任何答复。这颗星球的地表上没有通讯器网络，甚至连一台紧急求生通讯器都没有，就算有也应该全坏了，或是无法建立通讯链接。

你的通讯军官尝试采用一系列非常规手段，从一套用来定位从 人之领 时代以来就在深空中飘流的遗物的旧式通讯标准，再到一套容易用传感器阵列背景噪声掩盖的地下帮派专用最新低保真通讯标准，能让正派的海关人员板起脸侧目而视的那种。但这些尝试最终都只是徒劳罢了。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam，我们说不定只能用老办法和他们接触了。" 你的通讯军官带着一丝歉意向你报告。

original:
The comms crackle, forming an image.

"Captain $playerName," the Persean League $post stares at you with undisguised hostility. "You were once one of us. You believed in building a new sector together." $HisOrHer voice drops, "I wonder, though, did you ever believe or was it always a trick. What could you have gained that is worth such a betrayal of our ideals?"

$HeOrShe pauses for half a breath, then instead of admonishing you further taps the comms cutoff.
OR
The comms form an image, and crackling into focus.

"To think you were once part of the League," $heOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head in disgust. "You've chosen barbarism, so we shall deal with you in the only language you know: brute force."

$HeOrShe makes an abrupt sign to cut the comms.

通讯发出嘈杂声，形成了一个图像。

"$playerName舰长，" 英仙座联盟 的 $post 毫不掩饰敌意地盯着你。"你曾经是我们中的一员。你曾相信我们可以共同建设一个新的星域。" $HisOrHer的声音低沉下来，"不过，我想知道，你是否曾经真正相信过我们的理想，还是这只是你的一个诡计。背叛我们的理想，你究竟能得到什么好处？"

$HeOrShe停顿了一下，没有进一步责备你，而是切断了通讯。
OR
通讯发出嘈杂声，形成了一个图像。

"真没想到你曾经成为过联盟的一员，" $heOrShe厌恶地摇了摇头，"你选择了野蛮，那么我们就用你唯一能理解的语言来对付你：暴力。"

$HeOrShe突然做了个手势，切断了通讯。

original:
"Our partnership has been productive," $heOrShe says, "I trust you can handle the simple requirements of this task." 

$HeOrShe taps at a datapad, summoning a starmap. "There is an abandoned $rdsm_target on $rdsm_planetName in the $rdsm_systemName, $rdsm_dist light-years away. It was once property of the $rdsm_megacorpName megacorporation, not that it's mattered for 200 cycles."

"I will provide you with a datacore and a precise diagram of the $rdsm_target. Exchange my datacore for the one you will find per my specifications. Make it look natural, like it's been untouched since the Collapse." 

"If there's anything else around to plunder in the colony, have at it. My only concern is that the datacore is in place and the one you find is returned here to me. You'll be paid $rdsm_reward credits when you return to me with the datacore."
translation:
"我们的合作一直很高效，" $heOrShe说，"我相信你能完成这个简单的任务。"

$HeOrShe滑动数据平板，召唤出一张星图。"在距离这里 $rdsm_dist 光年处，{$rdsm_systemName 中的 $rdsm_planetName 上，有一座废弃的 $rdsm_target。它曾属于 $rdsm_megacorpName 集团，但那已经是 200 星历年以前的事情了。"

"我会给你提供一个数据核心和一份关于 $rdsm_target 的准确示意图。找到我需要的数据核心，用我给你的数据核心替换原有那个。做的自然点，让它看起来就像大崩塌以来一直未被触碰过。"

"如果殖民地周围还有其它有价值的东西，尽管带走。我唯一关心的是，我的数据核心要放在原位，而你找到的那个要拿回来给我。等你带着数据核心回来时，我会付你 $rdsm_reward 星币。"

original:
You order a few cargo crates loaded with supplies then rigged with visual-audio-radio emergency beacons and disposable landing rockets.

It's an old trick when dealing with decivs, but it usually works. Whether they accept the supplies as payment, bribery, or simply relatively high tech goods in an environment largely cut off from interstellar commerce, the value of these crates is literally astronomical.

你调来了几箱补给，给它们装上了声光无线电三合一紧急信标，还有一次性着陆火箭。

这算是处理蛮荒人的常用手段，但一般都能起效。不管他们是把这些补给当成你的报酬、贿赂，还是单纯知道在这种基本和星际经贸无缘的环境里，这些补给算是罕有相对高科技的产物，这几箱东西总之对他们能算得上价值非凡。

original:
"Drop telemetry reads successful surface contact," your sensors officer reports, who taps at their console then mumbles something into another comms channel. "Confirmed by $shipOrFleet instruments."

Tactical signals acknowledgement, then says "Mission is go." 

The landing shuttles glitter with a burst of propulsion then drop in silent formation toward the surface. The cargo drop was close enough to the target zone to distract any decivs present, but far enough - hopefully - to clear or persuade away any active resistance.

Within minutes, shuttles report unimpeded landing. Salvor crews deploy immediately through the settling dust cloud, only lightly armed to ensure maximum operational speed.
translation:
"遥测数据显示已成功建立地表联系。" 你的传感器技官报告道，他轻敲控制台，然后在另一个通讯频道低声说了些什么，"$shipOrFleet的仪器已对此进行了确认。"

战术信号得到了确认，随后传来指令："任务继续。"

在推进器的一阵闪光中，登陆穿梭机以静默的队形向地表降落。登陆仓投放位置距离目标区域足够近，足以分散所有在场蛮荒人的注意力，但也足够远 —— 希望如此 —— 以清除或劝退任何可能的主动抵抗。

几分钟后，穿梭机报告已顺利着陆。打捞小组迅速穿过逐渐散去的烟尘进行部署，他们仅携带了轻武器，以确保最大的行动速度。

original:
The small salvage team accesses the $rdsm_megacorpName $rdsm_target, cutting through sealed locks and blasting weak points as needed. Their work is sloppy, even crude, compared to your ops chief's usual standards - intentionally so. The physical evidence of your crews' intrusion is meant to appear to be the work of local decivs' random plundering rather than a targeted job.

Objective found, your salvors swap out the specified data core and install the fake. They carefully create the appearance of random tampering, plundering a few obvious modular and interface components that would be of interest to cut-off decivs, then re-dust the scene.

From orbit, your sensors officer spots movement in nearby terrain; armed locals. The salvors perform a quick evac before they can bring heavy weapons to bear and, aside from a few light energy weapon burns on the shuttle plating, there's no harm done.
translation:
打捞小组成功潜入了 $rdsm_megacorpName 的 $rdsm_target，他们破除了密码锁，并在必要时对薄弱点进行了爆破。与行动长官平日执行任务的严谨标准相比，这次行动显得颇为马虎，甚至有些粗鲁 —— 但这正是他们有意为之。这样做的目的是为了让船员们入侵的痕迹更像是当地蛮荒人随性掠夺的结果，而非有针对性的行动。

确认目标后，打捞人员迅速替换了指定的数据核心，并安装了伪造的数据核心。他们细心地制造出了随机破坏的假象，带走了一些会引起蛮荒人兴趣的模块和接口组件，然后重新布置了现场，覆盖灰尘以掩盖痕迹。

从轨道上，你的传感器技官报告附近地形中有移动痕迹；是本地武装力量。在他们架设重型武器之前，打捞小组迅速撤离。除了穿梭机外壳上留下几处轻型能量武器的灼烧痕迹外，并未受到任何伤害。

original:
A flight of shuttles is deployed, armed lightly enough to show respect to the smugglers but without being outwardly conspicuous. What appears to be a motley logistics crew with token guards approach the armored doors of the hidden base, hauling their basic cargo-moving tools: robotic lifts and agrav-fitted pallets, the usual.

Upon entrance, at the signal, weapons-fire erupts from the entire party. False air tanks conceal light arms and single-shot anti-armor tubes; utility panniers are stuffed with grenades and miniature assault drones. All are loosed in a few seconds of blinding violence which catch the smugglers completely off-guard.

After the initial shock comes the grind, and your marines pay for lack of heavy armor as they face recessed auto-turrets and not more than a few heavily armed criminals hiding in the worm-tunnels which loop through and around the rotten stone.
translation:
一组穿梭机被部署出去，它们只有轻量的武装，既表现出对走私者的尊重，又不至于太过显眼。一支看似由杂牌后勤人员和几名象征性的守卫组成的队伍，正朝着隐藏基地的装甲大门靠近，他们拖拽着基础的货物搬运工具：机器人升降机和装有反重力装置的托盘，这些都是再平常不过的东西。

一进入基地，接到信号后，整支队伍立即开火。伪装的氧气罐中藏着轻武器和单发反装甲炮；杂物袋里塞满了手榴弹和迷你攻击无人机。在短短几秒内，就发生了一场令人眼花缭乱的火力倾泻，走私者们完全措手不及。

最初的震惊过后，便是艰苦的鏖战，面对着隐蔽的自动炮塔，还有大量藏在蜿蜒曲折、遍布泥浆的虫穴中全副武装的犯罪分子，你的陆战队员因为缺乏重型装甲而付出了代价。

original:
A close approach by salvor teams shows a heat source, and glint of artificial light. An anomalous pocket of operational life-support, the emergency subsection backup of a backup somehow running for tens, hundreds of cycles? It is unlikely.

Your officers always perform the standard transponder pings at the start of a salvage operation; it is part of the ritual of legal salvage (though records of legality are fabricated easily enough, when required, and doing a good job of it is a sign of respect appreciated by customs officers across the Persean Sector).

It would be awkward to stumble into some hermit's cell, ideologue's oubliette, or pirate holdfast unannounced, so your comms officer takes charge of a new signalling attempt with a full range of communication protocols, from an overpowered standard holo-link to mere radio, laser staccato, and even an esoteric grav-pulse relay.
translation:
打捞小组抵近勘察后发现了一处热源与人造光源的反光。一个异常运行的生命维持系统气穴，某套备用系统的紧急子模块竟持续运转了数十乃至数百个星历年？这极不寻常。

你的军官在打捞作业前总会执行标准的应答器脉冲扫描 —— 这是合法打捞作业的一部分 (尽管在必要时可以轻松伪造合法性记录，但做好这点会赢得英仙座星域各地海关官员的尊重)。

Your Ops chief oversees a careful breach of the habitat, wary both for traps and the need to not disrupt the surviving bubble of life-support. Survivors make salvage rights more complex, but they're generally thankful enough for rescue to come to a profitable accommodation.

original:
A spot of green-yellow brightness at the end of a foggy corridor; the image stabilizer kicks in, cancelling the jerky hop-step of the lead salvor's micro-g movement.

A tiny garden grows wild within this celestial tomb. Some kind of fissile backup battery has survived, clicking away the decay of heavy elements to heat and light a tiny bubble of life. Moisture condenses in a murky lens of slush on a hubward window, then falls slowly in huge drops through the micro-g of the habitat's spin, past the glowplates, toward the mosses and molds and tiny flowers growing on the warm heaps of droppings and husks of vermin.

On a life-giving terran world, this would be nothing more than a dank pit. Here, it is a miracle.
translation:
雾蒙蒙的走廊尽头有一点黄绿色的光斑；随着图像稳定器的启动，领队打捞员在微重力环境中跳跃式前进的抖动也被抵消。

在这座天体坟墓中，有一小片花园在恣意生长。某种裂变备用电池仍在运作，以重元素衰变释放的热量与光线维持着这微小的生命气泡。水汽在朝向枢纽的窗户上凝结成浑浊的冰泥透镜，随后在聚居地自转的微重力环境中化为巨大液滴缓缓坠落，掠过发光板，洒向暖烘烘的粪堆与害虫空壳上滋生的苔藓、霉菌与细小花丛。

若在适宜生命的类地行星上，这不过是个潮湿的坑洼。但在此地，却堪称奇迹。

original:
Upon entry, your salvors discover first one, then many of the same portrait adorning the interior sections of the hab. Smashed busts line the primary reception concourse. Above all stood a statue of the selfsame likeness churned out of a simple rock-foam fabricator, polished, and gilded; it now lies face-planted into the deckplates, the gilding half-stripped.

All bear the face of a strong-jawed man who looks down upon the empty halls and dead plazas of the hab, his gaze fatherly; stern, and proud. And in all cases defaced: the nose smashed off, crude words painted or, more often, burnt across his image.

Even his name, whatever it was, has been erased from every databank by a spitefully determined noise-wipe virus.
translation:
进入后，救援人员先发现一幅，继而发现多幅相同的肖像装饰着居住站的内部区域。破碎的半身像沿着主接收港区排列，最显眼处矗立着一座由简易岩石泡沫制造机批量生产的同款雕像，经打磨与镀金；如今它面朝下瘫倒在甲板上，镀金层已半剥落。

所有雕像皆刻画着同一位颌骨坚毅的男子，他俯视着居住站空荡的走廊与死寂的广场，目光如父辈般慈爱，却又严厉而骄傲。每尊雕像都遭到了玷污：鼻子被砸碎，粗鄙的涂鸦，更多是烧灼的痕迹，这些都遍布在他的形象上。

就连他的名字 —— 无论曾是何名 —— 也被某种恶意十足的噪声擦除病毒从所有数据库中彻底抹去。

Exploring further, the salvor teams discover the remains of a palace dominating an entire section of the hab.

Once a vast construction, now just two blackened support legs remain amidst the rubble of its shattered visage. Parklands, now reduced to lone and level ash, follow the curve of the habitat's shell.

Whoever the man was, he was first exalted and then hated in equal measure.

在进一步的探索中，打捞小组发现一座宫殿遗迹占据了居住站的整个区域。

这座曾经宏伟的建筑，如今仅剩两根焦黑的支撑柱伫立在残破的废墟中。依照居住站外壳曲线延伸的园林，已化作孤寂而平坦的灰烬。

original:
Your salvors fan out through the station, discovering makeshift barricades around the access tubes to the executive and security modules. There's interior combat damage caused by handheld weapons, many of which appear to have been adapted from mining tools. A strike turned deadly.

The security forces employed riot-suppression armaments at first, then rapidly escalated to their cache of "vac-safe" weapons intended for boarding and infantry action within ship hulls or station modules. 

The miners appear to have responded by up-armoring standard haz suits, adding breastplates worked from mining drones' blast panels, slotted visors cut from rolls of nuke-rated anti-spall sheeting, and much other imaginative makeshift panoply.
translation:
你的打捞员们在空间站内散开搜查，发现通往行政与安防模块的通道管周围设有临时路障。内部存在手持武器造成的战斗痕迹 —— 其中许多显然由采矿工具改装而成。一场罢工演变为了致命冲突。

安保部队起初使用的是防暴武器，随后迅速升级为 "真空安全" 级别军火库 —— 这类装备本用于舰船舱内或空间站模块的登船与步兵作战。

矿工们的回应则是强化版的标准防护服：加装采矿无人机防爆板改造的胸甲、核爆级防碎片卷材切割而成的槽缝面罩，以及其他充满想象力的临时武装。

original:
These teams are experts at rapidly reconstructing the relevant events of a starship or space station's demise; such a narrative provides useful information about dangers and valuables.

Here, comms logs and surveillance gives meaning to the evidence of scattered damage caused by light firearms - local security was in the process of a major crackdown on a drug smuggling operation, and in an explosive confrontation appears to have caused a blowout of the primary hab section. The rest of the story is mere salvage for your waiting holds.

至于余下的故事，不过是你待装货舱中的普通打捞物罢了。

original:
Your salvors discover that comms and anti-collision weapon emplacements have been deliberately destroyed by careful strikes.

Closer examination shows evidence that a pirate ship docked - the brutal hull markings and garish paint job of the gutted hulk are a giveaway - but was completely disabled in the cargo bay by some kind of makeshift explosive adapted from on-hand mining equipment.

Their plundering mothership destroyed, the remaining pirates - operating a handful of light frigates and a wing of fighters - appear to have taken out their anger by strafing the station's hab modules and life support before going on their way.

The few miners who survived the immediate attack were doomed to a slow death.

随着劫掠母船被毁，驾驶着数艘轻型护卫舰与一支战机编队的残余海盗，似乎将怒火倾泻在空间站的居住模块与生命维持系统上，并在进行完扫射攻击后扬长而去。

少数在直接袭击中幸存的矿工，最终仍难逃缓慢死亡的命运。

One particular module of this research station appears to have been a bioweapons laboratory. The lab is - rather, was - hermetically sealed, and contains the ruins of state-of-the-art containment and decontamination facilities.

Naturally, something went terribly wrong. 

And as your techies analyze telemetry and what raw surveillance buffers the salvors on-station are able to transmit back to your $shipOrFleet, the disaster begins to look distinctly unnatural.

original:
"Sabotage," your ops chief mutters darkly.

The patchy surveillance shows a rapid spread of violent, painful demise beginning in atmospheric processing and spreading outward at the speed of fresh air through atmo conduits, tripping the broad-spectrum biohazard sensors one by one as the agent suffused through the station. But no alarm sounded for human ears.

Your salvage chief orders all remaining pockets of atmo purged, and strict quarantine procedures followed.

The bioweapons lab's computer core destroyed itself with a small bomb when a timed dead man's switch was not reset, so nothing of salable value remains, if indeed a buyer could be found for whatever biochemical horror was conjured here.
translation:
"蓄意破坏，" 你的行动长官阴沉地低语道。

断续的监控画面显示，一场迅猛而痛苦的死亡从大气处理系统爆发，以新鲜空气通过通气管道扩散的速度向外蔓延。当毒剂弥漫整个空间站时，广谱生物危害传感器接连被触发，但未响起任何人类可闻的警报。

你的打捞长官下令净化所有的残留气穴，并严格执行隔离程序。

生物武器实验室的计算机核心因定时自毁装置未被重置而通过小型炸弹进行了自毁，因此这里已不存在任何具有出售价值的物品 —— 即便真的有人愿意购买此处制造的生化恐怖产物。

original:
Salvor teams cut through fused locks and infiltrate the station. They find researchers, administrators, technicians down to the lowliest access-tunnel scrubber at their work-stations, or near enough. Quite dead, however. And even those who remained in pockets of viable atmo are surprisingly undecayed.

Their end was not pleasant, but it appears to have at least been very, very quick.

Your salvors and tech teams assemble evidence to reconstruct the event: a massive radiation pulse centered on Experiment Module B, which, judging from the gap between the ruins of Modules A and C, was almost entirely vaporized by the event.
translation:
打捞小组切开熔合的锁具并进入了空间站。他们发现研究员、行政人员、技术员乃至最低级的通道清洁工都倒在了工作岗位或附近区域，无一例外已经死亡。而即便是那些残留在可呼吸气穴中的人员，尸身也异常地并未腐烂。

他们的结局并不安详，但至少看来非常，非常迅速。

你的打捞员们与技术小组开始整合证据并重建事件：一场巨大辐射脉冲曾以 B 实验模块为中心爆发，根据 A 模块与 C 模块废墟间的缺口判断，该模块几乎在此事件中完全汽化。

original:
Although superficially intact, salvor teams soon find evidence of light weapons fire and the resulting carnage, thankfully long desiccated, decayed, and/or frozen depending on the run-down time of life support in any particular sector. 

The seemingly random spread and directionlessness of the violence suggests that the security systems of this station turned on its occupants all at once. The catastrophic results were not helped by the unusually strong internal security measures: hidden autoturrets set to kill, powered lockdown curtains which indiscriminately scissored obstructions, and nests of mobile suppression drones which could traverse small conduits and air ducts to find and "neutralize" any survivors.

Thankfully, the last of these measures has long run out of power.
translation:
尽管表面完好无损，打捞小组很快发现了轻武器射击的痕迹以及其造成的惨状，所幸这些遗骸因生命维持系统在不同区域的衰竭时间差异而早已干枯、腐烂或冻结。

暴力事件看上去似乎是随机蔓延且毫无方向性的，也暗示该空间站的安保系统曾集体反噬其居住者。这灾难性后果因异常严密的内部安防措施雪上加霜：暗藏的自动炮塔被设定为杀伤模式，动力封锁帘无差别地剪切着障碍物，成群的机动压制无人机能穿越狭窄的管道与风道，追踪并 "清除" 了任何幸存者。

谢天谢地，这套系统最后早已耗尽了能源。

original:
Despite the station's reactor being run down, and the power network itself highly degraded, your salvors are understandably paranoid. Your Ops Chief is more than satisfied to use their fear to emphasize the necessity of strict and systematic recovery protocols in this - and indeed every - recovery operation.

Try as they might to piece something together from station logs, it remains unclear to your tech team what precisely used the chief administrator's executive access codes to turn the security systems inward.

尽管空间站的反应堆已经停运，电力网络也严重衰变，但你的打捞员们仍难免草木皆兵。你的行动长官非常乐意利用这种恐惧心理，来强调此次 —— 实际上是每次 —— 打捞行动中严格执行系统性回收规程的必要性。

original:
The form matches the general pattern of Domain-era mining station designs, but with absolutely no provisions made for human occupation. No hab ring, no life support module, no shuttle receiving bays.

Instead, inactive drone rigs cluster around the ring-trusses. Ore receiving bays lay dark; an agglomeration of zero-G fabricators sprouts from the central spire over the tiers of darkened hangars and warehouses.

Despite the darkened exterior, sensors reports a mix of minor energy readings and the gentle ticking of particles which suggest a stock of concentrated transplutonics.
translation:
面前的物体看上去大致符合 人之领 时代的采矿空间站设计，但是完全没有任何为了人类居住所作的准备。没有居民环，没有维生系统，也没有穿梭机降落台。

取而代之的是环状桁架上四散的无人钻机。矿石接收仓隐藏在黑暗之中；一系列零重力制造厂点缀着中央尖塔，凌驾于漆黑一片的库房和机库之上。

虽然外部漆黑一片，传感器报告显示出一系列微弱的能量反应和轻微的粒子波动，表明此处聚集着密集的稀有元素。

original:
With a series of bangs, troopers in light combat frames burst through every entrance, shouting amplified orders, waving vicious little guns. 

Random INTSEC raid; you know enough to appear calm and keep your hands away from your sidearm.

Each patron is scanned and, in-turn, their fate is revealed by a subtle movement of the lead INTSEC officer signaling whether they are to be left alone or arrested. Most are spared.
translation:
身穿轻型战斗动力甲的士兵随着一连串的爆音从每个出入口鱼贯而入，口中命令凶狠咆哮、手中武器闪烁凶光。

这是 INTSEC 随机搜查；你很清楚此刻就得表现冷静，同时双手远离随身武器。

所有顾客都要逐一接受扫描，INTSEC 现场总指挥的一个小动作便会决定他们的命运：单独留下，或是当场逮捕。当然，大多数人都幸免于难。

original:
One group of spacers appears to believe they have something to hide. As the officer approaches, they break into action. One manages to half-draw a concealed weapon but is hit with the crack of an electrostun/restraint-foam round. The convulsing body crashes through a table, sending pieces of broken glass up in glittering parabolae.

The rest of the party are restrained and beaten, the drumming of clubs on flesh eventually overtaking the cries of pain and outrage. Outsiders look on in horror; the staff and locals have a glazed, unfocused expression; it is safest to see nothing.
translation:
一群宇宙民似乎是在隐藏些什么。当官员走近时，他们突然开始行动。其中一人刚刚将一把隐藏的武器掏出一半，就被电击/束缚泡沫弹击中。仍在抽搐着的身体撞翻了桌子，使得玻璃碎片在空中划出一条弧线。

剩下的人被制服和殴打，棍棒敲击在肉体上的声音最终盖过了痛苦愤怒的呼喊声。外来者们惊恐地看着这一幕；员工和本地人则表现得呆滞和失神；什么也不看应该是最安全的做法了。

original:
$HeOrShe looks conflicted, and leans in. "Perhaps you are not without hope, captain. This demonstration of Diktat power is made because you have dared - however ignorantly, however inadvertently - to interfere with Sindrian exports. Fuel is the heart of Sindria's economy, and your attempts to compete in fuel production are a threat, a hostile act, however feeble." $HeOrShe pauses to let you consider the depths of your betrayal. "Now you see, captain."

$HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head, almost regretful. Then speaks loudly, "I have my orders. And I have the clarity of vision to see my orders carried out to their end, no matter what the cost! If I die, the Sindrian Diktat will live on! Glory to the Supreme Executor!"

The $post is standing and saluting the abstract gaze of Philip Andrada, putting on quite a show for $hisOrHer bridge officers.
translation:
$HeOrShe向前一步，表情复杂，解释道。"或许你还算得上不无希望，舰长。辛达强权 之所以如此宣称，是因为你竟敢与我们进行市场竞争，无论你是否知晓后果，无论你是否有意为之 —— 燃料是辛达的经济命脉，而你尝试与我们进行市场竞争就是蓄意威胁，就是敌对行为，不管行为轻重。" $HeOrShe顿了顿，给你留些时间思考自己的背叛行为到底多严重，"这下你懂了吧，舰长。"

$HeOrShe摇了摇头，算是有些后悔的意思，然后大声喊道："我有令在身，我视野清晰，能看清我的命令如何完成，无论付出多少代价！即便我死去，辛达强权 必将继续存在！荣耀归于最高元首！"

$post 直直地站在原地，向抽象的 Philip Andrada 的目光敬礼，给$hisOrHer的舰桥军官演了出好戏。

original:
"Hm," Caden looks worried, almost. "He is quite insistent about his loyalty to the vision of the Supreme Executor, and to myself personally."

He looks down, brow furrowed. "But Macario has played larger tricks before. He was born a liar. Did you know he came from a Luddic family?" 

Caden smiles cruelly, "Oh yes. Of course, he had no faith. Never has and never will. And at the Battle of Salus he was a mere intelligence analyst, a junior officer! I suspect he's never accepted that Andrada did not truly favor him, and never completely trusted him."

"A web of intrigue is nothing compared to the might of a full warfleet. When the time comes, Dolos might realize this." Caden nods, satisfied at his own reasoning.
translation:
"唔，" 忧虑差一点就要出现在 Caden 的脸上，"他本人可是坚持他对最高元首的愿景，以及对我个人都是一片忠心。"

他看向地面，眉头紧锁。"但 Macario 也耍过更大的把戏，他生来就是个骗子。你知不知道他来自一个卢德信徒家庭？" 

Caden 残忍的笑道。"正是如此。当然，他没有信仰，之前没有过，将来也不会有。在 Salus 之战中，他只是个情报分析员，一个下级军官！Andrada 从未真正赏识他，也从未完全信任他，我怀疑他至今也没能对此释怀。

"情报网在一整只舰队的武力面前什么都不是。等时候到了，Dolos 或许就能认识到这一点了。" Caden 点了点头，对他自己的理论颇为满意。

original:
You have your comms officer transmit your appeal on all channels: $PersonRank $PersonName is a traitor in the eyes of the Supreme Executor as per the warrant provided to you by his Chief High Inspector, Dolos Macario. 

Anyone who assists this arrest will be doing their duty to the Sindrian Diktat. Anyone who interferes will be branded a traitor and abettor of terrorism to be dealt with as INTSEC sees fit.

With each word, you can watch $PersonRank $PersonName on a muted comm feed growing more enraged - and more unsure. In perfect silence, you see $himOrHer looking around wildly, shouting words you cannot hear, then arms from out-of-scene grab $himOrHer.

The comm-feed cuts out for a moment.
translation:
你命令通讯军官用所有的频道发送了你的这段声明：在最高元首的眼中，$PersonRank $PersonName 是一名彻头彻尾的叛徒，你手中有最高检察长 Dolos Macario 开出的逮捕令为证。

任何协助逮捕的人员都将被视为对 辛达强权 效忠有功。而任何干预此次逮捕的人员，都将被打上叛徒和恐怖主义同情者的烙印，交由 INTSEC 全权处置。

随着声明逐字逐句地传达，你通过静音的通讯信道欣赏着 $PersonRank $PersonName 逐渐愈发愤怒但又愈发不安的全过程。犹如一出完美的默剧，你看着$himOrHer发了疯似的望向四周，高声叫喊着传不到你这边的话语，随后就被从画面之外伸进去的无数双手臂给拽了出去。

One of my, ah, agents who has been working in Tri-Tachyon space is being pursued. They have information of enormous value."

He sighs, looking up. "Ah, but what this would cost! The question then is how much of the navy will back her - a not insignificant number of that, let us be realistic, rather plebeian force even looks up to her. She's 'strict but fair', they say."

He shakes his head, distracted; working out risk analyses for future schemes.
translation:
"Hyder？让她领导 辛达强权？" 他说着说着，突然大笑一声，但他的眼神仍然严肃如一。

"当然，这种事肯定是异想天开。但，如果说，她相信要想践行她心中那种奇妙的道德观念，满足她心中对秩序的渴求，别无他法的话...就要登上她自认为的领袖之位...对，这个动机说得通。"

他叹了口气，抬头望去，"啊，但她若是想这么来，代价又得有多大！到时候就得问问，整个海军中支持她的又会有多少？说的实际点，她的支持者肯定少不了，不说海军，连那些平民都很尊重她呢。那些平民说，她虽然严苛，却很公正呢。" 

他心不在焉的摇了摇头，估计正暗自评估着以后行动的风险。

original:
"Indeed!" Macario says, wide-eyed. "Imagine wasting years on such a hopeless cause! Then everything is undone because you were compromised by," he smiles with actual pleasure, dropping his voice into mock disappointment, "a friend."

"Oh, I shouldn't pay such attention to such small things. It is one of my few character flaws. But I do so enjoy the drama which plays between the lines of - and I'll be the first to admit - terribly dry intelligence reports. I do miss the old days, sometimes," he sighs.

"There was so much more time to conduct business... personally."
translation:
"确实！" Macario 说道，双目圆睁。"想象一下你将多年的心血投入到这样一个毫无希望的泡影之上！然后一切都毁了，只因为你被别人陷害，" 他发自内心地微笑起来，以一种失望的口吻嘲讽道，"还是被一个朋友。"

"哦，我不应该对这样一件小事过于关注。这是我为数不多的性格缺陷当中的一个。但我实在是很享受这出在一摞摞 —— 我要第一个承认 —— 枯燥无味的情报报告中上演的好戏 。我的确怀念过去的那些美好时光，有时吧。" 他感叹道。

"那时有太多时间来开展一些...私人安排。"

original:
"I must admit that you've underwhelmed me, captain." Macario leans back, hands held together, eyes on you. "Perhaps, stars forgive my manners, but perhaps you have not been entirely forthright?"

"I would so hate for the potential of our little collaboration to, how to put it... there's a Luddic expression, 'die on the vine' I believe? Now there's an image." He smiles charmlessly.

"Speaking of, let me provide you another opportunity to demonstrate your worth." He pauses a moment, then adds in a not-quite-threatening tone, "I'm sure by the end you'll agree that I can be very forgiving."
translation:
"我必须承认，你让我感到失望，舰长。" Macario 向后靠着，双手握在一起，注视着你，"或许 —— 请繁星原谅我的举止 —— 但或许，你并没有完全坦诚？" 

"我非常讨厌我们之间这次小小合作的潜能...怎么说呢，用一个卢德的说法，'无果而终'，我相信是这样说的吧？这么说形象点。" 他毫不迷人地微笑着。

"说到这里，让我给你另一个展示你价值的机会。" 他停顿了一下，然后以一种不完全威胁的语气补充道，"我相信到最后你会留下这样一个印象，那就是我可以非常宽容。"

He pauses, and seems to notice his own hands grasping one another, like they're trying to strangle each other. He lets them fall to the desk in a deliberate motion. 

"That was of mild interest. Confirming, I suppose, other sources," he leans back. "Ah, the rote work of intelligence gathering. It can't all end with a single, dramatic gunshot, eh?"

"Lucky for you, however, that's exactly what I've lined up with you in mind." He catches himself, amused, "No, no, not for you. One of Caden's agents on Umbra. I shall explain."
translation:
他停顿了一下，似乎注意到自己的双手紧紧握在一起，力度大到就像它们想要勒死彼此一样。他故意将手砸到桌上。

"我有些感兴趣了。不如，我觉得，再确认一下其他信源？" 他向后靠着，"啊，情报收集的例行工作哟，并不是所有事情都会以一声戏剧性的枪响作结，对吧？" 

"但你很幸运，我为你考虑的工作就是如此。" 他把自己给逗乐了，"不，不，不是说要射杀你，而是要你处理 Caden 在 Umbra 的一名特工。让我解释一下。"

"To tell the truth," Macario pauses to suppress a strange sound, like a hiccup, "you've been very illuminating." 

He leans back, hands grasping one another. "You could make a reasonable agent, were you more discreet." He smiles hollowly. "Far more discreet."

"Happily, I have just the thing, just the thing. The level of discretion is up to you; you'll find that I supervise with a light hand, contrary to the lies told about me. If you need to raze a few habs from orbit to extract an agent, why, then I accept your professional judgment. But let me explain..."
