original:
A plainclothes INTSEC goon - obvious from their demeanor - opens the door, looks you over disapprovingly, and relieves you of your holstered sidearm before leading you down metal stairs to a dark inner room below the street level.

Yannick Ram sits at a cheap conference table, dismissing the goon with a wave. The door thuds shut behind you, its weight suggesting armor or shielding.

"Captain, captain. I am so pleased that you have joined me. We have much to discuss, much to do," Ram stands with a chilly smile.
translation:
一个便衣的 INTSEC 人员 —— 从他的行为举止可以明显察觉 —— 打开了门，不以为然地审视着你。解下你的随身武器后，他接着带领你沿着金属楼梯通往街区之下的一个漆黑的套间。

"舰长啊舰长。我很高兴你加入了我。我们还有很多事情需要讨论，很多事情要去做，" Ram 站起身来，脸上挂着冷冷的微笑。

"Simply put, the plan - and my fellow patriots are in agreement - is to test and provoke the leaders of the Sindrian Diktat's three arms of power. They will either prove their loyalty to the vision of the Supreme Executor, Lion of Sindria, Philip Andrada, or they will show themselves to be corrupt cowards and traitors who must be executed to ensure the purity of the Great Cause."

"First, the navy. While the Grand Star Marshal is nominally in charge, he lies half-conscious in a clinic on Sindria. The Supreme Executor should have replaced him a cycle ago, but," Ram pauses significantly, "has not."

"In his place, Deputy Star Marshal Oxana Hyder commands the Askonia System Defense Armada. She is... unimaginative, and I suspect she regrets leaving the Hegemony behind during the Battle of Salus."
translation:
"简而言之，计划 —— 我的爱国者同伴们一致同意了的 —— 是测试与煽动辛达强权三大派系的领导人。他们要么证明自己忠于最高元首，辛达瑞亚之狮 Philip Andrada 的伟大愿景，要么揭露自己是必须被处决的腐败懦夫与叛徒，以此确保伟业的纯粹性。"

"首先，是海军。尽管星际元帅名义上还是负责人，但他现在正半昏迷地躺在辛达瑞亚的诊所里。最高元首本应在一个星历年前就把他的职务移交出去，但是，" Ram 意味深长地停顿了一下，"并没有。"

"正坐在他位置上的，副星际元帅 Oxana Hyder 指挥着 Askonia 星系防御舰队。她这人...缺乏想象力，我怀疑她在 Salus 之战时就后悔离开了霸主。"

Ram's goon dropping something? But the weight of the door suggests it would take a great deal more force to make a sound which could be heard in this room.

Ram 的长篇大论突然停下了。他抬起一只手，放在耳边，然后转身面向你，满脸疑惑。

Your eyes dart around, looking for something useful. The table itself is light metal and plastic, as are the folding chairs. Their mass is insufficient for a bludgeon.

The lighting is provided by a few rapidly degrading peel-off glowstrips; useless. In the shadows of the room your eyes catch on some liquid storage barrels - water? - and  a few hand-cargo containers. Padded, with rounded corners for zero-G safety.

Ram has a sidearm on his belt. It would take him but a moment to draw it. Or if he came closer to you...

Stepping back onto what passes for a street, you look up at one of the ubiquitous flickering holos of Philip Andrada, Supreme Executor of the Sindrian Diktat. You try to imagine the Lion of Sindria drooling and mindless, deep in some bunker-clinic, surrounded by increasingly panicked doctors.

Macario seems like a man who turns his capable subordinates into tools and his ambitious subordinates into corpses. But if you play along, for now, he readily provides generous rewards - and access to the heart of the Sindrian Diktat's upcoming power struggle.
translation:
在从无名小路走回街道的途中，辛达强权 最高元首 Philip Andrada 的全息投影依然无处不在地闪耀着。你仰望起了其中一座，试着想象了一下着这位昔日的辛达瑞亚之狮，如今却嘴角流涎神志不清，不得不躺在地下深处的某个医疗地堡里，簇拥在旁的只剩下一群愈发惶恐的医生。

Macario 看来城府颇深，他习惯把安分称职的部下驯为能榨取价值的工具，也不介意把包藏野心的同僚化为用来垫脚爬权的尸骨。但是 —— 至少现在 —— 只要你配合，他就能给你备好厚赏，还能让你触及 辛达强权 接下来争权夺势的风暴眼。

"You begin to understand," says Macario. "Good."

"Hyder believes she must circumvent the bureaucracy to maintain the condition of the Defense Armada. She is correct; the Lion's Guard takes the lion's share," he makes a strange, suppressed noise at his own joke, "-of the military procurement budget. This provides us an opening; leverage."
translation:
"你总算开始理解了。" Macario 说，"好啊。"

"我会发给你一份文件，内容关于 Hyder 副星际元帅手下某名军官。受 Hyder 所托，这位军官会私下面见某位走私贩子，从他那里购买武器。自然，这种行为算是叛国。"

"Hyder 相信，她必须绕开官方购买武器，才能保证星系防御舰队状态齐整。她倒是没错：狮心卫队确实经常狮子大开口。" Macario 一边自顾自的开着玩笑，一边发出某种沉郁的怪声 —— 或许是笑声，"准确的说，是在军备购入订单中，经常狮子大开口。总之，既然有她的把柄在手，你要与她对话就有切入口了，也就有杠杆可用了。"

original:
You oversee the raid from your bridge; your cadre of merc officers who have collectively seen every side of every major Persean conflict of the last 50 cycles run tactical command.

Each squad is set up like a surgery, cool and precise. Then, all at once, hell is unleashed: breaching charges churn storms of dust and debris lit into strobing clouds of fire by weapon discharge. Sub-AIs build ghostly visualizations with milliradar, updating threat-tags in real-time for each marine's combat display.

The target is flagged off bone structure scanned by combat sensors and matched to Macario's file. The agent is bagged and restrained for extraction with only minor injuries.
translation:
你在舰桥上监督着这场劫掠。你麾下佣兵的军官骨干们，共同见证过近 50 星历年来每一次重要冲突的每一方势力，战术指挥正是由他们负责。

每个小队的安排都如同外科手术一样，冷静而又精准。接着，地狱的一角被揭开了：破门炸药搅起尘埃的暴风，武器释放的火云频频闪烁，点燃了四散飞溅的碎屑。次级 AI 用毫米波雷达构筑出幽影般的可视化信息，实时更新着每一个陆战队员作战影像上的威胁标签。

根据作战传感器对骨骼结构的扫描结果，任务目标被精准地标记了出来，并与 Macario 的档案进行对比确认。该特工已被捕获并拘束以待撤出，仅受轻伤。

You join your technology officer and engineering chief in a small briefing room overlooking the shop bay dedicated to what has been euphemistically dubbed "special salvage".

Haz-suited technicians attend to the containment machinery, stepping over coils of tube and wire. A mess of makeshift components were pulled from the common microforge libraries then torn apart and re-engineered to operate in this unusual, even extraordinary, application.

Engineering wears a frown, tapping a TriPad as they observe the ongoing work. Tech can barely contain their excitement. 

"$PlayerSirOrMadam," they say in unison at your arrival.

工程师皱着眉头，在工作中时不时敲击 TriPad。技术官则已按捺不住激动的心情。

original:
On a bench before you lies a dueling kit: hardened boots, gloves, and helmet. A neatly folded jumpsuit of material smart enough to allow only what it judges to be non-lethal jabs and cuts comes with a suite of embedded medical sensors to automatically perform first-aid upon injury. "Deaths are very rare," a minor aristocrat assures you as he hands a scabbard to Neriene Rao.

She waves him back toward the gawkers with an annoyed look. There are fewer gathered around you, and fewer uniforms, than those egging on Cardona and Sang.

"This is stupid," she says, drawing the sword a handswidth and examining the edge. "You don't have to go through with it."
translation:
你面前的长台面上摆着一整套的决斗装备：坚固的靴子、手套和头盔，还有一套连身衣整齐地叠放在一旁。连身衣由智能材料构成，只允许被认定为非致命的刺击和劈砍穿过它。同时它还带有一套嵌入式医疗设备，可以在受伤时自动执行急救。"几乎没人在决斗时死去，" 一位低阶贵族向你保证道，同时他把一支没出鞘的剑递给了 Neriene Rao。

她挥手把这位低阶贵族赶回了看客之中，脸上止不住地流露出懊恼的神情。相对于 Cardona 和 Sang 那边，你这边围上来的人很少，而其中穿制服的家伙就更少了。

"这太蠢了，" 她说着，把剑抽出一掌宽，仔细检查起剑刃来。"你没必要这么做。"

original:
"We are all but comrades-in-arms, you and I. But where are my manners? Caspian Sang, reporting for duty." He half-salutes with his drink again, the liquid in the glass approaching but not quite escaping the rim. You catch one of Sang's drinking companions snickering, though it is unclear who the target is.

"Although..." He puts a finger on his chin, pantomiming deep thought, "...perhaps I should count you as, at best, an auxiliary comrade. Does your Hegemony commission pay splendidly well? No need to answer of course, friend. It is the business," this word he emphasizes, "of none but yourself."

"And old man Daud, of course," he adds with a wink.
translation:
"我们彼此几乎就是战友。可看看我，礼节都到哪里去了？Caspian Sang，前来报到。" 他握着酒又随手敬了个礼，差点就把杯子里的烈酒泼出来了。你逮到 Sang 的一个酒友正在窃笑，但搞不清楚是在笑谁。

"不过..." 他用手指托着下巴，假装沉思起来，"...也许我最多只能把你，算作一个辅助军同志，你在 霸主 这里拿到的报酬优厚吗？当然不用回答，朋友。这是属于你自己的 '买卖'，" 他强调着这个词，"与他人无关。"

"当然也和 Daud 老头有点关系。" 他眨眨眼补充道。

"I tell you what, I have just the notion." He decisively quaffs his drink, then proceeds.

"A most spectacular notion. In light of Daud's declaration that you're as much an officer as us, it would only be proper to provide you an opportunity to share an anecdote or two of your wisdom with the cream of the navy, don't you think?"

"House Rao - surely you know the family - is holding the grand ball of this season on Eventide. I shall place your name upon the guest list by invitation of the humble House Sang. Now does that not sound absolutely first-rate? You'll be the talk of the season, I'm sure of it."
translation:
"你知道吗，我有个主意。" 他果断地一口干了杯中的酒，然后继续说了下去。

"一个再精彩不过了的好主意。考虑到 Daud 宣称你身为军官的统率水平和我们不相上下，正好现在有个机会，能让你来和海军精英们一起分享一两件你的智慧轶事，这再合适不过了，不是吗？"

"Rao 家族，你一定听过这个名字，他们将在 Eventide 举行本季的盛大舞会。而我会以卑微的 Sang 家族的名义，将你的名字列入宾客名单。怎么样，听起来是不是相当一流？我敢肯定，你会成为这个季度的话题人物。"

original:
Despite the anonymous work-suit, you note the fine tracery of unnatural scars and insolent swagger that suggest this $manOrWoman is connected to organized crime.

$HeOrShe flicks some ash from a smoldering stim-stick onto the table, then offers a seat with the same hand, the smoke tracing an arc in the air.

"I need eyes on $ssat_marketName, in the $ssat_systemName. Word is you're quiet and can get jobs done." A drag from the stim-stick. "I can't afford being caught there, even in orbit. Got a bit of a record." You see a smile by the glint off $hisOrHer teeth.

"I'll provide the spysat package. Make sure no patrols are on your tail when you deploy it in orbit. Easy as robbing a Luddie pilgrim, yeah? Pay is $ssat_reward credits. You in?"
translation:
虽然只是穿着没什么个性的业务西装，但你留意到了这个$manOrWoman身上用精美的彩色纹身都掩盖不住的严重伤疤，和$heOrShe傲慢无礼的态度。这应该是个和犯罪团伙有些关系的家伙。

$HeOrShe把提神烟的烟灰弹到了桌面上，用夹着烟的手对你做了个请坐的手势，任由烟雾在空中画了条弧线。

"我需要监视 $ssat_systemName 的 $ssat_marketName}。有消息说你废话不多做事利索。" $heOrShe飞了一口提神烟，"我可不能在轨道那块儿被抓。毕竟之前在那儿留了点案底。"你看到金牙闪耀，才注意到$hisOrHer应该是笑了一下。

"放心，我会提供间谍卫星的。你只要负责把卫星弄到轨道上就好，记得别让巡逻队跟着你。这就跟抢个卢德朝圣者一样简单，不是吗？一笔就能赚 $ssat_reward 星币。搞不？"

original:
"Captain $playerName," $heOrShe says with a cool nod as you approach. "Your reputation precedes you."

$HeOrShe sips something transparent from a small crystal glass then taps $hisOrHer datapad; a privacy field blurs and muffles the surroundings.

"I require a well-led but irregular force willing to perform a tactical bombardment of $tabo_marketName, $tabo_dist light-years away. If this operation were performed to mission parameters, $tabo_reward credits could be routed to your account."

Glass in one hand, the $faction $rank taps $hisOrHer datapad again and slides it toward you. The display shows garrison numbers, defense parameters, and detailed intelligence. You politely survey the report and estimate that you'd need around $tabo_fuel fuel to carry out the proposed bombardment. The $rank is watching you, and as you look up raises an eyebrow. "Are you in?"
translation:
"$playerName 舰长，" 在你走近时，$heOrShe严肃地点了点头，"你可是名声在外。"

$HeOrShe抿了一口水晶杯里的无色液体，随后点了几下$hisOrHer的数据平板，隐私场隔绝了声音，领域外的景象也变得模糊了起来。

"我需要一支精锐但不在编制内的舰队，以对 $tabo_dist 光年外的 $tabo_marketName 进行战术轰炸。如果你能按照相关指示执行任务，{$tabo_reward 星币将会汇到你的账户内。"

一只手拿着杯子，$faction $rank 又操作了几下数据平板，然后将它滑向了你。屏幕上显示着驻军人数，布防状况之类的详细情报。在礼貌地浏览了报告后，你估计自己需要大约 $tabo_fuel 燃料来进行轰炸。$rank 注视着你，当你抬头时，对方扬起眉毛。"接这任务吗？"

"Here's what you're going to do." He speaks loudly now, looking directly through the comms.

"This is a negotiation, you understand? Tri-Tachyon is making an assertive opening bid, they're saying 'Don't try to compete with us, you'll lose. Just give up.' If you want to be taken seriously, you must reply aggressively, you understand? Tell them that it is unprofitable to compete with YOU."

original:
"Tri-Tachyon doesn't want war, they want a deal. They don't hold grudges, they don't care about ideology, or beliefs, or ethics. The Company is as happy to sell to the Church as the Diktat, and the Hegemony after two major wars, for all that those matter. In the end, it's about profits."

"So you must learn what negotiating is. You're not in this to destroy the Company; you can't. You don't want to remove their path to de-escalation. Show them that sponsoring attacks on you is a poor investment, but don't make it a PR disaster - it must be a covert fight. Transponder off, you hear me? Burn their fleets, burn their facilities, and always make sure they can say it wasn't you. Give them an out, and that out will be cutting a nice deal with you."

"Win-win."

He pauses to look accusingly at you. "Are my words getting into your brain or has it been floating around in space too long? Do you understand win-win?"
translation:
"速子科技 并不想发动战争，他们想要达成协议。他们不会记仇，也不在乎意识形态、信仰或道德。公司乐于向教会、辛达强权和经历过两场战争的 霸主 出售商品，这些都不重要。归根结底，一切都是为了利益。"

"所以你必须学会什么是谈判。你不是为了毁灭公司而来；你做不到。你也不想阻断可以缓和局势的渠道。让他们明白资助对你的袭击是一笔糟糕的投资，但不要让它变成公关灾难 —— 这必须是一场秘密的战斗。关闭应答器，你听到了吗？摧毁他们的舰队，摧毁他们的设施，并确保他们总能声称这不是你干的。给他们一个台阶下，而这个台阶就是与你达成一笔不错的交易。"

"双赢。"

他停下来，用责备的眼神看着你。"我的话你听进去了吗？还是你的脑子在太空里飘得太久了？你明白双赢的意思吗？"

"Captain, captain!" $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head in a pretense of shock, "My word is my bond. Besides, Tactistar holds a contract! A contract which includes a generous signing payment."

"Where would we be if mercenaries could simply sell their services to the highest bidder, with no regard for such concepts as honor and, after a fashion, morality?" $HeOrShe gestures vaguely, "Just imagine the sort of world we would live in."

$HeOrShe looks off into space for a few seconds, as if lost in a daydream. $HeOrShe turns back to face you, expression perfectly earnest. "No, your offer simply will not do."

"舰长，舰长！" $HeOrShe假装震惊地摇了摇$hisOrHer的脑袋，"我言出必行。再说了，战术之星还握着一份协议呢！一份包含丰厚签约金的合同。"

$HeOrShe凝视着太空，仿佛陷入了沉思，几秒钟后才回过神来。当$HeOrShe再度转过身来面对你时，表情已经变得无比认真。"不，你的提议不可行。"

"Greetings, star-farer. $HeOrShe微笑着，很完美。

"让我出价 $entity.ttwi_credits 星币，以换取您把它转移到我的舰船上吧。这样我们都可以满载而归。"

original:
"The miners of Derinkuyu Station, which is also located in this system and was operating near a subsistence level, were hit the hardest. They turned to piracy, intercepting one of the last food shipments to come in - out of desperation, no doubt, but there were deaths, and they've put themselves well outside the law.

Their leaders know that if the jump-points are stabilized and the system is once again part of the Sector, they can look forward to a life sentence at a penal colony at absolute best."

"同处于这个星系的 Derinkuyu 空间站上的矿工本来就挣扎在只能勉强维持生计的水平上，因此受到的打击最大。他们开始从事海盗行径，拦截了一批最后运抵的食物 —— 被逼无奈，毫无疑问。但由于已经造成了伤亡，他们早已公然凌驾于法律之上。

original:
Your tactical officer rapidly taps a few buttons; holodisplays flicker through status updates.

"If the shuttle power cores were overloaded simultaneously, well, with the shuttles so close to the wreck? The hull would have likely been damaged past any hope of recovery. In addition to killing the salvor crews, of course. But I don't think that was their goal; there are easier ways to kill salvage crews." 

As you indicate to your operations chief to ready the salvage teams for a second attempt, your tactical officer adds, "It comes to mind that what we just experienced was an attempt at an old Tri-Tach trick from the Second AI War. They left black-box EW traps to keep the Hegemony from recovering intel and tech from disabled hulls. And it worked. For a while, anyway. I'm just glad we kept that legacy commsec package installed."
translation:
你的战术军官快速地摁了几个按钮，全息投影上闪现出了更新过的数据。

"假如在距离残骸这么近的情况下，所有穿梭机的能量核心同时被过载的话会怎么样？那这船体就可能受到严重的损伤，没有修复的希望了。当然也会杀死打捞小组，但我认为这并不是他们的目的，毕竟明显有比这更容易杀死打捞小组的办法。"

当你指示行动长官让打捞小组做好开展第二次尝试的准备的时候，战术军官补充道，"长官，看起来刚刚我们遇到的应该是第二次 AI 战争时 速子科技 用的小把戏罢了。他们会在黑匣子上留下电磁脉冲陷阱，防止 霸主 从他们停机的船体里回收提取有价值的信息和科技。这方法挺管用的，至少管用过一段时间。我还蛮高兴那些旧的通讯链接安全包都还装着没被卸掉。"

original:
You dismiss your tactical officer and ponder the situation as the call-and-return proceeds between your command crew and the salvage teams waiting at standby. Reports trickle up through the hierarchy, from junior officers in after-action/sim analyst teams to your bridge crew. A picture begins to form that has too many gaps for your liking: The core-collapse signal appears to have originated not exactly in, but uncomfortably near to a secure cargo bay holding an Alpha Core. The core was shielded in complete isolation at the time, and it denies any responsibility as effortlessly as it offers you its service and advice during this crisis, if you would be so kind as to open up a small data-link. You curtly terminate the secured comm-channel and order the AI put back in isolated lock-down.

Your comms officer reports that there is uncertainty whether the AI was involved, or if the signal was sent from that location to throw suspicion onto the core. Both possibilities have troubling implications. In the meantime, however, your ops chief calls in, requesting the order to enter the wreck.
translation:
你结束了与战术军官的讨论，一边考量着当前的情况，一边听着指挥人员和原地待命的打捞小组之间维持着呼叫-应答流程。行动后/模拟分析小组的下级军官们的报告逐层汇总，集中在了你和你的舰桥船员面前。虽然还远不能让你满意，但事件的全貌逐渐被拼凑完全了：这艘舰船上有个装载有 Alpha 核心的安全货舱，发出能量核心崩溃指令的信号源虽然并不在那个货舱内部，但位置近得令人不安。AI 核心在事件发生时正受到屏蔽，与外界完全隔绝，而它一边拒绝为此事件负责，一边积极地自荐要在这场危机中为你提供帮助和建议，只要你能好心地帮它打开一个小小的数据链接。你毫不客气地终止了 Alpha 核心的隔离通讯频道，并下令把它重新放进隔离舱。

你的通讯军官汇报道，并不确定这次是 AI 参与了这一事件，还是信号源被故意放在核心附近，以便将怀疑引向核心。这两种可能性细推下去都令人感到担忧。然而，就在这时，行动长官接入通讯，申请再次进入残骸中。

original:
Scrolling the virtual pages, you find that the journal appears to hold the private thoughts of the chief technology officer of this facility.

It begins with vague complaints of being ordered to disregard safety protocols during tests, and frustration with demands made by Kelise Astraia. From what you understand, this is an effort to establish a hardcopy trail in case of the blame-shifting and record-altering which is common practice for high-ranking Tri-Tachyon executives involved in failed projects.

Concerns about "going outside" feature prominently in the entries. Understandable, given the surface conditions, but the increasingly intense obsessiveness of the writing seems to reflect a growing phobia on the part of the author.
translation:
翻动着日志的扫描件，你仿佛进入了这个速子设施技术主管的私人世界。

从最初对于在测试中被命令无视安全协议的含糊抱怨，以及对 Kelise Astraia 提出的要求的沮丧态度。以你对 速子科技 的了解，参与过失败项目的高管常常被当做替罪羊 —— 这显然是为避免记录被篡改而有意写下的备份。

高管本人对 "能否走出这里" 的担忧在显著地逐渐增加。表面情况下确实可以理解，但高管在书中的语气愈发地凸显出他日益增长而不曾消退的恐惧。

original:
After a few tense minutes, reports start to come in - the vessel is heavily damaged, and though of exotic design, it is theoretically recoverable.

Your operations chief reports that for all of the fancy hull features, it is clear that this ship requires crew to operate. But there are no traces of a crew, not even a single body caught in the battle damage, and the escape pods are all in their berths.

The operation proceeds with telemetry feeds, salvors' reports, and authorization orders flowing around you, through the bridge of your flagship. You catch yourself listening for that unheard music in a quiet moment, and shake your head just as a comms request from your technology officer appears, bringing you back from your reverie. You accept as a matter of course.
translation:
度过了焦灼的几分钟后，各种报告终于开始汇总了上来 —— 尽管目标舰船构造奇特且受损严重，但理论上还是可以恢复的。

行动长官的报告中描述虽然该船体外观复杂花俏，但这艘船仍需要船员进行操纵。然而打捞小组在调查中并未发现任何船员留下的痕迹，连一具因战损而留下的尸体都没有，甚至连逃生舱也全都原封不动地留在发射槽上。

随着行动的开展，各种遥测回馈、打捞汇报和指令传达的信息在喷涌在你身旁，向旗舰舰桥的各处奔去。你猛然意识到自己正倾听着那一段之前未曾听闻过的旋律，失神了有好一会儿了。你甩了甩头试图让自己回过神，而总工程师的通讯申请这时正巧也传了过来，一同把你拉回了现实。你就如同无事发生一样接受了通讯请求。

original:
Salvage teams dock their drone-shuttles at various entry points along the massive vessel's hull. At the precise moment the go-order is given, all telemetry feeds from the shuttles simultaneously blank out.

Your bridge officers initiate fallback procedures with practiced speed, contacting subordinates, performing checks and reinitializations to establish precisely where the systems fault occurred - and determine if it was a hostile act. Several agonizing minutes later, the salvage teams' data-feed and comms snap back to life.

"Captain!" Your tactical officer salutes, then launches into a status report, "Someone or something just tried to send a power core collapse signal to the shuttles' computers. Fortunately the security package caught it in time, but they had to perform a full systems shutdown and manually switch to backups; that's why their telemetry cut off. All salvage teams are now reporting all-green and are standing by."
translation:
打捞小组将他们的无人穿梭机部署并对接在这艘巨型船体的各个入口处。在舰桥下令进入的时候，同一时间的所有的遥测信息反馈都消失了。

舰桥立即发出撤退指令，并且联络下属开始执行检查并试图初始化无人机，以精准定位系统故障的位置 —— 同时试图判断这是不是敌对行为。整个舰桥这几分钟都像热锅上的蚂蚁，打捞小组的通讯和数据反馈终于恢复了。

"长官！" 你的战术军官在你面前标准地敬了一个礼，并且开始向你报告状况，"有人试图对我们的穿梭机的内部电脑发送动力系统崩溃指令。幸运的是安全系统及时拦截了它，但我们不得不重启整个系统并且手动切换到备份上；以上是遥测被切断的原因。现在整个打捞小组随时可以出动。"
